jobs.description:
*Dutch speaking*

Wil jij jouw ervaring in klantcontact inzetten voor dossiers waarin niet altijd direct duidelijk is wie er aansprakelijk is? Als Klantenservice Medewerker Aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen bij KCD behandel je uiteenlopende en soms complexe situaties. Je onderzoekt wat er precies is gebeurd, duikt in polisvoorwaarden en wet- en regelgeving en maakt vervolgens zelfstandig een goed onderbouwde beslissing.

Geen standaard antwoorden, maar dossiers waarin jouw beoordelingsvermogen en aanpak écht het verschil maken. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om situaties van A tot Z te behandelen en hebt daarbij oog voor zowel de inhoud als de impact op de klant.

De rol

Als Klantenservice Medewerker Aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen behandel je klantvragen en dossiers waarbij aansprakelijkheid niet altijd direct duidelijk is. Je brengt de situatie zorgvuldig in kaart, verzamelt de benodigde informatie en beoordeelt op basis van de feiten, polisvoorwaarden en geldende wet- en regelgeving wat de juiste afhandeling is.

Je krijgt bijvoorbeeld een klant aan de lijn die als vriendendienst de badkamer bij zijn buurman betegelt, maar daarbij per ongeluk het nieuwe bad beschadigt. Of een klant belt omdat zijn fiets is gestolen, terwijl deze op slot stond én met een ketting aan een lantaarnpaal was vastgemaakt. In dit soort situaties is het aan jou om de juiste vragen te stellen, de situatie te beoordelen en tot een passende beslissing te komen.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het zelfstandig behandelen van complexe aansprakelijkheidsdossiers van A tot Z;

  • Klanten telefonisch te woord staan en hun situatie zorgvuldig in kaart brengen;

  • Doorvragen en relevante informatie verzamelen om tot een goede beoordeling te komen;

  • Dossiers beoordelen aan de hand van polisvoorwaarden, wet- en regelgeving en de beschikbare feiten;

  • Zelfstandig inhoudelijke beslissingen nemen en deze duidelijk onderbouwen;

  • Klanten op een duidelijke en professionele manier informeren over jouw beslissing;

  • Omgaan met situaties waarin belangen kunnen botsen of bewijsvoering niet direct duidelijk is;

  • Zorgen voor een correcte en zorgvuldige administratieve afhandeling van dossiers.

Naast het behandelen van dossiers werk je samen met collega's aan een goede dienstverlening:

  • Je bespreekt complexe of opvallende casussen met collega's;

  • Je deelt kennis en ervaringen en leert van verschillende situaties;

  • Je ontvangt coaching en feedback om jouw inhoudelijke kennis verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Je denkt mee over het verbeteren van processen en de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening.

In deze functie is geen dossier hetzelfde. Het ene moment ben je bezig met het analyseren van een schade, terwijl je even later met een klant bespreekt waarom een bepaalde beslissing is genomen. Juist de combinatie van klantcontact, inhoudelijke analyse en zelfstandig beslissen maakt deze functie afwisselend.

Dit krijg je

Bij KCD krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen de verzekeringswereld. Je krijgt begeleiding en coaching om steeds meer kennis en ervaring op te doen in aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen. Naarmate je meer ervaring opdoet, krijg je steeds meer zelfstandigheid in het behandelen van complexe dossiers.

Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

  • Een bruto uurloon van €16,50;

  • Een flexibel contract waarbij je minimaal 28 uur per week werkt (20-28 / 24-32 / 28-36);

  • Werktijden van maandag tot en met vrijdag tussen 08:00 en 18:00 uur;

  • Een opleidingsbudget van €300,- per jaar voor trainingen en cursussen;

  • Een goed geregelde pensioenregeling;

  • Een functie waarin je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en jezelf inhoudelijk kunt ontwikkelen;

  • Een prettige werkomgeving waarin je samenwerkt met collega's en terechtkunt voor vragen en ondersteuning.

Requirements

Dit ben jij

Als Klantenservice Medewerker Aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen vind je het leuk om situaties uit te pluizen en tot de kern van een probleem te komen. Je stelt de juiste vragen, kunt verschillende belangen tegen elkaar afwegen en durft zelfstandig een beslissing te nemen.

Je vindt het interessant dat niet iedere situatie een standaardoplossing heeft en krijgt energie van dossiers waarin je echt moet nadenken. Tegelijkertijd verlies je de klant niet uit het oog en weet je jouw beslissing op een duidelijke en professionele manier uit te leggen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Mbo 4 werk- en denkniveau;

  • Ervaring in klantcontact, bijvoorbeeld binnen een klantenservice- of verzekeringsomgeving;

  • Een sterk analytisch en beoordelend vermogen;

  • Je kunt goed luisteren, doorvragen en hoofd- van bijzaken onderscheiden;

  • Je bent in staat om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen en deze goed te onderbouwen;

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met verschillende belangen en soms lastige klantgesprekken;

  • Je bent nauwkeurig en kunt goed werken met verschillende systemen en informatiebronnen;

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Je bent minimaal 28 uur per week beschikbaar.

Over KCD

Klant Contact Diensten (KCD) verzorgt het klantcontact voor bekende Nederlandse verzekeraars. Vanuit huis of op kantoor help je mensen écht verder; met kennis, aandacht en een luisterend oor. In deze functie krijg je de kans om je verder te ontwikkelen in een inhoudelijke rol waarin klantcontact en verzekeringskennis samenkomen. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen en leert iedere dag van nieuwe en uitdagende situaties.

Overview

LMI is seeking an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Engineer to support a Special Operations Command (SOCOM) mission partner with production machine learning, predictive forecasting, natural language processing, generative AI, and real-time decision-support capabilities. The AI/ML Engineer will design, implement, optimize, integrate, and sustain scalable AI/ML solutions within secure web-based applications and enterprise workflows. This position will work as part of a cross-functional data science product team to translate validated models into reliable operational capabilities while advancing reusable engineering patterns, governance, security, documentation, and enterprise AI/ML best practices.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and achieve mission success.

This position requires an active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and optimize machine learning algorithms for predictive forecasting, rate prediction, resource planning, and real-time decision support.
  • Develop and refine supervised, unsupervised, time-series, regression, ensemble, and other appropriate models to meet stringent accuracy, reliability, explainability, latency, and efficiency requirements.
  • Develop natural language processing and generative AI solutions, including large language models and retrieval-augmented generation capabilities tailored to approved business, operational, and intelligence use cases.
  • Engineer reusable model services, application programming interfaces, containers, and software components that integrate seamlessly into secure web-based applications, dashboards, and other mission data products.
  • Design scalable and reliable architectures for batch and real-time inference, model serving, monitoring, and application support across development, test, and production environments.
  • Integrate predictive models into existing web-based applications and enterprise workflows while ensuring compatibility, reliability, security, and seamless user functionality.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and data engineers to establish compatible data structures, features, pipelines, interfaces, and validation methods for model training, evaluation, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Conduct performance testing, hyperparameter tuning, error analysis, back-testing, drift detection, and model monitoring; document assumptions, limitations, risks, and opportunities for continued improvement.
  • Implement MLOps and DevSecOps practices for source control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and repeatable sustainment.
  • Apply responsible and secure AI/ML engineering practices, including access control, data protection, model governance, explainability, evaluation, auditability, and risk management.
  • Support enterprise synchronization, integration, governance, sustainment, and adoption of AI/ML capabilities across multiple mission teams, stakeholder organizations, applications, and products.
  • Develop projects that automate or augment human cognitive workload and respond rapidly to emerging operational requirements and changes in the mission environment.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation covering algorithms, system architecture, interfaces, security, testing, deployment, operations, and integration processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, demonstrations, instructional videos, and knowledge-transfer products sufficient for a qualified practitioner to assume future operation and sustainment of the capability.
  • Provide rapid-response engineering and product-level staff augmentation based on changes in mission priorities and the operational environment.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Five or more years of professional experience designing, developing, deploying, and sustaining machine learning models or AI-enabled software capabilities in production environments.
  • Advanced proficiency with Python and practical experience with modern machine learning frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and validating predictive models, including time-series, regression, ensemble, or comparable forecasting methods, against defined accuracy and performance requirements.
  • Experience operationalizing models through application programming interfaces, services, containers, automated testing, version control, continuous integration and delivery, model registries, monitoring, and repeatable deployment processes.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, data structures, feature pipelines, data quality controls, and secure integration with relational, non-relational, object-storage, or analytical data platforms.
  • Experience developing scalable architectures for batch or real-time inference, model serving, application integration, monitoring, and production support.
  • Knowledge of responsible and secure AI/ML engineering practices, including access control, data protection, model governance, explainability, evaluation, auditability, and risk management.
  • Experience producing clear algorithm, architecture, interface, test, deployment, operational, and knowledge-transfer documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across data science, data engineering, software, cybersecurity, governance, and operational teams.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable production capabilities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

We are seeking a Director of Product Line Management to define, build, and scale a portfolio of telecom enterprise services and network products. This leader will own the strategy and business performance of offerings that enable enterprises and service providers to connect locations reliably, securely, and at scale - from access devices and Layer 2 switching platforms to Carrier Ethernet and managed connectivity services.

Operating as the general manager for the product line, the Director will translate customer and market requirements into differentiated architectures, investment priorities, roadmaps, launch plans, and lifecycle decisions. The ideal candidate has brought purpose-built products - such as Layer 2 switches, Ethernet NIDs/eNIDs, access platforms, or edge appliances - from concept through certification, scale, and end-of-life, and understands how those platforms become repeatable, SLA-backed services.

What You'll Own

  • Portfolio strategy and P&L: Set the multi-year strategy, market segmentation, investment thesis, pricing, packaging, revenue plan, margin targets, and portfolio rationalization decisions using customer and competitive insight.

  • Product creation: Lead the end-to-end development of Layer 2 switching, Carrier Ethernet demarcation, NID/eNID, access, and edge products, including market requirements, business cases, PRDs, platform choices, feature priorities, release criteria, and lifecycle plans.

  • Enterprise service portfolio: Build scalable services including Ethernet Private Line and Virtual Private Line, E-LAN, DIA access, managed LAN, cloud connectivity, and adjacent secure or assured connectivity offers.

  • Technical and platform direction: Partner with Engineering and Architecture on switching silicon, system architecture, network operating software, optics, timing, power, thermal, security, manageability, and service-assurance requirements.

  • Partner and supply ecosystem: Evaluate and manage chipset, ODM/JDM, contract manufacturing, optics, software, certification, and technology partners; balance cost, differentiation, quality, availability, and roadmap control.

  • Product lifecycle governance: Establish disciplined stage gates from discovery and concept through development, field trials, launch, sustaining engineering, refresh, migration, and end-of-sale/end-of-support.

  • Go-to-market leadership: Define positioning, competitive differentiation, sales plays, solution bundles, enablement, launch readiness, reference customers, and adoption programs with Sales and Marketing.

  • Team leadership: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing product line management team; create clear decision rights, operating rhythms, accountability, and succession plans.

Domain Expertise

Candidates with demonstrated depth across several of the following areas will be strongly preferred:

  • Layer 2 switching: Ethernet switching architectures; VLANs and IEEE 802.1Q; QinQ/802.1ad; LAG and MC-LAG; STP/RSTP/MSTP; LLDP; QoS, buffering, multicast, and resiliency.

  • Carrier Ethernet and MEF services: E-Line/E-LAN/E-Tree service constructs, EPL/EVPL, bandwidth profiles, class of service, service OAM, SLA design, UNI/NNI concepts, and MEF-aligned lifecycle automation.

  • Hardware and software platforms: Merchant silicon and SDK ecosystems, BSPs, embedded systems, network operating systems, APIs, telemetry, secure boot, software maintenance, component lifecycle, and supply-chain risk.

  • Service assurance and automation: IEEE 802.1ag CFM, ITU-T Y.1731, performance monitoring, fault isolation, zero-touch provisioning, streaming telemetry, orchestration, inventory, and closed-loop assurance.

  • Commercial product management: Market sizing, competitive analysis, portfolio economics, pricing, gross margin, unit cost, forecasting, business cases, channel strategy, and contract or SLA implications.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 12+ years in product management or product line leadership in telecom, networking, or enterprise connectivity, including 5+ years leading teams or major portfolios.

  • Proven product delivery: A record of launching and scaling physical networking products such as Layer 2 switches, NIDs/eNIDs, access devices, routers, or edge appliances, together with software and service capabilities.

  • Business ownership: Demonstrated responsibility for a product line business plan, revenue and margin performance, pricing, roadmap investment, and lifecycle decisions.

  • Technical fluency: Ability to engage credibly with system architects and engineers on hardware, silicon, NOS/software, optics, protocols, APIs, telemetry, and deployment tradeoffs without losing sight of customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Market leadership: Strong understanding of enterprise buyer needs, telecom operator economics, global competitive dynamics, routes to market, and standards-based service delivery.

  • Cross-functional influence: Success aligning Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and external partners around high-stakes product decisions.

  • Executive influence: Exceptional communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, align senior stakeholders, and drive decisions.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Growth and economics: Revenue, bookings, adoption, strategic account penetration, gross margin, forecast accuracy, inventory health, and return on product investment.

  • Execution: Roadmap predictability, on-time launch, quality, certification readiness, field-trial conversion, and lifecycle discipline.

  • Customer outcomes: Service availability, SLA performance, deployment velocity, support burden, customer satisfaction, and renewal/expansion.

  • Leadership: Team capability, decision quality, cross-functional alignment, and development of future product leaders.

Why Join Us

  • Build the portfolio: Shape the next generation of enterprise connectivity products and services from architecture through commercial scale.

  • Work across the stack: Unite hardware, software, automation, assurance, and managed services to solve real connectivity problems.

  • Lead with autonomy: Join an entrepreneurial, customer-obsessed organization that values sound judgment, ownership, collaboration, and accountability.

Working Conditions

This is a full-time leadership position operating in a professional office and remote collaboration environment. The role requires flexibility to work across global time zones and to support important customer, partner, launch, or operational matters outside standard business hours when reasonably necessary.

Travel and Physical Requirements

Ability to travel domestically and internationally, typically up to 25-35%, with a valid passport and no material travel restrictions. The role requires extended computer use and periodic visits to offices, laboratories, manufacturing partners, data centers, and customer network sites.

  • Audience targeting
  • Acquisition economics and paid-media performance

Conversion

  • Landing pages
  • Conversion rate optimisation
  • Offer construction
  • Product page optimisation
  • Checkout flow
  • Customer journey and conversion friction

Retention

You should understand:

  • Email flows
  • SMS
  • Post-purchase experience
  • LTV strategy
  • Subscription models
  • Repeat purchase and retention

Economics

  • Unit economics
  • Contribution margin
  • CAC
  • ROAS
  • P&L fundamentals
  • Pricing strategy

Essential

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience running, managing, or growing ecommerce or DTC brands. You have been in the trenches, not simply advising from the sidelines.

  • Broad commercial understanding across traffic, conversion, retention, and ecommerce economics.
  • The ability to diagnose business challenges, identify priorities, and translate strategy into clear, practical actions.

Highly regarded

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Direct exposure to Foundr leadership and the wider ecommerce operator community.

jobs.description:
About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

Job Summary:

Octave is looking for a Head of Data Platform & AI to lead the technical vision and execution across our data platform and emerging AI, machine learning, and Data Science capabilities. This role will own and evolve Octave’s data and AI/ML technical foundation, set the technical/strategic direction for AI/ML in close partnership with Product and cross-functional business leaders, and build the team required to execute that vision as Octave grows.

This is a leadership role for a builder. While you will set strategy, lead the team, and operate as a senior cross-functional partner, you will remain close to the technology and be expected to contribute directly to architecture, prototypes, technical evaluation, and difficult engineering problems. You will initially lead a Data Platform team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and business leaders across Octave.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Develops, coordinates, and implements systems, policies, procedures, and productivity standards.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to the team, ensuring the achievement of goals and objectives.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of projects and initiatives within the team.
  • Establish and monitor operational processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and productivity.
  • Streamline operational processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall organizational performance.
  • Implement best practices, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and develop strategies to achieve operational excellence.
  • Ensures a safe, secure, and compliant work environment.
  • Accomplishes staff results by communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.
  • Build and manage a high-performing team, including hiring, training, and development.
  • Provide leadership to the team, including setting goals, providing guidance, and ensuring the team's overall success.
  • Set performance expectations and goals for team members. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and address performance issues.
  • Identify skill gaps within the team and develop strategies for filling those gaps. Support employee development through training, mentoring, and coaching. Identify high-potential employees and create succession plans.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Define Octave’s Data & AI Technical Vision
    • Develop and own the technical strategy and roadmap for Octave’s data platform and AI/ML capabilities, while shaping company-level direction and investment priorities by bringing a data and AI perspective to decisions about where Octave competes and how it grows.
    • Own company-level KPIs spanning Octave's AI/ML and Data Platform areas — defining the measures that matter, holding accountability for outcomes against them, and reporting on progress to the executive team.
    • Partner closely with Product and cross-functional leaders to identify where AI, machine learning, and Data Science can create meaningful customer and business value, and own the technical strategy and capabilities required to bring those opportunities to life.
    • Serve as Octave’s senior technical leader and thought partner on data, AI, ML, and Data Science.
    • Help Product, Engineering, and business leaders evaluate opportunities, understand technical feasibility and tradeoffs, and shape Octave’s approach to emerging capabilities.
    • Develop a clear point of view on where traditional machine learning, predictive modeling, generative AI, LLM-based systems, and other approaches are appropriate.
    • Establish principles for when Octave should build capabilities internally, leverage third-party platforms or models, or partner externally.
    • Balance near-term delivery with the foundational investments required to support Octave’s longer-term strategy.
  • Lead AI/ML and Data Science Technical Strategy
    • Establish the technical capabilities required to develop, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production AI and machine-learning systems.
    • Work with Product and business leaders to translate promising AI/ML opportunities into well-defined technical initiatives.
    • Ensure AI/ML initiatives are grounded in clear customer or business outcomes rather than pursued as standalone technology projects.
    • Guide technical experimentation and prototyping to validate opportunities before making significant investments.
    • Establish rigorous approaches to model and system evaluation, experimentation, observability, feedback loops, governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
    • Determine the Data Science, ML Engineering, and Applied AI capabilities Octave needs over time and develop an appropriate organizational model to support them.
  • Own and Evolve the Data Platform
    • Own the architecture and evolution of Octave’s centralized data platform and the systems that collect, transform, store, govern, and serve data across the company.
    • Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, observable, secure, and straightforward for downstream consumers to use.
    • Establish strong engineering practices around data quality, testing, lineage, documentation, monitoring, and reliability.
    • Build scalable interfaces and data products that enable analysts, Product, Engineering, and other teams to work effectively with trusted data.
    • Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions that balance scalability and technical quality with the speed required in a fast-growing company.
    • Avoid unnecessary complexity and ensure platform investments are justified by real customer, product, or business needs.
  • Enable a Decentralized Analytics Organization
    • Treat analysts embedded within Octave’s product and business organizations as key customers and partners of the Data Platform.
    • Partner with analysts and their leaders to understand common needs, remove technical bottlenecks, and improve access to reliable and well-modeled data.
    • Establish shared technical standards, platform capabilities, and ownership models that allow decentralized analytics teams to move quickly without creating unnecessary fragmentation.
    • Create clear ownership boundaries between the centralized Data Platform organization and embedded analytics teams.
    • Build foundational data capabilities that allow analysts to spend more time generating insights and less time solving recurring infrastructure or data-quality problems.
  • Build the Capabilities and Team Octave Needs
    • Lead, mentor, and develop the existing Data Platform team while remaining close to the technical work.
    • Continuously assess the technical capabilities required to execute Octave’s evolving data and AI strategy.
    • Develop existing team members where appropriate and recruit exceptional external talent when specialized skills or experience are missing internally.
    • Proactively identify capability gaps rather than scaling the organization through headcount alone.
    • Build additional specialized capabilities—including Data Science, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or other disciplines—as product and business needs warrant.
    • Determine when capabilities should live centrally, be embedded within Product or Engineering teams, or operate through another organizational model.
    • Develop strong technical leaders and individual contributors and create an environment characterized by high standards, ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and pragmatic execution.
    • Build an organization that can scale without introducing unnecessary layers or process.
  • Remain a Hands-On Technical Leader
    • Stay sufficiently close to the technology to provide credible technical leadership and make high-quality architecture and engineering decisions.
    • Dive into system design, architecture, data modeling, prototypes, code, technical evaluations, or production issues when your involvement can materially accelerate the team.
    • Personally engage with emerging AI/ML technologies enough to develop an informed point of view on their capabilities, limitations, and relevance to Octave.
    • Serve as a technical thought partner to Data Platform engineers, Product engineers, analysts, and senior company leadership.
    • Set a high technical bar while empowering the team to own execution.
    • Use technical depth to simplify problems and help the company avoid both underinvestment and unnecessary overengineering.

Required Skills:

  • Strong technical foundation and prior experience as a highly capable individual contributor before moving into leadership.
  • Strong understanding of traditional machine-learning and Data Science approaches and newer AI capabilities, including LLM-based systems and generative AI.
  • Strong judgment around build-versus-buy decisions and the ability to assess rapidly evolving technologies pragmatically.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to move fluidly between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior business and product leaders.
  • Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving organization where senior leaders remain close to execution.

Education & Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience building and leading data platform, data engineering, Data Science, ML, or AI capabilities in high-growth technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and building modern data platforms and production data systems.
  • Meaningful experience applying machine learning and/or AI to real-world product or business problems and taking solutions from experimentation into production.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product teams to identify and deliver technically sophisticated product capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose organizational capability gaps, build new technical capabilities, and recruit senior, specialized technical talent to fill them.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

  • We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.
  • People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.

25 € / Stunde · 20 Stunden / Woche · Möglicher Übergang in Festanstellung nach Studienabschluss · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen.

Als Werkstudent:in arbeitest du direkt an realen Mandaten mit: Du übernimmst statistische Auswertungen, unterstützt bei der Methodendiskussion, prüfst wissenschaftliche Texte und arbeitest dich Schritt für Schritt in eigenständige Klient:innen-Betreuung ein. Das ist keine Kaffeekoch-Werkstudi-Stelle, sondern echte fachliche Verantwortung mit Senior-Backup.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und mitdenkende Werkstudent:innen, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, lernen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen Verantwortung übernehmen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein typischer Werkstudi-Job nicht bietet: echte Mandate ab Tag 1, direkter Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung deiner Arbeit, und einen klaren Pfad in eine Festanstellung nach deinem Abschluss — wenn die Leistung stimmt.

Was du machst

  • Statistische Auswertungen in R, Python, SPSS und MAXQDA durchführen — unter Anleitung, mit wachsender Eigenständigkeit

  • Methodenteile in Dissertationen auf Korrektheit und Klarheit prüfen

  • Doktorand:innen einfache Methoden schriftlich und im Gespräch erklären

  • Senior-Berater:innen bei komplexeren Mandaten zuarbeiten

  • Eigene kleinere Mandate übernehmen, sobald du fachlich sicher bist

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools einsetzen, um Auswertungen effizienter zu machen

Was du mitbringst

  • Immatrikuliert in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar.

  • Bachelor ab dem 4. Semester oder im Master. Frühere Semester nur bei klarem Stats-Tutor-Track.

  • Mindestens 12 Monate verbleibende Studienzeit — wir investieren in dich, und das soll sich lohnen.

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast SPSS, R oder Python im letzten Semester konkret benutzt — aus Hausarbeiten, Tutorien, Werkstudent:innenjobs oder eigenen Projekten.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Übungsleiter:in, Studienkreis-Nachhilfelehrer:in, Hilfskraft am Lehrstuhl oder vergleichbar. Wer schon einmal jemandem Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig, fragst nach, wenn du nicht weiterkommst — bevor du Tage verlierst.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und mit Senior-Klient:innen schriftlich klar kommunizieren.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Karriere.

Tutor-/Nachhilfe-Track ist explizit erwünscht — wenn du bereits Studienkreis, Übungsleitung oder vergleichbar gemacht hast, schick uns das mit.

Was wir bieten

  • Vergütung: 25 € / Stunde — deutlich über dem üblichen Werkstudi-Niveau, weil wir Qualität bezahlen

  • Arbeitszeit: 20 Stunden / Woche, flexibel mit dem Studienplan vereinbar

  • Echte Aufgaben: Eigene Mandate, eigene Kund:innen, eigene Auswertungen — kein Hilfsarbeiter:innenkram

  • Mentoring: Persönliche Einarbeitung durch Senior-Berater:innen, Tool-Schulung, Methodendiskussion

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Übergangs-Option: Wer liefert, bekommt nach Studienabschluss ein Übernahmeangebot in Festanstellung

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Werkstudent:innen, die einen CV-Eintrag brauchen und Kaffeekochen aussitzen. Keine Studierenden, die nach Abschluss promovieren oder in der Wissenschaft bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und für den die Werkstudi-Stelle der erste Schritt in eine ernsthafte Karriere bei uns sein kann.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf, aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung und ein kurzes, persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du als Werkstudent:in bei uns arbeiten willst — und nicht in einem Konzern oder als Hilfskraft an der Uni.

  2. Was du nach deinem Studienabschluss konkret machen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

Job Description:

The Databricks Administrator will be responsible for the administration, configuration, optimization, and support of our Databricks platform. This role will work closely with data engineers, data scientists, analytics teams, and IT security to ensure a secure, reliable, and high-performing environment for data processing, machine learning, and analytics workloads.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

Platform Administration & Operations

  • Administer and maintain Databricks workspaces across development, test, and production environments.
  • Configure and manage clusters, pools, jobs, and workflows to support ETL, streaming, and ML workloads.
  • Monitor platform health, capacity, and performance; proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Manage Databricks runtime versions, libraries, and integrations with cloud storage and data services.
  • Implement and maintain backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures for Databricks assets.

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Configure and maintain identity and access management (IAM) roles, groups, and permissions in Databricks.
  • Implement and enforce security best practices, including encryption, network controls, and data access policies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Support implementation of data governance standards (e.g., Unity Catalog, catalogs, schemas, tables, and permissions).

Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Optimize cluster configurations, autoscaling, and job scheduling to balance performance and cost.
  • Analyze usage metrics and costs; implement strategies for cost control and chargeback/showback where applicable.
  • Recommend and implement platform tuning and optimization strategies for large-scale data workloads.

Collaboration & Support

  • Partner with data engineers, analysts, and data scientists to understand workload requirements and recommend best practices in Databricks usage.
  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for Databricks-related incidents and service requests.
  • Develop and maintain platform documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Conduct user onboarding, training, and knowledge-sharing sessions on Databricks capabilities and best practices.

Automation & DevOps

  • Automate workspace and cluster provisioning, configuration, and policy enforcement using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation).
  • Integrate Databricks with CI/CD pipelines for code deployment and environment management.
  • Support version control best practices for notebooks, jobs, and configuration.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
  • Alternative Path: If the candidate does not possess a relevant four-year degree, an additional four years of relevant work experience will be required.

Required Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience administering cloud-based data platforms or big data environments.
  • Hands-on administration experience with Databricks (Azure Databricks / AWS Databricks / GCP Databricks – specify as needed).
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, pools, and notebooks
    • Cloud storage (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage, S3, GCS) and networking concepts
    • Identity and access management in the relevant cloud provider (Azure AD / IAM / etc.)
  • Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash).
  • Familiarity with Spark concepts (clusters, executors, jobs, partitions) and performance considerations.
  • Demonstrated experience monitoring and troubleshooting platform performance and reliability issues.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to reliability and service quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Databricks certification(s) (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional, Lakehouse Fundamentals, Administrator).
  • Experience with:
    • Unity Catalog and fine-grained data access controls
    • CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)
    • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform strongly preferred)
    • Log aggregation and monitoring tools (Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Delta Lake, structured streaming, and data Lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience in enterprise environments with strong security and compliance needs.

Security Clearance Level:

  • This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.
  • This position has a U.S. residency requirement. The USPS security clearance process requires the selected candidate to have resided in the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for the last five years as follows: U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 6 months consecutively in the last 3 years (unless they meet certain exceptions). Non-U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 90 days consecutively in the last 3 years.

Claims Specialty Adjuster II

Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!

As a Claims Specialty Adjuster II, you will provide efficient and effective disposition of assigned claims through timely investigation, evaluation, and negotiation. This adjuster works well under limited supervision using company best practices. They must execute files within their authority to make appropriate decisions regarding coverage, settlement, and liability. The Specialty Adjuster II handles claims involving fire, theft, vandalism, specialty products, collision (1st and 3rd), shop damage, special investigations and various other comprehensive losses and a variety of complex claims. This position investigates coverage, evaluates, settles damages and effectively resolves claims to conclusion in a timely manner. In this role this adjuster is responsible for taking recorded statements, reviewing policies for coverage, settling claims including total losses, writing Reservation of Rights and Coverage disclaimer letters, when appropriate. The person in this role takes ownership of their personal brand, stays professional and works well individually and within a dynamic team atmosphere.

What you’ll do

  • Makes timely and appropriate contacts with necessary parties, determines, and completes appropriate level of investigation for coverage determination.
  • Determines exposure, establishes adequate initial reserves, and makes timely adjustment to reserve(s) as required.
  • Determines settlement value and negotiates proper settlement of claims within authority. Provides recommendations for settlement and disposition of claims exceeding authority level.
  • Works closely with the Special Investigation Unit (“SIU”) on claim investigations
  • Pursues subrogation when appropriate.
  • Handles first party auto property damage losses and occasionally third-party property damage losses.
  • Demonstrates strong negotiating skills
  • Controls expenses and expense reserves on storage, towing, appraisals, vendors, or legal counsel
  • Problem solves complaints or questions
  • Demonstrating technical learning and skill
  • Exemplifies strategic agility
  • Submit timely large loss reports and occasional Large Loss reporting

Authority/Accountability Level:

  • A Claims Specialty Adjuster II can analyze and determine exposure for fire, theft, vandalism, and a variety of complex claims of varying loss types. This person must exercise discretion to identify and resolve coverage issues, identify and investigate potential fraud, and settle losses as appropriate. A Claims Specialty Adjuster II will process approximately 500-700 lines annually and is responsible for reporting out to various departments within the business.

This Job Is Responsible for Producing the Following Results:

  • Maintaining stellar customer service tracked through company metrics
  • Handles claims for fire, vandalism, theft, complex coverage in personal lines and working in tandem with the SIU to complete thorough investigations in order to determine coverage, liability, and settlement
  • Meets or exceeds individual goals to help the department reach its targets
  • Making appropriate coverage and/or settlement decisions
  • Setting timely reserves
  • Consistently produces quality work product
  • Analyzes facts to justify the assistance of SIU, engineers, investigators, or legal counsel
  • Ability to take quality recorded statements from many parties
  • Identifies Red Flags
  • Ability to write accurate Reservation of Rights letters and Coverage declinations
  • Manages expenses
  • Pursues recovery as applicable
  • Fueling engagement within the team and department

This might describe you

  • Must be detail oriented and show a high level of accuracy
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledgeable in insurance products and expertise
  • Exercise decisiveness and execution within their authority
  • Must have ability to work individually and as a team
  • Ability to maintain confidential information
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong time management and organizational ability
  • Must possess a keen interest in self-development
  • Needs to be reliable, accountable, and trustworthy
  • Must be able to motivate and lead others
  • Demonstrate proficiencies with computer software & multitasking
  • Must maintain impeccable attendance
  • Must be licensed and bondable

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

jobs.description:
The location for this posting is in the APAC region.
We work in English, so excellent written and spoken English is essential.

Freelancing at Human Made

Join Human Made as a freelancer and you’ll feel like part of the team. You’ll be working on interesting and complex projects, alongside some of the industry's top talent. We’re fully remote, and have been for over 10 years, so you can expect well established ways of working, and a vibrant online culture.

Once you are qualified, you'll be added to our freelance talent pool and be invited to projects that suit your availability and expertise as soon as they become available, which might not be immediately. Once you are booked on a project, you will integrate as part of the team, so you are expected to join team meetings and activities (although we have a strong emphasis on asynchronous communication).

The Scrum Master Role at Human Made

As a Scrum Master you will create self-organising teams that are flexible and fully productive during sprints, with the goal of creating high performing teams. To do this you should be able to plan deliverables and help teams monitor their performance. You should have a thorough understanding of scrum/agile concepts, and can apply them through coaching and mentoring. You understand value, as it applies to the companies we work with and its alignment with our own priorities, and you are consistent in pursuing it.

Responsibilities:

These are the main areas of focus for a Scrum Master:

Applying Scrum To Produce High Quality Work

  • Manage each projects scope and timeline
  • Create and maintain a team culture that facilitates a shared responsibility for successful delivery
  • Guide team on principles and practice of the agile framework being used in the project
  • Work with team to help define and refine project scope, estimates, and resource requirements for projects
  • Prepare and facilitate workshops (either virtual or in-person) to establish project needs and relationships
  • Facilitate meetings to monitor project progress and resolve any issues the team may be experiencing
  • Remove impediments or guide the team to remove impediments
  • Assess the time and financial impact of scope change and communicate to stakeholders as appropriate
  • Identifies when to use experiments for learning and solutioning

Accountability To The Business

  • Be commercially aware: Understand the status of the budget of your projects and be able to report on them back to the company
  • Allocation management of project needs in conjunction with your squad composition

Building And Safeguarding Relationships

  • Facilitate wider engagement with internal and external stakeholders, and partners engaged in delivery
  • Build a partnership relationship with clients, understanding their business imperatives as context for helping align the team on those goals
  • Understand the workings and needs of the account you are partnered with
  • Communicate regularly; be proactive in facing difficult conversations
  • Manage your interactions with clients and internal team professionally, and personably
  • Using data to allow the team and wider business to make critical decisions

Striving For Great Work

  • Develop creative and technical judgement and strive for high quality output
  • Share progress and communicate to internal and external stakeholders
  • Conduct team reviews and retrospectives to promote continuous improvement
  • Endorse and present appropriate metrics to sustain continuous improvement to get the best out of each team. Report progress, team status, and issues across the board.

Requirements

  • Scrum Master certification or qualification, or equivalent work experience
  • Experience applying scrum, a wider awareness of agile principles, and a data driven mindset
  • Enterprise agency environment experience
  • Highly developed skills in servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency
  • Experience in using a wide range of project management tools such as, budget/time tracking tools and issue tracking software with the depth of knowledge to recommend the right tools for a project
  • Proficiency in written and oral communication in English, and ability to utilise and parse through technical terminology comfortably
  • An Interest in AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their appropriate use and limitations
  • Broad understanding of web technologies such as HTML/HTML5, CSS, CMS, Javascript, and version control

Benefits

Whether you are a freelancer, or a permanent member of the team, we want all Humans to have a fantastic experience, and benefit from Human Made’s people focused approach to work.

  • Gain experience working in an agency, without a long term commitment
  • Work alongside some of the WordPress industry’s top engineers
  • Access to Slack channels which will open up plenty of opportunities to network with other WordPress peers at Human Made
  • The opportunity to explore Human Made with the potential of becoming a full-time employee

Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by

1) providing the best services for homebuyers

2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance

3) to protect the whole home

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Senior Data Warehouse Engineer

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Data Warehouse Engineer with the Data team.

Porch Group is looking for a Senior Data Warehouse Engineer to join our data team as a key individual contributor. In this role, you will be responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining the data pipelines that power our business intelligence and reporting.

You aren't just writing code; you're ensuring our data reflects the complex realities of our SaaS and insurance operations. You will work closely with lead architects to implement scalable solutions and serve as a subject matter expert in SQL and database performance.

What You Will Do As A Senior Data Warehouse Engineer

  • Build and monitor robust ETL/ELT pipelines using BigQuery, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer.
  • Develop high-performance SQL scripts for complex data transformations, ensuring accuracy across multiple datasets.
  • Contribute to the design and refinement of data models (Star/Snowflake) to support evolving business requirements in the insurance and SaaS space.
  • Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in data pipelines, optimizing for both query speed and cloud cost-efficiency.
  • Partner with Data Analysts and stakeholders to translate business logic, such as churn rates or claims ratios, into technical specifications.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and maintain documentation to ensure the long-term health of the data warehouse.
  • Perform other data engineering related duties or projects, as assigned.

What You Will Bring As A Senior Data Warehouse Engineer

  • 5+ years of professional data engineering experience, specifically within cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Solid experience with the Google Cloud ecosystem, including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and IAM best practices.
  • Expert-level SQL proficiency, including comfort with window functions, recursive CTEs, and query plan analysis.
  • Strong grasp of indexing, partitioning, clustering, and data warehousing lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with metrics common to SaaS (MRR, Churn) or Insurance (Premiums, Claims, Actuarial data) is highly valued.
  • Detail-oriented, with pride in data integrity and clean code.
  • Collaborative, enjoys working as part of a high-functioning team, and comfortable contributing to shared goals.
  • Adaptable, able to pivot between building new features and troubleshooting legacy pipelines as business needs change.
  • Candidates that have worked in IT/Data for a United States based publicly owned company preferred.
  • Excellent written and communication skills in the English language.
  • Proven experience working with US based business teams.
  • Ability to work within core US business hours / time zone expectations - Eastern Standard Time (EST) overlap.
  • Working Hours: 8 Hours (Excluding breaks)
    4 Core US Hours Overlap (7:30pm- 11:30pm IST)
    4 flexible hours (IST)  
  • Workspace: A quiet, dedicated space to work, and a reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps.

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: ₹24,75,000 – ₹34,65,000 INR Annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing.

  • Our benefits include medical insurance, accident insurance and retiral benefits
  • Our wellness programs include 12 company-paid holidays, 2 flexible holidays, privilege/earned leave, casual/sick leave, paid maternity and paternity leaves, and weekly wellness events.

What’s next?

Submit your application below and our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:


As Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sustainable commercial growth across the region while protecting the premium positioning and long-term equity of ARC’TERYX. You will shape and execute the regional wholesale strategy, developing strategic partnerships with leading outdoor specialty, mountain, trail running and premium sporting goods retailers. You will have the opportunity to build and strengthen a high-performing regional sales organization while creating new structures, processes and commercial opportunities across diverse EMEA markets. Working across countries, channels and cultures, you will navigate the complexity of balancing ambitious growth objectives with disciplined distribution and exceptional brand presentation. This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in growing the ARC’TERYX footwear business and strengthening our credibility within the outdoor community through authentic retail partnerships, technical expertise and meaningful consumer experiences.
This role can be hired remote. Business operations occur on Central European Time (CET/CEST) and extensive travel throughout EMEA is required.

Meet Your Future Team:


The EMEA Wholesale team is responsible for building strong, long-term partnerships with our retail and distribution network while delivering sustainable commercial growth across the region. Working collaboratively across markets, functions and channels, the team is focused on strengthening our premium distribution, elevating the consumer experience and ensuring ARC’TERYX products are represented with authenticity and excellence.

If you were in the Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

  • Developing and executing the EMEA wholesale footwear strategy in alignment with global business objectives and regional market opportunities
  • Building and strengthening long-term partnerships with leading outdoor specialty retailers, mountain shops, trail running specialists, premium sporting goods retailers and selected omnichannel partners
  • Leading and developing regional sales representatives, Key Account Managers, Area Sales Managers, Technical Representatives and agencies to deliver a high-performance, partnership-led sales culture
  • Managing commercial planning across markets and strategic accounts, including annual agreements, Joint Business Plans, seasonal pre-orders, in-season replenishment and sell-through performance
  • Collaborating cross-functionally and across international markets to optimize assortments, forecasting, inventory productivity, merchandising standards and future collection strategies

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Delivering sustainable double-digit growth across priority EMEA markets while protecting premium distribution and long-term brand equity
  • Strengthening strategic relationships with leading specialty outdoor retailers and key distribution partners across the region
  • Increasing footwear sell-through through stronger assortment planning, retail activation, technical education and premium merchandising
  • Improving forecasting accuracy, inventory productivity and commercial visibility across EMEA
  • Developing multi-year business plans by region, country and strategic account to identify and unlock sustainable growth opportunities
  • Elevating ARC’TERYX footwear visibility and credibility within the outdoor community through strategic retail initiatives, athlete engagement, product testing, field clinics and authentic consumer experiences
  • Building a high-performance regional sales culture focused on consultative selling, collaboration, coaching and long-term partnership
  • Strengthening distribution and channel discipline to ensure every commercial decision contributes to the long-term value of the brand

Are you our next Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA?

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sports Management or a related field
  • You bring 8–10+ years of international sales experience, ideally within premium outdoor, technical footwear or a related premium sporting goods environment
  • You have a proven track record managing wholesale business across multiple EMEA markets
  • You have a strong network within the European outdoor footwear and specialty retail community
  • You have experience negotiating complex international commercial agreements and developing long-term strategic customer partnerships
  • You have demonstrated success in delivering profitable growth while protecting premium brand positioning and disciplined distribution
  • You have strong commercial, analytical and strategic planning capabilities, with the ability to translate market opportunities into actionable business plans
  • You are an experienced people leader and coach, capable of inspiring sales teams, agencies and cross-functional partners toward ambitious objectives
  • You are comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures and markets, balancing regional consistency with local market needs
  • You have experience using Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms and/or retail analytics tools
  • You are fluent in English, with German highly desirable; French, Italian or Spanish would be advantageous
  • You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions
  • You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity and a fast-evolving business environment
  • You effectively balance autonomy and collaboration while working across international markets
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking, continuous improvement and a high-performance sales culture
  • You seek the best solutions, with an unwavering commitment to leaving it better
  • Your passion for commercial excellence is matched by your passion for getting outside and maintaining genuine credibility within the outdoor community

    • This role requires approximately 50-70% international travel throughout EMEA, with a focus on Europe, as well as approximately four annual journeys to Vancouver for key company moments such as Kick Off and Leadership Summit. You will regularly engage with specialty retailers, distributors, outdoor events, athlete activations, mountain festivals and international trade shows, while participating in product testing, field clinics and outdoor experiences to maintain deep product and consumer credibility.

You’ll combine people leadership with technical and architectural guidance, helping your team deliver scalable, secure, high-performing systems. You’ll also help improve how the team operates, from engineering processes and capacity planning to technical decision-making and delivery.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: The Principal Database Engineer (DBE) is a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture, automation, performance, and operational excellence of NextGen's enterprise database platforms supporting cloud-first healthcare applications.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Principal Database Engineer (DBE) is a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture, automation, performance, and operational excellence of NextGen's enterprise database platforms supporting cloud-first healthcare applications. This role bridges deep database engineering with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to build highly available, scalable, secure, and observable data platforms across public cloud environments.
  • Define, architect, evolve and govern highly available, resilient, and secure enterprise database platforms across cloud environments (AWS, GCP).
  • Lead the reliability, performance, scalability, and lifecycle management of Microsoft SQL Server platforms while driving enterprise-wide migrations and modernization initiatives toward PostgreSQL and cloud-native database services.
  • Design and develop automated frameworks for database provisioning, patching, backup validation, failover testing, and routine maintenance using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management.
  • Partner with Platform Engineering to design and implement robust database release automation, CI/CD pipelines, schema versioning, and environment standardization.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to optimize database design, query performance, schema evolution, and deployment strategies for cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.
  • Establish comprehensive database observability standards, implementing telemetry, logging, proactive alerting, and performance analytics across all database environments.
  • Define and improve database reliability objectives, recovery strategies, and operational readiness practices.
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent corrective actions following major database production incidents, establishing post-mortem reviews to mitigate future risks.
  • Author enterprise engineering standards, reusable automation modules, and comprehensive technical documentation to reduce operational complexity and improve platform consistency.
  • Align database technology roadmaps with business goals in partnership with engineering leadership.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging databases and data-tier technologies to recommend architectural improvements that enhance long-term reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority for database architecture and cloud migrations, mentoring junior and mid-level engineers while influencing technical strategy across the engineering organization.
  • Support strategic cloud initiatives across AWS and Google Cloud while remaining cloud-provider agnostic wherever practical.
  • Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

  • 10+ years of experience designing, supporting, and managing enterprise relational database platforms in production, with extensive experience operating in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices.
  • Experience participating in incident response, root cause analysis, SRE initiatives, and implementing database DevOps practices like schema versioning and release automation.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, influencing enterprise technical standards, and driving legacy database migrations (such as SQL Server) to cloud-native or open-source platforms.
  • Experience supporting cloud-native applications, Kubernetes, or containerized workloads, ideally within SaaS, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries (preferred).

License/Certification Required:

  • Microsoft SQL Server certification or equivalent experience.
  • AWS or Google Cloud Professional certification (preferred).
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent containerization certification (preferred).
  • Terraform Associate or equivalent Infrastructure as Code certification (preferred).
  • ITIL Foundation or SRE-related certifications (preferred).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of: Expert-level Microsoft SQL Server administration, engine internals, high availability/disaster recovery (HADR) strategies, and performance engineering. PostgreSQL or other enterprise relational database platforms, including database design, query optimization, and modernization pathways. Public cloud architectures (AWS/GCP), containerized environments (Kubernetes), and modern infrastructure automation principles. Observability and monitoring frameworks, including tools like Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry (preferred).
  • Skill in: Advanced scripting and programming using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent languages to eliminate manual operational toil through automation. Database performance engineering, advanced SQL query tuning, and deep troubleshooting of distributed data systems. Influencing and presenting technical strategies and architectures to both technical teams and executive-level leadership.
  • Ability to: Influence technical strategy and translate complex technical concepts into actionable architectures across multi-disciplinary engineering organizations. Balance urgent operational support and platform maintenance with strategic, forward-looking engineering innovation. Communicate complex technical designs clearly and author comprehensive technical standards and documentation. Act as a cultural catalyst for DevOps and SRE adoption within the broader database engineering community.

jobs.title: Working Student (m/f/d): Legal Research & Platform Implementation
jobs.excerpt: Europe's private markets manage trillions in assets, yet much of the work behind them still runs on manual processes, spreadsheets, and fragmented legacy systems.
jobs.description:
Europe's private markets manage trillions in assets, yet much of the work behind them still runs on manual processes, spreadsheets, and fragmented legacy systems. Investor onboarding, KYC/AML checks, subscriptions, and closings can take weeks and tie up lawyers, fund administrators, and compliance teams.

Vestlane is changing that. We build the KYC/AML and onboarding platform for funds and asset managers: one system that takes investors from first contact to closing, with screening, risk scoring, and monitoring built in and audit-ready by default. Fund managers get a faster, fully digital process; their investors get an experience that finally matches the quality of the funds they invest in.

Since 2021, we have onboarded 12,000+ investors & assets from around the world into 600+ funds, working with leading European and international fund managers. Our team combines lawyers, engineers, and compliance experts, and we work in small, senior teams with real ownership and short decision paths. If you want to shape how an entire industry handles compliance rather than maintain the status quo, you'll fit in here.

Tasks

In this role, you work at the intersection of fund law, legal research, client implementation, and legal engineering. Your analysis doesn't end in a memo: you turn it into digital workflows that run in live fund closings and investor onboardings.

  • Research and assess legal questions in the fund space: analyze limited partnership agreements (LPAs), subscription documents, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, including Germany, Luxembourg, the UK, and many more.
  • Work directly with fund managers, law firms, and fund administrators to understand their existing legal and compliance processes and translate them into scalable, standardized workflows on Vestlane.
  • Implement subscription documents on our platform: build them into legally sound, production-ready digital workflows with form logic, field mapping, and e-signature integration (DocuSign).
  • Support client implementations from the first document review to go-live, and take on more responsibility for your own projects as you grow into the role.
  • Feed what you learn back into our product: spot recurring legal and regulatory requirements across clients and jurisdictions and share them with our Product and Engineering teams.
  • Work closely with our Legal & Compliance team, who provide subject-matter guidance, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our legal-tech processes, templates, and documentation.

Requirements

  • You are studying law (ideally from the fourth semester onwards) with an interest in corporate, business, or capital markets law, or you have already completed your degree. Students of business law (LL.B./LL.M.) and legal trainees (Referendar:innen) looking for a part-time role are equally welcome.
  • You enjoy working through complex legal questions, but you are just as interested in what happens after the analysis: how requirements are implemented in practice and turned into efficient, repeatable processes.
  • You work in a structured, detail-oriented way. Getting a document exactly right matters to you, because it will run in real fund closings.
  • You are curious about technology and want to get hands-on with digital tools and processes. You don't need to be a developer, but you enjoy figuring out how things work.
  • You communicate confidently in German and English, in writing and with clients.

Nice to have, not required:

  • First exposure to fund law, fund structures, or investor onboarding, for example through a seminar, internship, or a position at a law firm or fund administrator.

Benefits

  • 20 hours per week, flexibly scheduled around lectures and exam periods
  • Remote-first, preferably located in the Cologne/Bonn area
  • Full equipment for working from wherever you are
  • Structured onboarding and a fixed mentor in the Legal & Compliance team
  • Real client projects and live fund closings from an early stage
  • Fund law across multiple jurisdictions and legal-tech tooling you won't find in a law firm
  • Clear career path support after your studies

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. A CV is enough, no cover letter needed. We review every application personally and get back to you within two weeks. After that, the process is one short step: a 45-minute call where we get to know each other, talk about your experience so far, and answer everything you want to know about the role.

Questions before applying? Reach out to us directly, we're happy to help.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter who enjoys working independently, has strong business acumen, and possesses the drive to grow an established territory while identifying new opportunities within municipal, transit, paratransit, healthcare, and commercial transportation markets.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As the Regional Sales Manager, you will:

  • Develop and execute territory sales strategies to achieve unit sales, revenue, margin, and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Generate leads and actively prospect for new business opportunities throughout Ontario.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with municipal, government, transit, paratransit, healthcare, and commercial transportation customers.
