  • Attend industry trade shows, conferences, networking events, and customer functions to promote Crestline products and services.
  • Achieve customer satisfaction goals and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.
  • Provide regular sales forecasts, territory updates, and market intelligence to leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

As the Regional Sales Manager, you will bring:

  • Minimum 3-5 years of sales experience, preferably selling capital equipment or complex business-to-business solutions.
  • Experience selling to municipalities, government organizations, transit agencies, healthcare organizations, or public-sector customers is considered a strong asset.
  • Demonstrated success in business development, prospecting, and territory growth.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Post-secondary education in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field is preferred.
  • Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

  • Strong prospecting and lead-generation abilities.
  • Experience managing long sales cycles and complex customer relationships.
  • Familiarity with municipal procurement processes, tenders, and RFPs is considered an asset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or similar systems.
  • Familiarity with quoting and proposal management software is considered an asset.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects and manage competing deadlines.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Customer-focused with a passion for building long-term relationships.
  • Self-motivated and highly driven to achieve results.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong business acumen and professional presence.
  • High emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborative team player who enjoys working cross-functionally.
  • Adaptable, resilient, and proactive.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • Valid passport and ability to travel within Canada and the United States.
  • Ability to travel throughout Ontario approximately two weeks per month.

WHY CHOOSE CRESTLINE COACH?

Crestline Coach takes pride in a strong company culture that embodies excellence, integrity, trust and innovation. To foster a strong culture, we believe in a progressive, dynamic and solution-based environment and want to prosper amongst the best and brightest in the country. Benefits of working with Crestline Coach include: ◦ A competitive salary with bonus earning potential including a recruitment referral bonus. ◦ Health benefits including dental, extended health care, long and short-term disability coverage, accident and serious illness insurance, life insurance, and a health spending account. ◦ A group registered retirement savings plan that has a 4% matching, occupational vision care, employee, and family assistance programs along with a virtual walk-in clinic that provides unlimited healthcare for you and your family. ◦ Milestone and service awards at five-year increments. ◦ Access to CUBBI, a discounted food delivery service of fresh meals from local kitchens, and Sutton Smart Perks Discounts for services and discounts from local businesses. ◦ Career path and career longevity support by approved professional development opportunities and cost reimbursement, including association memberships.

Crestline Coach Ltd. is committed to fair and inclusive hiring. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and supported. Accommodations are available upon request during any stage of the recruitment process.

At NV5 Digital, we help architects, engineers, and building owners make better decisions through reliable digital information. We do that by putting people on client accounts who actually know the work — not just the software.

Are you the go-to Revit expert in your office? Do your colleagues come to you when they're stuck on a workflow, a family, or a model that isn't behaving? We look for people who bring that understanding, whether from years in practice, in-house BIM leadership, or hands-on consulting experience.

Clients get the benefit of the whole team's experience, and you have real backup when things get complicated. What you bring to your accounts matters; so does the team around you.

Remote, work from home. 5-day, 40-hour work week with some flexibility on working hours. Candidates can be based anywhere in the US.

We work daily in Revit, ACC/Forma, Navisworks, Dynamo, and related platforms.

  • Work as part of a team serving assigned BIM Management clients — responsive, consistent, and proactive

  • Proficiency with ACC/Forma — setup, administration, and user enablement
  • Experience delivering training or technical guidance to peers or client teams
  • 2- or 4-year degree in architecture, engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered

SKILLS & WORK STYLE

  • You are organized and reliable — clients and teammates know they can count on you
  • You manage your own time and workload without needing someone to check in on you
  • You communicate clearly and consistently, both in writing and one-on-one

About Us

Qualio is a unified quality and compliance management platform that helps regulated organizations get products to market faster with reduced risk. Trusted by biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics companies worldwide, Qualio eliminates fragmented systems that create audit delays and compliance blind spots. Our platform enables audit readiness in weeks through multi-standard automated gap analysis and evidence reuse across ISO and FDA requirements. Qualio is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 27701 certified, reflecting our commitment to security, quality, and privacy.

The Qualio team is all-remote, and currently distributed across North America, Europe and Australia.

Who are we?

At Qualio, the engineering department is responsible for the "what" and the "how". "What" as in what should we build for our customers. "How" as in how do we delivery and operate the solution.

We are working on building a platform team providing horizontal services to vertical feature centric product teams to deliver on Qualio's brand promise - "An easy, scalable and trusted QMS".

How do we work?

We are designing our teams to own specific horizontal areas of our application. Teams are made up of a Product manager (PM), Engineering team lead and a team of engineers. Owning the area of application means everything, collaborating with product managers, customer success partners, architecture, peer engineering teams to deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to our customers.

As Werner Vogels says, "You build it, you run it".

What do we value?

In order to make this a reality we value a number of things:

  • Iterative development - Solutions are delivered as a collection of small pieces. No big bangs.
  • Test driven development
  • Clean code
  • Automation in all its forms - tests, infrastructure, build and deploy - everything
  • "Done" means it's in the hands of customers

What’s the opportunity?

As Qualio continues to grow, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join one of our platform teams. We have a new feature area that is growing beyond an MVP.

We are predominantly a Python shop, but we also use Node.js, TypeScript, React, AngularJS, REST APIs and host our cloud software in AWS, but we’re open to developers who have expertise in different languages as long as you're open to learning!

What will I be doing?

  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset
  • Partner with team in designing, implementing and delivering effective cloud based solutions - evidenced by timeliness, quality, usability, operational stability, performance, and success of meeting customer requirements/business objectives
  • Ability to maintain a proactive and positive attitude in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • You like the sound of working for a fully remote-based organization with lots of opportunities

What skills do I need?

  • You have 3+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Utilize programming languages like Python, Node.js, RDBMS and NoSQL databases.
  • Well-versed with AWS Cloud based services such as ECS, Lambda, EC2, and related technologies e.g. ELB, API Gateway, Security groups, VPCs, etc
  • Well-versed with OpenSearch
  • You can code, conduct reviews on architecture and code along with other team members to build effective software
  • Apply engineering best practices in TDD, clean code, CI/CD to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support product solutions
  • Experience with Agile methodologies/DevSecOps environment
  • Breadth and depth of experience in areas like application platforms, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, data management, and infrastructure as code
  • Actively use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate your work, whether writing code, debugging, or prototyping, and you have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't in an engineering context.

Benefits

In addition to playing an important role in building Qualio, you'll receive:

  • Competitive salary
  • Flexible holidays
  • Flexible time off policy
  • Professional development stipend
  • Working space allowance / home office budget
  • Opportunity to make a difference through helping life-saving products to get to market

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every single one of the qualifications as described in a job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive company and we are most interested in finding the BEST candidate for the job. That candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background, and that’s okay. We would strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of the qualifications described.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned communications strategist who thrives in high-visibility, fast-paced federal environments and brings a disciplined, audience-first approach to translating complex program information into compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders. You are equally comfortable advising senior executives, drafting Capitol Hill briefing packages, and building the coalition relationships necessary to sustain long-term transformation initiatives.

About Tiberius Aerospace

Tiberius Aerospace is a cutting-edge Aerospace and Defense company committed to delivering innovative, secure, and compliant solutions for our customers. We specialize in mission-critical technology services for government and private sector customers, ensuring excellence in aerospace systems design, performance, and compliance. To serve our nations with Strength, Honor, and Purpose - forging the systems that defend freedom and shape the future of defense.

Position Overview

Tiberius is seeking an experienced Capture Manager to lead the pursuit of strategic opportunities across the Department of Defense and Intelligence Community, from early identification through contract award.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives before the RFP drops building customer relationships, shaping requirements, running competitive intelligence, and assembling the win strategy that turns an early lead into a program of record. The Capture Manager will work closely with the cofounders, business development, engineering, and program teams to convert Tiberius's technical capability into funded, winnable pursuits.

The ideal candidate has run capture campaigns inside DoD or IC acquisition environments, understands how programs of record actually get built, and can operate with the pace and informality of a startup while speaking fluently to program offices, primes, and government stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Own capture strategy and execution for strategic pursuits across DoD and IC customers, from early qualification through award

  • Identify, qualify, and prioritize opportunities aligned with Tiberius's programs and technical roadmap, including bid/no-bid recommendations to leadership

  • Build and execute capture plans: customer engagement strategy, win themes, competitive positioning, teaming approach, and price-to-win input

  • Build and maintain relationships with program office, requirements, and acquisition stakeholders ahead of formal solicitations

  • Run competitive intelligence track incumbents, likely competitors, past performance, and pricing patterns to shape a winning position

  • Identify and negotiate teaming relationships with primes, subcontractors, and industry partners where capability gaps exist

  • Partner with engineering and program teams to translate customer requirements into a compelling, technically credible solution

  • Support proposal development: shape win themes, review compliance, and contribute to proposal sections as needed

  • Track and report pursuit status, pipeline, and capture milestones through the CRM, in partnership with the RevOps Manager

  • Represent Tiberius at industry days, technical forums, and customer engagements

Capture Process & Competitive Strategy

  • Lead gate reviews (qualify, pursue, propose, submit) with clear go/no-go criteria and executive sign-off

  • Develop win themes and discriminators grounded in Tiberius's actual technical differentiation, not generic value props

  • Coordinate black-hat and competitive assessment sessions ahead of major pursuits

  • Maintain a live capture pipeline with accurate stage, value, probability, and next-action data

  • Work with contracts and finance on pricing strategy and cost-realism for major pursuits

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of capture management experience in DoD or IC acquisition environments

  • Demonstrated track record of shaping and winning defense programs, from early-stage pursuits through program of record

  • Strong understanding of DoD/IC acquisition pathways: FAR/DFARS, OTAs, SBIR/STTR, MTA, IDIQ, and program-of-record transitions

  • Experience building and negotiating teaming agreements with primes, subs, and industry partners

  • Excellent relationship-building skills across government, industry, and internal technical stakeholders

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior government and executive audiences

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment with minimal structure, building process as you go

Preferred

  • Prior military service or direct experience supporting a DoD or IC program office

  • Active or recent TS/SCI clearance, or eligibility to obtain one

  • Experience capturing opportunities in fires, precision munitions, autonomy, or related weapons-systems domains

  • APMP Capture Practitioner Certification or equivalent

  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth defense-tech company, not only a traditional prime

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM for pipeline tracking

What We're Looking For

  • A relationship-first operator who builds trust with program offices long before an RFP exists

  • Someone who can hold both the big picture (program-of-record strategy) and the granular (teaming agreements, pricing input, proposal compliance)

  • A collaborative leader who can pull engineering, program, and executive stakeholders into a single pursuit without needing formal authority to do it

  • Comfortable being the first Capture Manager in the building

jobs.description:
Overview

The Proposal Manager will lead the development and coordination of client-facing responses, including RFPs, RFIs, client questionnaires, and related projects. This role is responsible for managing proposal timelines, organizing requirements, identifying content gaps, coordinating input from SMEs, and producing clear, client-focused content.

This position requires a proposal professional who can manage active pursuits with limited direction but with the support of a team. The ideal candidate can think strategically about client needs, ask effective follow-up questions, recognize weak or incomplete content, and escalate issues to internal SMEs. Strong writing judgment, project ownership, collaborative confidence, and the ability to translate complex business information into polished proposal content are essential.

In addition to active proposal support, the Proposal Manager will support content governance initiatives. This includes maintaining reusable content in Responsive, supporting post-submission audits, improving library accuracy, reducing outdated or duplicative/trivial (ROT) records, strengthening AI-assisted proposal workflows, and creating reusable sales assets that improve future response quality and speed.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned RFPs, RFIs, client questionnaires, and related proposal projects from intake through submission.
  • Review client requirements, instructions, scoring criteria, attachments, portals, and deadlines to create a clear work plan.
  • Build proposal schedules, track action items, manage deadlines, and follow up with internal contributors.
  • Develop first-draft proposal responses using approved content, prior submissions, the proposal library, and other approved sources.
  • Write, revise, and tailor proposal content for clarity, compliance, client relevance,

tone, and strategic positioning.

  • Identify gaps in proposal responses and determine what information is needed from SMEs.
  • Coordinate SME input: prepare clear requests, follow up, and help translate SME feedback into client-ready content.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to align proposal content with solution strategy, client needs, value proposition, and pursuit priorities.
  • Support proposal compliance by checking that responses address client questions directly and follow required formats.
  • Manage attachments, exhibits, certifications, supplemental documents, and other supporting materials required for proposals with the support of the broader team.
  • Use proposal automation and AI tools responsibly to accelerate drafting, improve consistency, and standardize content while validating accuracy against approved sources.
  • Support post-submission audits to identify new, updated, or improved content that should be captured for future reuse.
  • Maintain and improve the proposal content library, including standard answers, boilerplate content, case examples, location information, solution descriptions, and reusable proposal language.
  • Help reduce redundant, outdated, and trivial (ROT) content through identification and removal or re-writes.
  • Support tagging, categorization, and content lifecycle processes in the proposal library.
  • Coordinate SME review cycles for high-use, high-risk, or frequently changing content.
  • Support broader organizational initiatives when proposal content, sales messaging, or internal knowledge assets are needed.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with Sales, Account Management, SMEs, Compliance, Marketing, Operations, and leadership.
  • Track proposal status, open items, risks, and blockers, escalating when deadlines, missing content, or quality concerns require leadership attention.
  • Contribute to process improvements that improve proposal quality, reduce rework, increase content reuse, and improve responsiveness.

Qualifications

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience managing RFPs, RFIs, client questionnaires, sales proposals, or complex business responses in a B2B or BPO environment.
  • Strong proposal writing, business writing, editing, and content development skills.
  • Ability to translate technical, operational, compliance, and service delivery information into clear, client-facing language.
  • Strong project management skills, including deadline management, task tracking, stakeholder follow-up, and prioritization.
  • Confidence working with SMEs and senior stakeholders, including the ability to ask direct questions, clarify incomplete answers, and follow up in a professional manner.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around compliance, formatting, response accuracy, submission requirements, and content organization.
  • Ability to manage multiple proposal deadlines and competing priorities during high volume seasons.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Understanding of content governance, maintenance, and updating.
  • Experience with proposal platforms such as Responsive, Loopio, Qvidian, or similar tools preferred.
  • Experience using AI tools for drafting, summarization, rewriting, and content standardization preferred.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to understand client needs, value propositions, and solution strategy preferred.
  • Experience supporting sales teams, account management teams, marketing teams, or revenue organizations preferred.
  • Experience in BPO, contact center, customer experience, revenue operations, outsourcing, or other complex service industries preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Technical Writing, or related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with Canva or similar tools helpful but not required.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewPosition Overview:HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market.
jobs.description:
Overview

Position Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

The Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead owns the business-facing capability that turns operational data into trusted, actionable decisions across HealthEdge. This is an enterprise capability, not a reporting function: the role sets the agenda for what gets measured, what gets automated, and how the business and Technology work together to deliver it.

The person in this role operates as a strategic partner to Operations, Product, and Technology leadership — translating business priorities into data and automation requirements, and shaping HealthEdge's data strategy from the operational vantage point. The role does not own the underlying data platform, architecture, or engineering; that ownership sits with the Data & Analytics Platform team in Technology. The Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead owns the demand side of the equation: priorities, requirements, and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set enterprise priorities for operational reporting and dashboards, ensuring the business consistently has trusted, decision-ready information.
  • Lead business intelligence and analytics efforts that surface insight — not just data — for Operations, Product, and executive stakeholders.
  • Identify and drive business process automation opportunities, including applying AI where it measurably improves speed, accuracy, or cost.
  • Translate business needs into clear data and technology requirements that the Platform team and other Technology partners can build against.
  • Influence HealthEdge's long-term data strategy by bringing operational priorities and real-world business context into platform and architecture planning.
  • Act as the primary business-side partner to the Data & Analytics Platform team, Product, and Technology — owning requirements definition, prioritization, and business validation of delivered solutions.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized roadmap of reporting, analytics, and automation initiatives based on operational impact.
  • Represent the voice of the business in Technology governance and planning forums where data and automation investment decisions are made.

Ownership & Partnership Boundaries:

This capability is deliberately split to keep accountability clear as it scales:

  • Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead owns: reporting and automation priorities, business requirements, opportunity identification, business-side data strategy input, and partnership with Product and Technology to validate that delivered solutions meet business needs.
  • Data & Analytics Platform team (Technology) owns: the underlying data platform, architecture, engineering, and technical roadmap.

Neither side substitutes for the other. The Platform team is not accountable for deciding what the business should measure or automate next; the Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead is not accountable for how the platform is engineered. The two roles are expected to operate as tightly coupled partners with distinct, non-overlapping accountability.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Operations, Product, and Technology leaders treat this role as the natural first call for "what should we be measuring or automating next."
  • Reporting and automation priorities are demonstrably tied to operational decisions and outcomes, not just delivered dashboards or scripts.
  • Business requirements handed to the Platform team are clear enough to build against with minimal rework.
  • The role has a visible seat at data strategy planning conversations, with operational priorities reflected in the resulting roadmap.

Required Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, analytics, or business process transformation, including significant time operating at an enterprise or cross-functional scope.
  • Demonstrated track record of setting data and automation priorities at an organizational level, not just executing against requirements set by others.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous, cross-functional business problems into clear, buildable data and automation requirements.
  • Experience operating as a senior peer to a Technology or Data Platform organization — shaping data strategy and priorities without owning engineering or architecture directly.
  • Strong record of identifying and delivering business process automation at scale, including applying AI/ML in operational contexts.
  • Executive-level communication and influence skills; credible setting and defending priorities directly with Operations, Product, and Technology leadership.
  • Healthcare technology, SaaS, or BPaaS industry experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience standing up or scaling an enterprise BI/analytics function from a business-owned (rather than Technology-owned) position.
  • Familiarity with modern data platform concepts (cloud data warehousing, self-service BI tooling, workflow automation platforms) sufficient to write strong requirements, without engineering-level depth.
  • Experience operating in a post-merger or integration environment where operating models and ownership boundaries are still being established.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $205,000 to $222,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

Role Overview:

Responsible for leading the organization's data and analytics function by developing, maintaining, and governing enterprise data platforms, reporting solutions, and business intelligence capabilities that support strategic, operational, financial, and clinical decision-making. This role oversees data architecture, data engineering, analytics, reporting, data governance, and privacy practices to ensure the availability, integrity, security, and effective use of organizational data assets. The position partners closely with business, clinical, and executive leaders to translate data into actionable insights, establish trusted performance metrics, and drive a culture of data-informed decision-making. Additionally, this role provides leadership and development for data and analytics teams, manages vendor relationships and technology investments, and ensures compliance with healthcare data standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational objectives.

Essential Duties:

  • Lead Data Platform Strategy and Operations: Oversee the organization's data warehouse/lakehouse environment, ensuring scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data architecture and operations.
  • Manage Enterprise Data Integration: Direct the development and maintenance of data pipelines and integrations across clinical, operational, financial, human resources, and external data sources.
  • Establish Data Modeling and Analytics Standards: Develop and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and standardized metric definitions to ensure consistency and reusability across reporting and analytics.
  • Oversee Data Engineering Practices: Establish standards for development, testing, deployment, version control, code review, and platform governance to ensure quality and reliability.
  • Monitor Data Platform Performance and Reliability: Ensure data pipeline health, system performance, data freshness, and issue resolution through proactive monitoring and continuous improvement practices.
  • Lead Business Intelligence and Reporting Functions: Oversee the development and delivery of executive dashboards, operational reporting, and enterprise analytics solutions that support organizational decision-making.
  • Manage Enterprise Metrics and Reporting Governance:Maintain a catalog of key performance indicators, business definitions, data lineage, and reporting ownership to support consistent and trusted reporting.
  • Partner with Business and Clinical Leaders: Collaborate with operational, clinical, financial, quality, revenue cycle, and human resources leaders to translate business needs into actionable data, analytics, and reporting solutions.
  • Support Regulatory, Quality, and External Reporting Requirements: Ensure the availability, accuracy, and timely delivery of reporting required for regulatory programs, payer reporting, quality initiatives, and governing board oversight.
  • Establish and Maintain Data Governance and Privacy Controls: Implement data governance practices that support data quality, security, privacy, role-based access, data lineage, and compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure Data Quality and Stewardship: Oversee data quality monitoring, issue resolution processes, and system-of-record management to improve the integrity and usability of enterprise data assets.
  • Lead and Develop Data and Analytics Teams:Recruit, develop, coach, and retain data engineering and business intelligence professionals while fostering accountability, collaboration, cross-training, and continuous learning.
  • Manage Analytics Portfolio, Prioritization, and Delivery: Establish intake, prioritization, and resource management processes that align data and analytics initiatives with organizational priorities and business value.
  • Oversee Vendor, Financial, and Strategic Data Initiatives: Manage vendor relationships, technology investments, licensing, budgets, and participation in system selection and implementation efforts to ensure long-term data and analytics success.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, health informatics, or a related field or equivalent work experience
  • 8+ years experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including 10+ years directly managing technical staff
  • Advanced SQL and demonstrated ownership of a production data warehouse or Lakehouse
  • Hands-on experience with a modern transformation or orchestration stack, for example dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or comparable tools
  • Production experience with an enterprise BI platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Qlik, including governance and workspace administration
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to analytic data
  • Track record of delivering reporting that changed an operational or financial outcome, not only dashboards that were shipped

Licenses and Certifications:

  • Valid Colorado driver’s license or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire and a clean driving record required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Healthcare experience with EHR reporting data, for example Epic Clarity and Caboodle, Oracle Health, Meditech, or athenahealth

  • Experience with quality and value-based care reporting, including HEDIS, MIPS, or CMS star ratings

We’re looking for a skilled and adaptable Full-stack Software Engineer who takes an AI-first approach to software development, using tools such as Claude Code and Codex to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering standards. We value hands-on experimentation, short feedback loops and the judgment to know when to change direction or turn a promising prototype into reliable software. You’ll also build integrations with our products and third-party platforms, adding LLMs and other AI capabilities where they solve a real user need.   • Strong technical, analytical, and communication skills, written and verbal.

Bonus Points For:

Job Requisition ID: 94664

Location Designation: Hybrid - 3 days per quarter

Business Unit

Technology, Data, AI and Ventures (TDAV)

Business Unit Overview

Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world-class financial services company competes in the AI era — all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last.

Role Overview

As part of Technology, Data, AI and Ventures (TDAV), you will help shape New York Life's cloud platform strategy by designing, building, and operating secure, scalable, and highly automated AWS cloud platforms that enable enterprise application development and digital innovation. As a Senior Associate, Cloud Platform Engineer, you will leverage cloud engineering, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices to deliver resilient cloud services that improve developer productivity and operational excellence.

Working closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, Application Development, and Operations teams, you will develop reusable infrastructure, automate cloud operations, strengthen platform reliability, and integrate security and compliance into cloud-native services. This individual contributor role requires strong technical expertise, a collaborative mindset, and a passion for building cloud platforms that are secure, observable, resilient, and engineered for scale.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, automate, and continuously improve secure, scalable, and highly available AWS cloud platforms using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), cloud-native services, and automation to deliver consistent, repeatable infrastructure provisioning.

  • Develop reusable platform capabilities, automation, and engineering tools using Python, Go, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines to streamline cloud operations, reduce manual effort, and enable application teams to consume infrastructure through standardized self-service patterns.

  • Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to improve platform availability, scalability, observability, and operational resilience by implementing monitoring, alerting, logging, service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), automated remediation, and incident response processes.

  • Design, implement, and operate Kubernetes and Amazon EKS environments while partnering with Security and Architecture teams to embed cloud security controls, policy-as-code, compliance validation, IAM, and governance into cloud platform services and infrastructure delivery pipelines.

  • Collaborate across Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, Product, and Application Development teams to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, support production environments, evaluate emerging technologies, and continuously improve cloud platform capabilities through automation, technical standards, and engineering best practices.

What You'll Bring

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience) with 5+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting AWS cloud infrastructure and platform services.

  • Strong experience with AWS, Terraform, Terraform Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud infrastructure automation, and Git-based DevOps and CI/CD practices.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or similar technologies with experience developing automation, APIs, platform tooling, and reusable infrastructure solutions.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting cloud-native platforms with knowledge of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, cloud security, infrastructure reliability, software engineering principles, and production operations.

  • Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), monitoring, observability, incident management, root cause analysis, disaster recovery, and operational excellence, with the ability to troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to partner effectively across cloud engineering, application development, architecture, infrastructure, operations, and cybersecurity teams while continuously learning new technologies and cloud services.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AWS services including Lambda, S3, EventBridge, IAM, CloudWatch, EC2, VPC, Amazon EKS, and other cloud-native platform capabilities.

  • Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, cloud platform frameworks, policy-as-code, compliance automation, and infrastructure governance solutions.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or CloudWatch, and modern CI/CD platforms including GitHub, Jenkins, Harness, or Azure DevOps.

  • AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps Administrator, or AWS Certified Developer, along with experience supporting highly available, resilient, cloud-native architectures.

As a React Frontend Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing user interface components using React.js and workflows (such as Flux or Redux). You will ensure that these components and the overall application are robust and easy to maintain, ensuring a seamless user experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Development and Design: Develop new user-facing features using React.js. Build reusable components and front-end libraries for future use. Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality code.

Performance Optimization: Optimize components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers.

Collaboration: Collaborate with product team and back-end developers for defining and implementing innovative solutions for the product direction, visuals, and user experience.

Testing and Debugging: Write and maintain test cases to ensure the robustness and reliability of the code. Debug and fix issues reported in the production environment.

Maintenance and Upgrades: Keep up-to-date with the latest React.js trends and industry best practices.

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Experience: At least 5-6 years of experience in React.js development. Experience with popular React.js workflows (such as Flux or Redux) is a must.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript, including DOM manipulation and the JavaScript object model. Familiarity with newer specifications of ECMAScript. Experience with data structure libraries.

Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving skills, a keen eye for detail, and a team-oriented mindset. Excellent communication skills for coordinating with other teams.

Other: Familiarity with RESTful APIs, modern front-end build pipelines and tools, code versioning tools such as Git.

Travel Insured International is a leading travel insurance provider with more than 30 years in business. As a key component of our Specialty Business Unit, within the Accident & Health division, TII provides travel protection plans to help each individual travel confidently. Travel Insured International is proud to offer products to consumers and to agency partners of all sizes. We're committed to providing dependable coverage, great value, and end-to-end satisfaction for all customers.

Job Description

The Director, Business Development & Key Accounts, plays a crucial role in driving new business growth and increasing market share for Travel Insured International within the travel agency distribution channel across both consortia and non-consortia segments.

The Director, Business Development & Key Accounts has two main areas of focus: Opening New Business Accounts and Managing & Growing Top Accounts. This includes opening new accounts both for personal production and to feed the field team (Regional Business Development Managers/BDM’s), fueling the overall growth pipeline and expanding TII's market share.

The Director, Business Development & Key Accounts, will also serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of assigned top accounts, with full responsibility for growing that book of business and increasing market share. This is one of two Director, Business Development & Key Accounts positions on the team, each managing a separate portfolio of accounts. This is an individual contributor role within the Travel Business Center.

This is a 100% remote position with regular travel required.

  • Open and activate new business accounts for personal production and transition appropriate accounts to Regional BDMs for ongoing management, maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities.

  • Create and deliver tailored presentations, proposals, co-op programs, and bonus override structures that drive measurable partner growth, activation, conversion, retention, and ROI.

  • Collaborative Leadership & Mentorship — The ability to work cross-functionally with underwriting, claims, and other internal teams while mentoring and guiding peers and junior team members to elevate overall team performance.

  • Resilience & Self-Direction — Maintains a high level of personal accountability for achieving outcomes. Works effectively with minimal direction, remains dependable under pressure, and demonstrates consistent follow-through on commitments and deadlines.

Responds confidently to objections, does not give up easily, and maintains relentless focus on achieving sales targets, weekly KPIs, and bottom-line growth. Proven ability to analyze performance and optimize strategies to drive continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Demand Planner
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT OLIPOPAt OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale.
jobs.description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

THE ROLE

As a Demand Planner, you own the demand plan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, and you own the assumptions behind it. You will build and publish the monthly forecast in Anaplan, quantify risk and opportunity ahead of the cycle, and bring your portfolio and your reasoning into consensus and S&OP. You are the company’s expert on order behavior for the accounts you carry, and the first person to know when something in your portfolio is moving.

This role sits inside an active transition from Excel-based planning to Anaplan. You will plan in the system, not around it, and you will help shape how the demand review cycle runs as functionality comes online. That means comfort with a process that is still being built, and a point of view on how it should work. The role carries real ownership of a forecast and real exposure to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. It is the level where a planner stops producing a number and starts defending a position.The Senior Manager is your escalation path on complex or high dollar changes, not an approval gate on routine cycles.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Ownership

• Build, validate, and publish the monthly demand forecast in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, including baseline, promotional lift, new item ramp, and phase-out, and stand behind the assumptions you set.
• Review the statistical baseline in Anaplan each cycle, apply overrides at the appropriate level with documented reasoning, and maintain override discipline rather than defaulting to manual entry.
• Build and compare scenario versions in Anaplan for risk and opportunity, promotional plans, supply constraints, and pricing changes, so the business sees the range before it commits to a number.
• Hold forecast accuracy and bias to target for your portfolio, review results every cycle, and come to the review with root cause on misses and a corrective action, not only the variance.
• Build launch forecasts for new items using historical analogs, planned marketing support, and account level merchandising plans, then track performance against the ramp and adjust.

Business Partnership

• Represent your portfolio in consensus and S&OP, presenting forecast changes, the drivers behind them, and the risk and opportunity attached, to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance.
• Collect and challenge assumptions covering promotional activity, launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer specific plans, and reflect them in the plan with a documented rationale.
• Quantify and communicate risk and opportunity early enough for the business to make a decision rather than react to a result.
• Partner with Supply Planning on inventory position, weeks of supply, fill rate risk, and allocation decisions, and flag supply and demand imbalance before it reaches the customer.
• Become the company expert on retailer and channel trends for your accounts using internal, POS, and syndicated data, and communicate what customer order behavior is telling us.
• Support the annual operating plan and long range planning cycles with portfolio level demand inputs and scenario analysis in partnership with Finance and Commercial.

Systems and Process

• Participate in the Anaplan implementation for your portfolio, including user acceptance testing, data validation against source systems, and migration of your accounts off Excel.
• Partner with the Demand Planning Analyst on master data accuracy, reporting needs, and analysis, and escalate data breaks that affect the forecast.
• Adhere to the demand review calendar and forecast lock dates, and keep your portfolio current between cycles as conditions change.
• Identify where the cycle is slow, manual, or unreliable, and help fix it.


QUALIFICATIONS:

REQUIRED:

  • Planning Platform: Proficiency in Anaplan
  • ERP System: Experience with NetSuite for managing order, shipment, and inventory history
  • Data Analysis: Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to handle large data sets
  • Presentation Skills: PowerPoint proficiency, with the ability to build materials suitable for driving consensus and presenting to leadership

PREFERRED:

  • Syndicated and POS Data: Familiarity with NielsenIQ, Circana, or SPINS, as well as retailer portals such as Retail Link or Vendor Central
  • BI and Visualization Tools: Experience with Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau

IDEAL CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE:

• 3-5 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least one to two years at the demand planner or demand planning analyst level or equivalent.
• Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly forecast cycle.
• Hands-on experience forecasting in Anaplan or a comparable integrated business planning platform.
• Advanced Excel proficiency and experience working in an ERP.
• Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals, along with the judgment to recognize when the statistical answer needs a commercial override and the discipline to document why.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain an analysis to a non-analytical audience.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and influencing approach across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization.
• Experience in a CPG, beverage, or manufacturing environment.

Nice-to-Have

• Experience through an Anaplan or comparable planning platform implementation, including user acceptance testing, data validation, or migration off spreadsheet-based planning.
• Anaplan Level 1 certification or equivalent platform training.
• Experience with syndicated and POS data sources and retailer portals.
• Exposure to annual operating plan or budget cycles alongside Finance.

REPORTS TO:

Senior Manager, Demand Planning

COMPENSATION:

$80,000-90,000 + Bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together.

  • Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.
  • Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who:

  • Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks
  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.

jobs.description:
About MD Integrations

At MD Integrations, we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful.

MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is the central point of contact and technical liaison for MDI customers in active implementation and supporting existing customers as they expand their integration offerings. You’ll lead the technical implementation process from kickoff to go-live, mapping and configuring API connections, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting issues to keep integrations on track.

This role is ideal for someone technically literate and highly comfortable working with APIs who enjoys problem-solving, learning new systems, and explaining complex concepts clearly to non-technical customers. This is not a software engineering role: you won’t be writing production code, but you will need to be confident configuring, testing, and debugging API connections independently. You’ll partner closely with the partner success and engineering teams, escalating clearly documented issues when they’re beyond the scope of this role.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Serve as the technical point of contact for new customers throughout implementation, and for existing customers expanding their integration footprint, guiding each engagement from kickoff through go-live.
  2. Lead the end-to-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.
  3. Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.
  4. Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.
  5. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back-and-forth.
  6. Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.
  7. Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.
  8. Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.
  9. Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

Success Looks Like…

  • Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go-live.
  • High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.
  • Low number of escalations needing hands-on engineering resources.
  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation.
  • Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.
  • Familiarity with data mapping, payload structures, or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or SQL).
  • Experience using tools such as HubSpot, Postman or equivalent for troubleshooting and testing API calls.
  • Technically-savvy and able to communicate technical concepts and processes to both technical and non-technical users. This is a technical support/implementation role, not a software development role, so you won’t be writing production code, but you should be able to independently resolve the majority of configuration and integration issues you encounter.
  • Experience documenting integration processes or producing customer-facing support materials for internal and external use including workflows, process diagrams and SOPs.
  • High attention to detail and organization; able to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new systems, data flows, and integration logic quickly.
  • Customer-first mindset: you thrive in helping customers solve problems and find clarity.
  • Experience in SaaS or healthcare technology integrations, a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary: The targeted range for this mid-level position is $72,500 - $85,000 per year, DOE.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance with generous subsidy, company-covered life and disability insurance, and 401(k) with match for full-time, US-based employees.
  • Professional Development Opportunities: We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and growth opportunities.
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes.
  • Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment: We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success.

Job Title: Senior SAP ABAP Developer (Digital Manufacturing Integration)
Location: Remote / Global Travel Required
Experience Level: 8–12+ Years

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior SAP ABAP Developer to support the global upgrade and implementation of our digital manufacturing platform (SAP MII/ME). In this role, you will be the core backend developer responsible for building and optimizing the ERP-side interfaces, custom extensions, and cloud-readiness strategies required to fuel our shop-floor systems. Working with a premier Aerospace & Defense client, you will leverage current ECC instances and they transition to S/4HANA and SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) to ensure seamless, high-performance, and secure data exchange between the enterprise core and MII/ME layers.

Core Responsibilities

  • ECC & S/4HANA Core & Integration Development: Develop, optimize, and maintain modern interfaces utilizing OData services, CDS Views, and AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures) to connect S/4HANA with SAP MII and SAP ME.
  • SAP BTP Extension & Integration: Design and build clean-core extensions, APIs, and integration flows on SAP BTP to orchestrate data between S/4HANA and shop-floor solutions.
  • ERP Custom Enhancement: Create custom ABAP objects, User Exits, BADIs, and Enhancement Spots within core S/4HANA manufacturing modules (PP, QM, MM, PM) using RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model) or modern extensibility frameworks.
  • Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot, profile, and optimize complex ABAP code and S/4HANA database queries to handle high-volume, real-time data transmissions without latency.
  • A&D Regulatory Adherence: Ensure all custom code, BTP applications, and data structures strictly comply with defense-specific compliance mandates, including ITAR data segregation and secure cloud standards.
  • Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with the Lead Functional Consultant and Principal SAP MII/ME Architect to translate technical specifications into secure, scalable S/4HANA and BTP solutions.

Technical Qualifications

  • ABAP on ECC & S/4HANA migration Expertise: 8–12+ years of advanced SAP ABAP programming experience, with minimum 1-2 projects (3+ years) of hands-on experience migrating & developing natively inside an SAP S/4HANA environment.
  • SAP BTP Proficiency: Practical experience with SAP BTP services (such as SAP Integration Suite, Extension Suite, or BTP ABAP Environment) to develop side-by-side or decoupled extensions.
  • Modern SAP Development Stack: Deep expertise in building CDS Views, OData services, AMDP, and applying SAP's "Clean Core" development principles.
  • Manufacturing Module Knowledge: Deep technical understanding of the underlying database tables and logic inside S/4HANA PP (Production Planning), QM (Quality Management), and MM (Materials Management).
  • Shop-Floor Context: Prior experience developing code specifically designed to interact with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) or SAP MII/ME layers (excluding SCADA).

Soft Skills & Compliance

  • Strong analytical skills with a precise attention to detail required for the highly regulated A&D industry.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across global, distributed technical teams.
  • Due to ITAR regulations and defense contract restrictions, US Citizenship or specific regional security clearances may be required.

Manatee is a virtual mental health clinic for kids and families. We partner with pediatricians and health systems to connect families to care, fast. As our Head of Provider Partnerships, you'll set the strategy for how we grow provider relationships across key markets, including Illinois and Texas. You own the partnerships and coach a distributed team toward the metrics that get Manatee to our ambitious financial goals that allow us to scale and serve more families. This is a senior role, reporting into our CEO, and built for someone who is as comfortable setting the strategy in the leadership meeting as they are driving to a pediatrician's office. You’ll spend half your time on the road building relationships in-person, the rest working from home on strategy, team coaching, and follow-through to close, nurture, and grow our referral partnerships.

What You'll Do:

  • Set the Strategy: Own how Manatee grows provider and referral partnerships across Illinois and Texas: where to invest, which practices and health systems to prioritize, and how the team gets there.
  • Lead and Develop the Team: Manage and coach a distributed team of five: Provider Partnerships Associates (BDRs) and the Provider Success Manager), with dotted-line guidance to Marketing. Set goals, run pipeline reviews, and coach your team toward the monthly and quarterly metrics that get Manatee to our goals for growth and impact.
  • Build Relationships Yourself: Conduct your own outreach and in-person meetings with physician practices and health systems. You're a strategic partner, not a door-to-door sales rep. You use data and a real understanding of pediatric behavioral-health referral patterns to have credible, high-impact conversations with skeptical gatekeeper pediatricians who care deeply about their patients and families, you aren’t just there to hard-pitch a rigid solution.
  • Grow the Partner Base: Drive new pediatrician and health-system partnerships from first contact to signed, active referral relationships. You'll personally carry a monthly new-partnership quota alongside your team. You know when to strategically leverage the Founder and CEO for a key, large group kickoff or close, but handle 90% of deals yourself.
  • Own the Engine, Don't Just Manage It: You will keep the CRM and territory pipeline honest. When something needs fixing: a CRM workflow, an associate's pipeline discipline, or marketing that isn’t landing, you're comfortable rolling up your sleeves and hands-on coaching, or bringing it across the line yourself when necessary.
  • Manage Up: Report metrics and progress to Manatee's CEO and Head of Operations, translating what you're seeing in the field into the decisions leadership needs to make. This role exists to create space for the Founder to stay focused on carrier partnerships, market-building, and investor relations.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years in a quota-carrying sales, business development, or partnerships role
  • At least 5 years specifically in healthcare sales or partnerships, working directly with care providers or physicians
  • Proven experience coaching and developing a team toward measurable sales or partnership targets
  • A strategic operator's mindset, just as willing to optimize a CRM workflow or coach an Associate one-on-one as to set strategy
  • Comfortable with in-person selling and building relationships face-to-face
  • Reliable personal transportation for local relationship-building in your home market (mileage reimbursed); available for meaningful travel to our other core markets — expect roughly 40–50% travel, concentrated on in-person partnership building
  • Comfortable remotely managing people and markets across the country
  • HubSpot or similar CRM experience
  • A track record of hitting partnership or revenue targets you personally owned

Why Manatee:

  • Mission and impact: Your team's work connects families to life-changing care
  • High Growth Environment: Join a fast-scaling company at a pivotal moment: your team's performance is directly tied to Manatee's path to growth and ability to serve more families, with real room to grow in the role and company impact.
  • Ownership: Take the reins of a growing field team, and shape where it goes next as we expand in growth markets.

Compensation: Base $135,000 - 150,000; OTE $250,000-$300,000
