About the Role

Our client is seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to build, scale, and maintain modern web applications and the infrastructure that powers them. This is a highly technical, hands-on role focused on full-stack product development, cloud infrastructure, system reliability, and engineering excellence.

You will work across front-end interfaces, back-end services, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and system monitoring to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performing applications. Beyond shipping features, this role also involves mentoring developers, contributing to architecture decisions, and improving long-term platform stability and maintainability.

The ideal candidate is a strong end-to-end engineer who thrives in fast-paced product environments and enjoys balancing speed, scalability, reliability, and technical quality.

Responsibilities

Front-End Development

  • Build modern, responsive user interfaces using React, Angular, or Vue
    • Translate Figma or Sketch designs into pixel-perfect, production-ready experiences
    • Optimize applications for performance, accessibility, and responsiveness
    • Build reusable UI components and scalable front-end architecture
    • Ensure compatibility across browsers and devices

Back-End Development

  • Develop and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs using Node.js, Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI), or Java
    • Build secure authentication and authorization systems with role-based access control
    • Design and optimize database schemas and queries across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB
    • Implement scalable server-side business logic and integrations
    • Improve application reliability, scalability, and performance

Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering

  • Deploy and manage applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or equivalent tools
    • Manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes
    • Monitor infrastructure performance, reliability, and deployment health
    • Support scalable cloud-native architecture and deployment practices

Testing & Engineering Quality

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using Jest, Mocha, PyTest, Cypress, or similar frameworks
    • Maintain high automated test coverage and engineering quality standards
    • Conduct peer code reviews and enforce clean coding practices
    • Troubleshoot production issues and performance bottlenecks efficiently

Monitoring, Reliability & Security

  • Monitor systems using Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar tools
    • Implement logging, alerting, and observability best practices
    • Apply secure coding principles aligned with OWASP Top 10 standards
    • Ensure systems comply with GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA, or other relevant compliance requirements
    • Support uptime, resiliency, and disaster recovery initiatives

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Collaborate with product managers and designers to turn requirements into scalable technical solutions
    • Lead technical discussions and contribute to architecture planning
    • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through reviews, guidance, and pairing
    • Contribute to long-term technical roadmaps and engineering standards
    • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies, planning, and technical estimation

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong full-stack engineer capable of owning features end-to-end
    • Experienced in scaling systems and improving infrastructure reliability
    • Hands-on problem solver who thrives in technical environments
    • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across teams
    • Balances rapid execution with maintainable architecture and code quality
    • Passionate about mentoring and improving engineering culture

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional full stack software engineering experience
    • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with React and Node.js
    • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB)
    • Hands-on cloud deployment experience using AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Strong understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines
    • Experience building APIs, scalable applications, and production systems
    • Strong debugging, optimization, and troubleshooting skills

Ideal Experience & Skills

  • Experience leading architecture reviews and technical design sessions
    • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation)
    • Background building SaaS or high-traffic applications
    • Experience with microservices, event-driven systems, or serverless architectures
    • Familiarity with Kubernetes orchestration and distributed systems
    • Exposure to observability, performance engineering, and cloud cost optimization

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Senior Full Stack Software Engineer’s day revolves around building features, improving infrastructure, and ensuring system reliability. You will:

  • Join standups and align with engineering and product teams on sprint priorities
    • Build full-stack features across APIs, databases, and front-end interfaces
    • Review pull requests and mentor engineers through technical feedback
    • Investigate and resolve bugs, outages, and performance bottlenecks
    • Collaborate with product managers and designers on implementation strategies and UX flows
    • Deploy updates through CI/CD pipelines and monitor infrastructure health
    • Contribute to technical planning, architecture decisions, and platform improvements

In essence: you are both a hands-on builder and technical leader, ensuring systems remain scalable, reliable, secure, and continuously improving.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Features delivered on time and aligned with technical specifications

• Application uptime ≥ 99.9%

  • High code quality and maintainable architecture standards
    • Automated test coverage maintained at ≥80%
    • Reduced technical debt and improved platform reliability
    • Fast resolution of production issues and infrastructure incidents
    • Positive peer feedback and successful mentoring of junior engineers

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (Full Stack Exercise or Architecture Case Study)
    • Client Interview(s) with Engineering Team

• Offer & Background Verification

ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

JOB OBJECTIVES:

Reporting directly to the Global Head of Marketing you will be support the marketing ecosystem, data, campaigns in a mission-driven organization where our impact is felt directly with those who need it the most.

This is a key appointment for us in which you will support the team in place on the design, implementation, and management of our global marketing strategy as we continue to improve and to bridge the gap between education and employment. You will play an operational but critical role within our growing marketing team. By leveraging data, operations, content, insight, and technology, you will help drive strategy, performance, and sustainable growth for and with the wider Generation team.

A self-starter with a real “can-do” attitude, you will be part of the Global Marketing Team and will work with country teams spanning from APAC to the Americas.

In this role, you will actively partner with multiple internal stakeholders while using technology wisely to drive creative, impactful solutions.

Your part in our team counts as a critical and central piece of the marketing puzzle that attracts both Learners and Employers and will help us shape the path to change and improve the lives of many more people of all ages throughout our 17+ locations and growing.

Power your future with Qualus in our Transmission & Distribution Canada business. We are seeking a Lead Protection & Control Engineer to join our well-established Protection & Control team of engineers and designers in Canada. This role offers long-term workload stability, exposure to a diverse portfolio of projects, and the opportunity to provide technical leadership across utility and renewable energy clients. You will work on projects ranging from 12 kV to 500 kV, supporting designs from early concept through construction and commissioning. This opportunity is ideal for a lead engineer who enjoys technical ownership, mentoring others, and solving complex system-level challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the Qualus’ Protection & Control Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing technical governance across multiple projects and programs
  • Set and uphold protection, control, and metering philosophy, standards, and best practices for high-voltage substations
  • Serve as Lead Engineer or Technical Authority on complex, high-risk, or non-standard projects, providing final technical approval and direction
  • Provide review and approval of:
    • Protection planning, philosophy, and application documents
    • One-lines, schematics, logic diagrams, panel layouts, and wiring diagrams
  • Oversee protection coordination studies and relay settings for utility transmission systems, including review and validation of work performed by others
  • Chair or participate in senior-level design reviews, hazard and risk assessments, and near miss investigations
  • Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), Site Acceptance Tests (SATs), and critical field inspections for complex installations
  • Advise project teams on construction sequencing, outage planning, and commissioning strategy
  • Participate in client technical, Safety by Design, and constructability review meetings
  • Provide technical oversight for project scopes, feasibility studies, cost estimates, and definition-phase deliverables, including review of assumptions and risks
  • Support Business Development by contributing technical strategy, execution approaches, and risk assessments for proposals and pursuits
  • Act as a primary technical escalation point for clients, internal teams, and external partners
  • Mentor senior and junior engineers, and play a key role in the continuous improvement of P&C standards, tools, and engineering practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10-15 years of utility-focused protection, control, and metering engineering experience, with demonstrated system-level responsibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Canada, or eligibility to obtain (U.S. PE considered an asset)
  • Recognized expertise in substation protection philosophy, including transmission line, transformer, bus, and feeder protection
  • Extensive experience reviewing and approving detailed P&C design drawings and technical deliverables
  • Experience performing protection coordination studies and relay settings for high-voltage transmission systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of protection software and platforms such as ASPEN, CAPE, EasyPower, SKM, and SEL / GE relay families
  • Practical experience with substation construction, commissioning, outage planning, and operational interfaces
  • Proven ability to provide technical judgment on non-standard, complex, or first-of-kind applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience on EPC projects, and familiarity with utility maintenance and operational practices, are considered strong assets
  • Demonstrated capability to mentor

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Neben einem fairen Festgehalt bekommst du eine jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn. Je nach Rolle besteht zudem die Option auf einen Firmenwagen.

Transparente Feedbackkultur & Entwicklung

Wir setzen nicht auf jährliche Pflichttermine, sondern auf regelmäßige, ehrliche Gespräche auf Augenhöhe – du gibst uns Feedback, wir dir. So wissen wir alle, woran wir sind, und können unsere gemeinsamen nächsten Entwicklungsschritte gezielt unterstützen.

Gesundheit, Freizeit & Sicherheit

Du erhältst 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, die nicht verfallen, sowie zusätzliche Absicherung, zum Beispiel durch eine Gruppen-Unfallversicherung. So bist du nicht nur beruflich, sondern auch privat gut aufgestellt.

Teamkultur & gemeinsame Erlebnisse

Trotz Remote-First ist uns persönlicher Austausch wichtig: Wir treffen uns regelmäßig zu gemeinsamen Aktivitäten – mal locker bei einem Get-together, mal zum gemeinsamen Workshop, mal aktiv bei Ausflügen – und sorgen so für echten Zusammenhalt abseits des Bildschirms.

wen suchen wir?

Wir suchen einen DevOps Engineer, der unseren openDesk-Managed-Service im Tagesbetrieb am Laufen hält: deployen, updaten, überwachen, troubleshooten. Du fühlst dich in Kubernetes zu Hause und kennst die Werkzeuge, mit denen openDesk ausgerollt wird: Helmfile über 35+ Helm-Charts, Helm-Diff und die Auslieferung über GitLab CI.

Wir betreiben openDesk mandantengetrennt über mehrere Kubernetes-Cluster hinweg: Jeder Kunde erhält eigene Namespaces für Applikation, Konfiguration, Mail und Datenbanken. Du betreibst die openDesk-Anwendungsschicht: die Deployments der Komponenten (Nubus/Keycloak, OX App Suite, Nextcloud, Collabora, Jitsi, Element/Synapse, OpenProject, XWiki), die Datenbanken über die von euch betriebenen Operatoren (CNPG, MariaDB-Operator, Keycloak-Operator) und die anwendungseigenen Secrets via ExternalSecrets. Cluster, Netzwerk und geteilte Bausteine wie cert-manager, external-dns, external-secrets, Flux, kube-prometheus-stack, Thanos, Loki und OpenBao stellt das Platform-Team bereit: du nutzt sie, betreibst sie aber nicht selbst.

Du arbeitest datengetrieben, automatisierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und denkst Sicherheit von Anfang an mit. Da wir einen 24x7-Service betreiben, ist die Rufbereitschaft fester Bestandteil der Rolle (kein Schichtdienst). In einer Organisation mit 360-Grad-Feedback bringst du dich offen ein.

was machst du bei uns?

Als openDesk DevOps Engineer verantwortest du den technischen Betrieb des Managed Service:

  • Du deployst und aktualisierst die openDesk-Komponenten via Helmfile/Helm-Diff über GitLab CI, inkl. Release- und Patch-Management; Supporting Services rollt ihr, wo möglich, via GitOps aus.
  • Du betreibst die Datenbanken über die Operatoren des Teams (CNPG für PostgreSQL, MariaDB-Operator): Backup/Restore, Point-in-Time-Recovery, Upgrades.
  • Du verwaltest die anwendungseigenen Secrets via ExternalSecrets gegen OpenBao.
  • Du überwachst die Anwendung: app-spezifische Metriken, Alerting-Regeln und Arbeit gegen SLI/SLO auf Basis von kube-prometheus-stack, Thanos und Loki.
  • Du betreibst die Supporting-Services im openDesk-Kontext (Redis/Memcached, Object Storage, Mail-Infrastruktur, ClamAV/ICAP, Coturn).
  • Du betreibst Fehlersuche/Debugging über die openDesk-Komponenten und auf Kubernetes-Ebene und dokumentierst Runbooks.
  • Du automatisierst Betrieb und Deployment und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zum Platform-Team.
  • Du nimmst gemeinsam mit dem Team an der Rufbereitschaft für den 24x7-Betrieb teil.

was bringst du mit?

Technical Skills

Must-have

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kubernetes im Betrieb (Workloads, Networking, RBAC, Storage, Troubleshooting).
  • Erfahrung mit Helm; Bereitschaft und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Helmfile und Helm-Diff.
  • Praxiserfahrung mit CI-getriebenem Rollout (z. B. GitLab CI) und/oder GitOps (Flux) als Betriebsmodell.
  • Erfahrung mit Datenbankbetrieb (PostgreSQL/MariaDB), idealerweise über Operatoren wie CNPG/CloudNativePG oder MariaDB-Operator.
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring/Observability (Prometheus/Grafana-Ökosystem) und Alerting.
  • Fundierte Linux-Kenntnisse und Automatisierungs-Mentalität (z. B. Ansible, Scripting).
  • Bereitschaft zur Rufbereitschaft (24x7-Service, kein Schichtdienst).
  • Deutsch und Englisch auf Business Level (C1/C2) in Wort und Schrift.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit openDesk-Komponenten (Nubus/Keycloak, OX App Suite, Nextcloud, Collabora, Jitsi, Element/Synapse, OpenProject, XWiki).
  • Erfahrung mit Secret-Management via ExternalSecrets und Vault/OpenBao.
  • Erfahrung mit den Supporting-Services (Redis/Memcached, Object Storage, Mail-Infrastruktur, ClamAV/ICAP, Coturn).
  • Erfahrung mit mandantenfähigem Betrieb über mehrere Cluster hinweg (Namespace-Layout, Tenant-Isolation).
  • Zertifizierungen (z. B. CKA/CKS).

Soft Skills

Must-have

  • Empirisch-agiles Mindset und ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.
  • Betriebsverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit im 24x7-Kontext.
  • Kommunikationsstark und teamfähig, bei gleichzeitiger Fähigkeit zur Selbstorganisation.
  • Sicherheitsbewusstsein (Security by Design, least privilege).
  • Bereitschaft, 360-Grad-Feedback zu geben und einzuholen.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung aus dem IT-Betrieb (Operations) eines Managed Service oder SaaS.
  • Bereitschaft zum Knowledge-Transfer im Team.

wie sieht der bewerbungsprozess bei uns aus?

Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst, begleiten wir dich transparent durch mehrere klar strukturierte Schritte. Uns ist wichtig, dass du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst – deshalb erhältst du in jeder Phase zeitnah Rückmeldung und alle nötigen Infos zum weiteren Ablauf. In der Regel durchläufst du dabei folgende Schritte:


Screening
Wir sichten deine Unterlagen sorgfältig und bewerten, ob deine Erfahrungen, Kompetenzen und Ziele zu der ausgeschriebenen Rolle und zu DACHS IT passen – auf dieser Basis entscheiden wir über eine Einladung zum Kennenlernen.

Kennenlerngespräch
In einem 30–45-minütigen Videocall lernst du ein Mitglied unseres Teams kennen. Ihr sprecht über deinen Hintergrund, unsere Kultur, Erwartungen beider Seiten und habt Raum für Fragen.

Technisches Interview
In einem 60-minütigen Termin löst du gemeinsam mit ein bis zwei unserer Consultants anspruchsvolle technische Aufgaben. Dabei geht es uns darum, deine Herangehensweise, dein Fachwissen und deine Zusammenarbeit im Team kennenzulernen.

Persönliches Gespräch
Anschließend triffst du unseren Geschäftsführer Alexander. Ihr besprecht verbleibende Fragen, Rahmenbedingungen und wie eine gemeinsame Zukunft bei DACHS IT konkret aussehen könnte.

Angebot
Stimmt die Vorstellung auf beiden Seiten, erhältst du ein Angebot von uns – transparent, nachvollziehbar und mit allen wichtigen Details.

We are a cyber security company that is on a mission to make the internet a safer place. We do this by delivering tooling and services related to an international standard, DMARC. Our technology enables organisations to protect their staff, customers, suppliers, and the whole world from email spoofing and impersonation attacks on their domains.

We’re a fully remote company with the majority of our builders working out of South Africa and sales teams in the Netherlands, the US, Latin America, Australia and the UK.

Why This Role Exists

The mission of this role is to create beautiful and user-friendly interfaces across Sendmarc’s digital products.

Sendmarc ships new capability fast, across a growing set of products and surfaces. This role exists to make sure every feature we ship is clear, consistent, and genuinely easy to use.

You’ll work alongside Sendmarc’s existing product design function, building out the design system that keeps our interfaces consistent as the product surface area grows, and working closely with Product and Engineering to take ideas from concept to shipped feature.

Outcomes

The core outcomes this role is accountable for:

End-to-End Product Design

Design and deliver product experiences that are intuitive, cohesive, and user-centric, communicating design thinking through wireframes, prototypes, sketches, user flows, mockups, and high-fidelity visual designs, and distilling complex problems into systematic, scalable solutions that get refined iteratively.

Usability & Research

Investigate usability pain points and apply UX heuristics to improve clarity and ease of use, and conduct research that informs design decisions, shapes product direction, and surfaces new opportunities.

Design System Ownership

Define, evolve, and maintain Sendmarc’s Design System, keeping the experience consistent and unified across the product ecosystem, and develop the usage guidelines, reusable components, content standards, and usability documentation that let product teams move faster.

Cross-Functional Delivery

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to plan, design, and implement new features, analysing business rules and technical constraints to keep solutions feasible, presenting design work and adjusting it based on feedback, and supporting engineers through delivery with assets, clarifications, and updates.

Competencies

PRODUCT DESIGN

  • Experience designing end-to-end product experiences, from wireframes and user flows through high-fidelity UI
  • Comfortable distilling complex problems into systematic, scalable design solutions, and refining them iteratively
  • Strong grounding in UX heuristics and usability principles, with a track record of removing friction and confusion from an interface

DESIGN SYSTEMS

  • Experience defining, evolving, and maintaining a design system: components, usage guidelines, content standards
  • Understands how a documented, reusable design system speeds up delivery for the wider product team

COLLABORATION & DELIVERY

  • Comfortable working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to plan and ship new features
  • Able to translate business rules and technical constraints into feasible, effective design solutions
  • Confident presenting design work, gathering feedback, and iterating in response
  • Comfortable supporting engineers through delivery with assets, clarifications, and design updates

TOOLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Tertiary qualification in Design, Interaction Design, HCI, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years hands-on experience designing digital interfaces, preferably for SaaS or B2B products
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools
  • A portfolio demonstrating practical UX and UI design work

Who We're Looking For

You’re a practical, detail-oriented designer who gets real satisfaction from solving an interface problem cleanly and shipping something people find genuinely easy to use. You communicate design thinking clearly, through wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups, and you’re comfortable working closely with Product and Engineering from early concept through to a shipped feature.

SaaS or B2B product experience is a plus, not a requirement: what matters more is a portfolio that shows sharp thinking and polished execution.

jobs.description:
Statistiker:in (m/w/d)

Ab 4.500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.

Konkret heißt das: Du übernimmst Projekte von der ersten Methodendiskussion bis zur finalen Abgabe. Du analysierst Daten (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA — je nachdem, was das Projekt verlangt), überarbeitest wissenschaftliche Texte, erklärst Doktorand:innen Methoden ruhig und klar, gibst Feedback, hältst Termine ein und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne dass jemand dich an die Hand nehmen muss.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.

Was du machst

  • Mediziner:innen durch den kompletten Promotionsprozess führen — Methodik, Statistik, Schreiben, Struktur

  • Statistische und qualitative Auswertungen liefern (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA)

  • Doktorand:innen Methoden geduldig und klar erklären — schriftlich und im Gespräch

  • Wissenschaftliche Texte überarbeiten, Feedback geben, methodische Sauberkeit sicherstellen

  • Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren — Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

  • Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

  • Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

  • Bodenständigkeit. Du hast in deinem Leben schon einmal richtig gearbeitet — Gastro, Bau, Pflege, Pflichtdienst, Lager, Versorgerjobs, körperliche Tätigkeiten neben dem Studium. Wer einmal eine 10-Stunden-Schicht in der Küche oder auf der Baustelle gemacht hat, weiß, was ehrliche Arbeit bedeutet

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet — nicht nur im Studium.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Nachhilfelehrer:in, Übungsleiter:in, Werkstudent:in im Lehrstuhl-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wer Lernenden schon einmal Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Emotionale Stabilität. Wenn ein:e Klient:in panisch wird, bleibst du ruhig. Wenn drei Mandate parallel brennen, sortierst du methodisch, statt dich anstecken zu lassen. Du nimmst Fehler sachlich, nicht persönlich.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig — auch wenn niemand drüberguckt.

  • Belastbarkeit in intensiven Phasen — keine Schönwetter-Mentalität.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und gegenüber Senior-Klient:innen klar, aber respektvoll argumentieren können.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Atmosphäre.

Berufserfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wir nehmen auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit starkem Tutor-Track. Mit 2-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in datenorientierten Bereichen (Marktforschung, Pharma-Innendienst, Junior Analytics, klinische Studien) bist du im Vorteil.

Was wir bieten

  • Geld: Ab 4.500 € brutto, reale Steigerung in den ersten 6–12 Monaten nach Ergebnissen

  • Aufstieg nach Leistung: Wer liefert, kommt schnell hoch — Zugehörigkeit zählt nicht

  • Echte Verantwortung: Eigene Projekte, eigene Kunden, eigene Entscheidungen — ab Tag 1

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

  • Entwicklung: Methodisch, technisch und unternehmerisch — du wächst hier real

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Akademiker:innen, die in der Forschungsblase bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Keine Leute, die "Work-Life-Balance" auf das Stundenkonto reduzieren. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und dafür entsprechend bezahlt werden will.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges und persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du in eine kleine Firma willst — nicht in einen Konzern oder die Uni.

  2. Was du in den nächsten 12 Monaten konkret erreichen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

Job Summary

Job Title: Data Scientist Sr

As a Senior Data Scientist supporting the VA's AI Citizen Developer Ecosystem (TOPR 0049), you will lead technical support activities that empower Veterans Health Administration (VHA) staff to leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions across clinical and operational domains. Working within a cutting-edge federal healthcare environment, you will apply advanced ML techniques—spanning supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning—to develop, validate, and analyze healthcare-specific data models and synthetic data cohorts that drive meaningful outcomes for Veterans. This role sits at the intersection of data science innovation and mission-driven public service, contributing directly to the VA's strategic goal of becoming an AI-enabled enterprise.

The ideal candidate is a self-directed, collaborative problem-solver who thrives in complex, matrixed federal environments and can translate sophisticated data science concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You bring deep intellectual curiosity about healthcare data, a commitment to responsible AI practices, and the ability to mentor and guide citizen developers as they build and scale AI solutions.

JOB DUTIES.

  • Lead technical support and advisory services for VHA AI Citizen Developers, guiding the design, development, and deployment of machine learning models and AI-driven solutions within the Veterans Health Administration ecosystem.
  • Apply supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning techniques to build and validate predictive models and analytical pipelines tailored to healthcare-specific use cases, including clinical decision support and population health management.

  • Contribute to the documentation, peer review, and continuous improvement of AI/ML methodologies, model performance metrics, and data quality standards, ensuring solutions meet federal regulatory requirements and VA enterprise AI policies.

Minimum Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS.

  • Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in data science, applied machine learning, or a closely related quantitative discipline, with demonstrated expertise in healthcare or life sciences data environments.
  • Master's Degree (required) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field from an accredited institution; PhD preferred.

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryWe are seeking an experienced Program Director to support the VA Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) Strategic Planning Division (SPD) enterprise portfolio, ensuring alignment of program objectives, timelines, milestones, and deliverables with VA strategic priorities and task order requirements, including comprehensive program, portfolio, and pilot management support, providing senior-level program management and strategic advisory support across a complex set of enterprise-level initiatives within the nation's largest federal health system.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Program Director to support the VA Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) Strategic Planning Division (SPD) enterprise portfolio, ensuring alignment of program objectives, timelines, milestones, and deliverables with VA strategic priorities and task order requirements, including comprehensive program, portfolio, and pilot management support, providing senior-level program management and strategic advisory support across a complex set of enterprise-level initiatives within the nation's largest federal health system. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to SES-level VA leadership, driving program strategy, portfolio oversight, and cross-functional coordination to advance mission-critical data-driven and value-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care. You will also be responsible for developing high-quality briefing materials and deliverables tailored for Congressional audiences, ensuring clear communication of program status, impact, and strategic direction. The ideal candidate is a seasoned federal health sector leader who combines executive-level advisory acumen with hands-on portfolio management expertise and thrives in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment where strategic thinking, stakeholder diplomacy, and precise written communication are equally valued.

Primary Responsibilities

Provide senior program management oversight across the VA Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) Strategic Planning Division (SPD) enterprise portfolio, ensuring alignment of program objectives, timelines, milestones, and deliverables with VA strategic priorities and task order requirements, including comprehensive program, portfolio, and pilot management support. Serve as a principal advisor to SES-level VA leadership on program strategy, risk management, organizational change, and initiative performance, offering evidence-based recommendations that inform executive decision-making. Lead the development, coordination, and quality review of Congressional briefing materials, testimony preparation documents, and legislative reports, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with VA messaging and policy positions. Oversee enterprise portfolio governance activities, including the establishment and maintenance of program dashboards, integrated master schedules, risk registers, and performance metrics across priorities aligned with the development of data-driven and value-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration among VA program offices, contracting officials, clinical stakeholders, and external partners to resolve program impediments, drive decision-making, and maintain continuity of operations across pilot design, resourcing, evaluation, strategic planning, and enterprise decision-making supporting CCPI SPD initiatives. Develop and maintain comprehensive program documentation including strategic plans, program management plans, executive status reports, and after-action reviews, ensuring audit-readiness and compliance with federal program management standards and VA policies.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 10 years of progressive program management experience within the federal health sector, with demonstrated responsibility for large-scale, enterprise-level initiatives. Master's Degree in Business Administration, Public Health, Health Administration, Public Policy, or a closely related field is required. Demonstrated experience providing advisory support directly to SES-level or equivalent federal executives, preferably within the VA, DoD, HHS, or a comparable large federal health agency. Ability to obtain and maintain a VA PIV credential and successfully complete a VA background investigation; active federal suitability or security clearance is preferred. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or a recognized equivalent (e.g., PgMP, FAC-P/PM Senior) is required at time of hire.

Desired Qualifications

Experience supporting development of data-driven and value-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden within a VA Medical Center (VAMC), Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN), or Veterans Health Administration Central Office (VHACO) environment. Familiarity with statutory authorities and responsibilities associated with testing new models of care, including support for waiver requests where authorized, and leadership of or collaborate on legislatively directed pilot initiatives. Experience with VA/VHA policies and processes aligned with connect pilot design, resourcing, evaluation, strategic planning, and enterprise decision-making. CCPI requires comprehensive program, portfolio, project, stakeholder, communications, and operational support to sustain these functions and maintain program continuity across active and future pilots. Prior experience authoring or directly supporting Congressional Budget Justifications (CBJ), congressional briefings, or formal legislative correspondence on behalf of a federal health agency. Demonstrated experience implementing or overseeing portfolio management frameworks such as PMI's Standard for Program Management, PPBE processes, or OMB Circular A-11 capital planning requirements within a federal health context. Proficiency with VA enterprise tools and systems such as the VA Procurement and Logistics Office (P&LO) platforms, PowerBI-based dashboards, or the VA's Integrated Financial and Acquisition Management System (IFAMS).

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

Job Description

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. EisnerAmper is seeking a Manager – Project Management to join our Outsourced Services practice. This role will lead complex operational and client-focused initiatives, ranging from client focused projects to large-scale transformation programs.

Many of these initiatives combine technology implementation, process redesign, data, and change management to improve client service, operational performance, scalability, and the employee experience. The Manager will translate business priorities into structured programs, establish effective governance, and lead cross-functional teams through planning, execution, implementation, adoption, and benefits realization. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable working with senior business leaders, service-line professionals, technology teams, vendors, and client stakeholders and will bring structure to ambiguity, manage interdependent workstreams, resolve risks, and maintain accountability for measurable outcomes.

What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:

  • You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry.
  • You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance.
  • You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards.
    • We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions.
    • We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation.

    • Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts.

What Work You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Lead a portfolio of operational, client-delivery, and technology-enabled transformation initiatives within the Outsourced Services practice.
  • Translate strategic priorities, client needs, and operational challenges into clear project charters, business requirements, roadmaps, workstreams, milestones, governance structures, and success measures.
  • Partner with firm and client leadership to define desired business outcomes, scope, deliverables, resource requirements, budgets, decision rights, and measures of success.
  • Lead initiatives through the full transformation lifecycle, including opportunity definition, current-state assessment, future-state design, implementation, adoption, stabilization, and benefits realization.
  • Establish and maintain effective program and project governance, including integrated plans, status reporting, risk and issue management, decision tracking, change control, and executive communications.
  • Manage scope, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple concurrent projects and interdependent workstreams.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions, outcomes, and required leadership actions.
  • Lead multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams across service lines, business operations, technology, data, vendors, and subject-matter experts, with clear roles, priorities, and accountability for outcomes.
  • Anticipate and resolve project risks, implementation barriers, resource constraints, and cross-program dependencies in partnership with clients, engagement teams, and firm leadership.
  • Facilitate collaboration and structured decision making among clients, firm leaders, technology teams, vendors, and subject-matter experts to maintain alignment and delivery momentum.
  • Partner with technology teams and implementation vendors to translate business needs into actionable requirements, implementation plans, testing, deployment, and transition activities.
  • Define measurable outcomes and provide transparent reporting on delivery progress, adoption, risks, financial performance, and realized business benefits.
  • Ensure initiatives meet applicable quality, risk management, compliance, contractual, data, and firm requirements.
  • Prepare and present executive-level updates, recommendations, and decision materials to leadership.
  • Build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across multiple levels to drive timely decisions and sustained adoption.
  • Support client relationship development, solution scoping, proposals, and other practice-growth activities related to the role’s areas of responsibility.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop project and engagement team members through coaching, performance feedback, and professional development guidance.
  • Develop and continuously improve repeatable project and transformation-management methodologies, tools, templates, governance standards, and delivery practices for Outsourced Services.
  • Stay current on project and program management, process improvement, change management, emerging technologies, and market developments relevant to clients and Outsourced Services.
  • Contribute to firm recruiting, training, knowledge sharing, and other practice-development activities as needed.
  • May be required to work extended hours and/or travel to client and EisnerAmper locations as business needs require.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Finance, Accounting, or a related field is required.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience leading complex projects, programs, technology-enabled transformation, process improvement, consulting, outsourced services, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of management, supervisory, team leadership, or cross-functional program leadership experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large programs, portfolios, or multi-project engagements with interdependent workstreams and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop effective teams across small, medium, and large-scale projects.
  • Project management or related certifications preferred, including Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile/Scrum, Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP), Prosci, or Lean Six Sigma credentials
  • Experience using project and portfolio management platforms such as Jira, Monday.com, Planview, Microsoft Project, or similar technologies to manage delivery and provide portfolio visibility.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, resource planning, financial management, change management, and performance reporting.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple concurrent initiatives, cross-program dependencies, and ambiguity in an evolving environment.
  • Strong analytical, process-design, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex business and operational needs into actionable requirements and recommendations.
  • Excellent facilitation, interpersonal, written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships, influence senior stakeholders, and guide groups through scope, priority, governance, process, and decision-making discussions.
  • High degree of professionalism and demonstrated ability to appropriately handle confidential client and firm information.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook; familiarity with data visualization and collaboration tools is preferred.
  • Experience partnering with business leaders, technology teams, vendors, and implementation partners to deliver solutions that align process, technology, data, and operating-model decisions.
  • Experience establishing outcome measures, monitoring adoption, and assessing whether completed initiatives deliver intended client, operational, quality, efficiency, scalability, risk, or financial benefits.

Job Title

Location(s)

US Remote - DC

Job Description

This is a full-time salaried position with Project Farma, a PerkinElmer company. The successful candidate will reside in one of Project Farma's primary markets and be willing to travel domestically to meet client project requests.

Project Farma’s purpose is to improve patient lives by accelerating the delivery of life-changing therapies. We accomplish this through the successful execution of high-quality life sciences projects across the full project lifecycle. Project Farma (PF) team members collaborate with cross-functional teams to build trusted client relationships, deliver an exceptional customer experience, and contribute to business growth by identifying opportunities and applying data-driven insights to support project planning, cost, schedule, and performance management.

This role contributes to organizational success by supporting financial performance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement, while also investing in people through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and professional development.

All team members are expected to embody Project Farma’s values by being curious, personable, and unselfish, while maintaining a strong commitment to a Patient Focused and People First mindset.

The Director, FP&A is a senior finance leader who will own and drive the day-to-day finance function with a high degree of independence. The Director; FP&A will serve as the operational finance lead, ensuring continuity, driving critical process improvements, and building scalable capabilities. This role will be accountable for leading PSA and ERP transformation, process optimization and system refinement alongside core finance operations. The Director, FP&A has the primary responsibility of owning and executing the finance function end-to-end, including financial planning and analysis, revenue reconciliation, invoicing excellence, system process improvement, and AI enablement within finance. They will operate with minimal oversight, proactively identifying gaps and driving solutions while the VP, Finance provides strategic direction and maintains overall oversight. This individual must thrive in a fast-moving, post-acquisition environment and be comfortable building processes from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and lead the day-to-day finance function, serving as the primary finance leader and will operate with a high degree of independence and accountability.
  • Lead and motivate a high-performing finance team; build team capabilities and foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
  • Forecasting, P&L oversight, weekly and monthly reporting, and analysis to identify trends, manage budget, and monitor revenue.
  • Identify/quantify risks and opportunities to ensure that the team and management are informed of the financial status and impact.
  • Develop, consolidate, and present insightful and robust qualitative and quantitative financial analysis including annual budget, quarterly/monthly forecast variances.
  • Partner with the VP, Finance to ensure alignment on strategic priorities; independently execute on finance operations and escalate key decisions as appropriate.
  • Evaluate trends within the business and offer business decision support.
  • Report financial results and key metrics against appropriate business projections and deviations from plan.
  • Develop ad-hoc reports as required.
  • Develop and provide monthly reports of key performance metrics for the consolidated results and a summary of the reports provided by the business divisions.
  • Develop and maintain long-term forecast models.
  • Provide support and analysis for financial requests from the investors, leadership team, and/or departmental business leaders.
  • Lead process improvement efforts on the recently implemented Professional Services Automation (PSA) tool and ERP integration; identify gaps, drive remediation, and build standardized workflows to optimize system performance.
  • Design and implement a new end-to-end revenue reconciliation process; ensure accuracy across project billing, recognition, and reporting within the PSA and ERP environment.
  • Redesign and improve the invoicing process to reduce cycle times, minimize errors, and ensure timely client billing; establish controls and reporting to track invoicing performance.
  • Lead the annual budgeting process.
  • Support resource management analysis ensuring staffing is being managed tightly to revenue.
  • Identify, pilot, and embed AI tools and automation within the finance function to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance decision-making across FP&A, invoicing, and reporting workflows.

Attributes for Success

  • Technical Delivery: Applies advanced technical knowledge and professional expertise
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Seeks better ways, adapts to change and champions new ideas.
  • Customer Focus & Professionalism: Represents PF with consistent professionalism, appropriate escalation and respect for internal stakeholders, even during high stress delivery situations
  • Integrity & Humility: Demonstrates self-awareness and puts PF mission above ego
  • Collaboration & Communication: Communicates clearly and proactively and drives transparent alignment with clients.
  • Project Execution: Delivers reliably, manages priorities and drives for high quality outcomes
  • Growth Mindset: Shows openness to new ideas, feedback and change

Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or business administration—or equivalent experience
  • Years of Experience: 10+
  • Proven track record of leadership, execution, and strategic thinking.
  • Management experience required.
  • Strong knowledge of financial statements and fundamental accounting standards
  • Proficiency in Microsoft suite; Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Proficiency in advanced data tools; SQL and PowerBI
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Superb financial modeling, data analysis, and forecasting skills; experience with post-acquisition integration and professional services business models a plus.

Other Preferred

  • CPA, CFA
  • Significant experience in financial reporting and analysis
  • Experience with Professional Services Automation (PSA) tools (e.g., Certinia, Kantata, or similar) and ERP integrations
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, or finance-specific AI platforms) to automate or enhance finance processes.

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.excerpt: Help customers get more value.  Build stronger relationships.
jobs.description:
Help customers get more value. Build stronger relationships. Keep the places people go to have fun running smoothly.

Since 2007, Clubspeed has been the leading venue management platform for the places people go to have fun. More than 1,700 venues across 34 countries rely on Clubspeed and Resova to power bookings, point of sale, integrated payments, memberships, waivers, guest experiences, and operations.

We're entering an exciting new chapter.

Following a recent acquisition, we're investing heavily across our products, customer experience, and go-to-market organization. As we scale, we're looking for a Customer Success Specialist who can help our customers get more value from our products throughout their journey with us.

This role is about being proactive, organized, and customer-focused. You'll help customers adopt our products, answer questions, deliver training, identify risk, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

If you enjoy helping customers succeed, solving problems, and working across teams to create a great customer experience, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity

The Customer Success Specialist supports a portfolio of Clubspeed and Resova customers across onboarding, adoption, engagement, and renewal.

You'll serve as a key day-to-day contact for your customers while helping them understand how to get more value from our products. You'll deliver training and webinars, translate new functionality into practical customer use cases, monitor customer health, and identify opportunities or risks before they become bigger issues.

You'll also work closely with Sales, Support, Marketing, Product, and other members of the Customer Success team to provide a coordinated experience from implementation through renewal.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build their Customer Success career inside an established SaaS business entering a new phase of growth.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you'll:

· Build trusted working relationships across your assigned customer portfolio.

· Help customers successfully transition from implementation into ongoing Customer Success.

· Increase customer adoption and engagement through training, webinars, best practices, and proactive outreach.

· Become confident connecting customer goals and operational challenges to Clubspeed and Resova capabilities.

· Maintain strong visibility into account health and identify potential churn risks early.

· Ensure customer questions and escalations are routed appropriately and followed through to resolution.

· Support Account Managers and Customer Success leadership through the renewal process.

· Identify expansion and payments opportunities and connect customers with the appropriate commercial team.

· Maintain accurate customer health, activity, and account information within our systems.

· Help build and improve the playbooks, processes, and programs we use to deliver Customer Success at scale.

What You'll Do

Customer Success & Retention

· Support a portfolio of customer accounts throughout onboarding, adoption, engagement, and renewal.

· Build strong day-to-day relationships with customer contacts and become a trusted resource for using Clubspeed and Resova effectively.

· Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers, answering questions and resolving common issues directly.

· Triage customer requests and coordinate with Support, Product, Implementation, or other internal teams when escalation is required.

· Follow customer issues through to resolution and ensure customers remain informed along the way.

· Monitor customer health, product engagement, and account activity to identify potential risks early.

· Support retention and recovery efforts for customers showing signs of churn risk.

· Collaborate with Account Managers and Customer Success leadership throughout the renewal process.

Adoption & Training

· Deliver product onboarding, webinars, and ongoing customer training aligned with our Customer Success programs and service levels.

· Help customers apply Clubspeed and Resova to their day-to-day operations and share relevant best practices.

· Understand customer goals and pain points and recommend workflows, features, and solutions that can help.

· Translate product releases and new functionality into practical use cases for customers.

· Partner with Implementation to ensure a smooth transition from implementation into ongoing Customer Success.

Customer Advocacy & Voice of Customer

· Gather customer feedback, recurring themes, and usage insights and share them with Product, Support, Sales, and other internal teams.

· Represent the customer's perspective in internal conversations and advocate for strong customer outcomes.

· Identify potential expansion, upsell, and payments opportunities based on customer needs and usage.

· Connect customers with the appropriate commercial team when an opportunity is identified.

Customer Operations

· Maintain accurate customer records, activity notes, health indicators, and next steps within CRM and Customer Success systems.

· Follow established Customer Success playbooks while helping identify opportunities to improve them.

· Coordinate across Sales, Support, Implementation, Product, and Customer Success to keep customer information and responsibilities aligned.

· Use customer data and engagement signals to prioritize outreach and ensure the right customers receive the right level of attention.

· Contribute to scalable Customer Success programs that allow us to support a growing global customer base effectively.

You'll Thrive Here If...

· You genuinely enjoy helping customers succeed.

· You're comfortable managing a portfolio rather than waiting for customers to come to you.

· You're proactive and notice potential problems before they become urgent.

· You can balance relationship-building with strong organization and follow-through.

· You enjoy teaching customers how to get more from technology.

· You're comfortable working across multiple teams to solve customer problems.

· You take ownership of issues even when someone else ultimately needs to resolve them.

· You like improving processes instead of simply following them.

· You use data and customer signals to determine where to focus your time.

· You're comfortable operating in a growing business where processes will continue to evolve.

· You're accountable, curious, and always looking for ways to improve.

Why Join Clubspeed?

You'll be joining an established category leader at an important point in its growth.

· Recently acquired with significant investment behind the business.

· Work with a global customer base of more than 1,700 venues across 34 countries.

· Help shape how we deliver Customer Success as the organization scales.

· Work closely with Sales, Product, Support, Implementation, and leadership.

· Represent customers and directly influence how we improve our products and customer experience.

· Develop experience across SaaS, integrated payments, commerce, and venue operations.

· Build your career within a growing Customer Success organization with opportunities for increased ownership and responsibility.

Our Hiring Process

We'll keep the process thoughtful and efficient.

· Introductory conversation

· Hiring Manager interview

· Customer Success scenario or practical exercise

· Cross-functional conversation

· Leadership conversation

· Final decision

Join Us

We're looking for someone who wants to do more than answer customer questions.

We want someone who understands what customers are trying to accomplish, helps them get there, identifies problems before they grow, and makes Clubspeed and Resova increasingly valuable to their business.

If you're energized by helping customers succeed and want to build your career with a market-leading SaaS company entering its next phase of growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Requirements

You'll likely be successful if you have:

· 2-4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Support, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably supporting a SaaS product.

· Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

· The ability to manage multiple customers, requests, and priorities without losing track of the details.

· A problem-solving mindset and good judgment about when to resolve something yourself and when to bring in additional expertise.

· Experience translating customer needs into practical product recommendations or solutions.

· The ability to identify customer risk and take proactive action.

· Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

· Comfort working with CRM and Customer Success technology; Salesforce experience is an advantage.

· A bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Education, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Experience with hospitality, attractions, entertainment venues, reservations, point of sale, payments, or vertical SaaS is a significant advantage.

Experience with Jira, Confluence, or other Atlassian tools is also helpful.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary (between $60,000-$70,000 CAD)
  • Comprehensive health coverage, including dental and vision
  • Flexible time off policy

  • Experience selling/leading in a highly matrixed environment and large account management preferred.

About SRS Acquiom

SRS Acquiom delivers the smartest way to run a deal™ through a platform and services designed to help deal parties manage complex M&A and loan agency transactions more efficiently.

Based in Denver, Colorado, with offices across the United States and in London and Amsterdam, SRS Acquiom supports transactions across North America and Europe. Our M&A services include professional shareholder representation, paying and escrow agent services, and online document solicitation and reporting. For loan and credit transactions, we provide independent Administrative Agent, Collateral Agent, Sub-Agent, and Successor Agent services.

Since 2007, SRS Acquiom has supported more than 11,500 transactions globally. By bringing efficiency, expertise, and purpose-built technology to complex financial transactions, we help sophisticated deal parties focus on building great businesses and maximizing value.

We’re equally committed to building careers as we are to building solutions.If you’re looking for a company with entrepreneurial energy, a proven record of growth and innovation, and a culture that supports your next career move, we’d love to talk.

A few benefits our employees enjoy

  • Day‑one coverage: medical, dental, and vision plans so you’re protected from the start
  • A 401(k) with a 4% company match to keep your future on track
  • Discretionary time off - take the time you need, when you need it
  • Employer‑paid life insurance, with the option to add extra coverage for peace of mind
  • Employee Assistance Programs for confidential support when life gets complicated
  • Discounted pet insurance (because furry family members count, too)
  • A fitness credit to back your health and wellness goals
  • Pre‑tax plans for dependent care, transportation, and flexible spending

Don't see an open role that fits your background? We'd still love to hear from you — and that's exactly what this application is for!

At SRS Acquiom, we sit at the center of the deals that reshape companies: handling the payments, escrows, and shareholder complexity that make M&A transactions actually close. It's high-stakes, detail-obsessed work, and it only works because of the people doing it.

We hire for every part of the business — full-time, part-time, contract, and internship roles, from early career through senior leadership, across our US, UK, and EU locations.

Here's what that business is made of:

The SRS Acquiom Lifecycle

Shareholder Representation — Represents selling shareholders' interests when a buyer disputes a claim against the escrow

Escrow and Payment Solutions — Sets up the escrow account and processes the payments that move at closing

Deal Operations — Keeps escrow and payment data accurate and reconciled for the life of a deal, from closing through final distribution.

Compliance — Checks every fund release against the deal's contract terms before money moves.

Loan Agency — Provides independent administrative, collateral, and agency services for loan and credit transactions

Client Services — Steps in to resolve shareholder issues and troubleshoot questions that arise during the post-closing process.

The Engine Behind Every Deal

Engineering — Builds and maintains the platforms and internal tools that run the rest of the business.

Product — Owns the roadmap and direction for SRSA's platform and tools.

The Role

Developers increasingly rely on AI search, coding assistants, technical communities, and traditional search engines to find and evaluate solutions. For Apryse to earn their attention, our content must be technically accurate, easy to discover, and genuinely useful.

As a Developer Writer, you will create the technical content that helps developers understand what they can build with Apryse and how to get started. You will write tutorials, how-to blogs, use-case content, code-led articles, and other documentation-adjacent resources designed to answer real developer questions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who can turn technical concepts and product capabilities into clear, practical content. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be comfortable reading code, working with technical subject-matter experts, and writing for an audience that values precision over marketing language.

Responsibilities

Create Technical Content Developers Can Use
  • Write how-to guides, technical articles, use-case content, and other documentation-adjacent resources.

Collaborate Across Technical Teams

  • Work with Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, and Documentation to verify technical claims and product details.

Contribute to the Broader Content Program

  • Support additional Content team priorities, including ebooks, one-pagers, campaign content, sales enablement materials, and BDR programs.
  • Adapt technical subject matter for different audiences, channels, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Contribute to a developer-focused brand voice that is credible, direct, useful, and free from unnecessary marketing language.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience writing technical content for developers or another technical audience.

Nice to Haves

Compensation Philosophy

The compensation for this position is commensurate upon experience, and the range listed reflects total compensation or on target earnings. The top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive experience and a profile that strongly aligns with the senior expectations of this role.

As the industry-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. jobs.excerpt: OverviewLEARN Behavioral is a national organization made up of dedicated and caring individuals with the sole purpose of nurturing children with autism and special needs to lead resilient and fulfilling lives.
jobs.description:
Overview

LEARN Behavioral is a national organization made up of dedicated and caring individuals with the sole purpose of nurturing children with autism and special needs to lead resilient and fulfilling lives. We specialize in contemporary, evidence based applied behavior analysis to deliver personalized treatment plans, backed by 20 years of clinical insights. We are proud to be a part of each family’s journey and share in the experience of finding success for every child, and family, in our care. If you share a similar passion for nurturing and empowering the success of others, along with the opportunity to have an impact on the lives of others, we are eager to connect with you!

LEARN Behavioral hiring an Executive Director of Advocacy!

Every day, families across the country are waiting — for a payor approval, for a regulatory fix, for someone in the room who understands both the policy and the child behind it. At LEARN Behavioral, we believe every autistic individual deserves access to the care that helps them thrive, and we're looking for an individual to lead our Advocacy efforts and help make that a reality in every community we serve.

This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of mission and policy — shaping the legislative and regulatory landscape for autism services while serving as a trusted voice for one of the country's leading providers of ABA and autism care.

Who We’re Looking For

We are seeking an individual who is excited to develop and execute plans that drive meaningful, lasting impact across the organization and the field.

As the leader of LEARN’s advocacy efforts, you will lead the company efforts to improve access to care for autistic individuals — especially clients covered by Medicaid — in partnership with executive management, local leadership, and third-party lobbyists. You'll work hand-in-hand with regional leaders to advance legislative and regulatory reforms that support our mission and business goals, and you'll serve as LEARN's primary point of contact with national and regional industry associations.

What You Have

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in advocacy, government relations, public policy, or a closely related field. Preference for individuals with direct experience in the field of ABA.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex policy issues into actionable advocacy strategies.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders — from clinicians to legislators to payors.
  • A track record of working independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines at once.
  • Willingness to travel to represent LEARN in key markets and forums.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop and implement advocacy initiatives in key markets alongside internal stakeholders, with a particular focus on Medicaid programs.
  • Partner with local leadership to weave advocacy priorities into broader business strategy and objectives.
  • Track and report on legislation and regulations that could affect access to care, keeping the organization ahead of change rather than reacting to it.
  • Build and sustain relationships with key external stakeholders — legislators, regulators, payors, and industry partners.
  • Represent LEARN at relevant forums, conferences, and events, serving as a visible and credible voice for the field.
  • Keep executive management informed on developments that could impact the organization.
  • Partner with Payor relations and RCM team on reimbursement related issues
  • Liaise with key industry groups

Physical Requirements

The physical requirements and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. In order to perform this position adequately, the individual must be able to carry out the following essential physical requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential physical requirements.

  • Communication: Can communicate expressively and receptively, verbally and in writing.
  • Problem Sensitivity: The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem.

If you’ve felt the pressures of traditional practice, chasing volume instead of shaping outcomes, Wider Circle may be for you.
Patients leave the hospital, and the system fractures: families scramble, meds get muddled, follow-up falls through, and another admission happens. The system wasn’t built for these moments. We started Wider Care+ because it simply wasn’t enough.

Wider Circle delivers community-rooted, relationship-driven care for older adults and clinically complex populations by aligning clinical insight with trusted, community-based support. Wider Care+ is our new pilot that pairs physicians, Community Health Workers, Licensed Clinical Social Workers, and care navigators to create a coordinated, humane path forward. You are the clinical entry point—the comprehensive assessment that sets the foundation for real, ongoing intervention.

The Role as a Telehealth Physician for Wider Care+, you’ll conduct initial telehealth assessments that serve as the clinical gateway for members newly enrolled in the pilot. Each visit confirms clinical needs, synthesizes the medical and social context, identifies barriers to care, and establishes prioritized clinical goals for the care team to implement over the course of months of support. Your assessment directly shapes the member’s care journey. This role is ideal for clinicians interested in innovative care delivery, population health, and collaborative, whole-person models of care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive telehealth initial visits for enrolled members (10-15 min)
  • Synthesize complex medical and social histories and identify clinical priorities and risks
  • Create concise, actionable clinical plans and handoffs for Community Health Workers, LCSWs, and care navigators
  • Document findings and recommendations clearly in the EMR to guide ongoing care
  • Provide clinical guidance on escalation pathways and program workflows during the pilot
  • Build rapid clinical rapport and trust with members and caregivers

Why clinicians say Wider Care+ feels different

  • Clinical autonomy: You own assessments and clinical judgment—no productivity quotas, no templated box-checking.
  • Focused clinical impact: You set direction; a skilled, community-centered team executes longitudinal engagement and social support.
  • Remote, flexible work: Telehealth visits you can schedule to fit your week—no clinic overhead, no commute.
  • Early-stage influence: Join a pilot shaping how we deliver whole-person care at scale.
  • Team-based care: You’re never alone—care managers and community teammates carry longitudinal work.

Requirements

  • MD or DO with an active, unrestricted license
  • Board-certified or board-eligible in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Geriatrics, or related primary care specialty preferred
  • Substantial experience with Medicare/Medicaid populations, or complex chronic disease management
  • Skilled at telehealth assessment and building rapport virtually
  • Strong clinical judgment, comfort with complexity and ambiguity, and interest in care coordination
  • Comfortable working in an iterative, startup-like pilot environment

Benefits

  • 1099 independent contractor
  • Competitive hourly/visit-based compensation (Commensurate with experience)
  • Part-time, flexible scheduling (Recommended 6–10+ hours/week depending on caseload)
  • Fully virtual visits and EMR documentation
  • Pilot role with opportunity to expand as Wider Care+ scales

Why This Role Is Different

This is not a traditional panel-based practice.

You focus on understanding the patient and setting direction — while a dedicated support team helps carry out the ongoing engagement.

If you’re interested in improving care for vulnerable populations while working in a flexible, innovative care model, we’d love to connect.

Responsibilities

  • Build, test, document, and maintain QA/QC systems for several products in an Agile lifecycle using C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure technologies.

>Accuracy
