The Offshore Bookkeeper is a precision-focused production role responsible for preparing accurate, complete, and review-ready bookkeeping and payroll work.

This role supports the Senior Bookkeeper and Principal by:

  • Maintaining clean, structured client files
  • Ensuring compliance documentation is complete
  • Following documented SOPs and quality standards

All work is reviewed before client delivery.

This role does not communicate directly with clients unless specifically instructed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transaction Processing & File Maintenance

  • Code daily/weekly transactions in Xero and Dext in accordance with firm standards.
  • Reconcile bank feeds, credit cards, PayPal, Stripe and clearing accounts
  • Apply tracking categories and project costings accurately
  • Process supplier bills and expense claims using DEXT.
  • Maintain structured and audit-ready client files

Output Standard: Files must be review-ready, fully reconciled, and supported with working papers.

2. Accounts Payable & Receivable Support

Note: Does not approve or file STP payroll.

4. Month/Quarter/Year-End & Compliance Preparation

  • Prepare draft and custom management reports if required (P&L, Balance Sheet).
  • Prepare BAS/IAS working papers and GST reconciliations. Ability to use the Xero GST Reconciliation feature within Xero is a requirement of the role.
  • Post draft journals (prepayments, accruals, loan interest, staff leave, EOFY adjustments).
  • Update & maintain fixed asset registers.
  • Perform internal file quality checks before submission for review.

Output Standard: It is expected that work is submitted by agreed deadlines in complete draft form.

5. Workflow & Documentation Discipline

  • Follow all documented SOPs and QC checklists.
  • Escalate discrepancies, missing information, or unusual transactions promptly. Quality Control is a high priority on a day to day basis.

  • Contribute to process improvement recommendations.

Role Boundaries

This role:

  • Does not lodge BAS/IAS.
  • Does not approve payroll or payments.
  • Does not provide advisory commentary unless otherwise requested.

All outputs are subject to review.

Performance Expectations & KPIs

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Accuracy (minimal review corrections required).
  • Timeliness (meeting internal deadlines).
  • Reconciliation completeness.
  • Working paper quality.
  • SOP adherence.
  • Proactive issue escalation.
  • Clear internal communication.

Quality is prioritised over speed. However, consistent delivery timelines are essential.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years Bookkeeping experience with Australian clients.

jobs.excerpt: We are opening a Staff Software Engineer position with a cross-squad scope.
jobs.description:
We are opening a Staff Software Engineer position with a cross-squad scope. It is a senior individual contributor role, reporting directly to the Head of Engineering.

Your impact will be measured by how much the whole engineering team improves with you in it: the quality of our architecture, the speed at which squads deliver, and the technical level of the engineers around you. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you will shape the technical direction of our three squads, lead the technical initiatives no single squad can own, help teams with their hardest problems, and keep writing code. This is a job for someone who still likes to build.

Our Tech Department?

Our stack

  • Ruby on Rails monolith

  • Micro-services in Go, Ruby

  • Postgres, MySQL and Redis

  • ElasticSearch or Algolia, depending on our use case.

  • gRPC

  • Kafka

  • React, TypeScript, Next.js, React testing library and Storybook

  • AWS hosting, Kubernetes, monitored with Grafana.

  • Continuous deployment with Github & CircleCI

Our organization (the famous “Spotify model” adapted so differently by each company)

  • 60 people (engineers, product people and data team)

  • 1 product engineering tribe with 3 impact teams and 3 Staff Engineers

  • 1 platform tribe including a QA team, a core engineering team, a devops & SRE team

  • Each team with a hands-on Engineering Manager

  • Staff Engineers report directly to the Head of Engineering

  • Software craftsmanship: clean code, testing, peer programming, code review, etc.

What you will do

Architecture and technical direction across squads

  • With the other Staff Engineers, you define and maintain the target architecture of the platform and turn it into a technical roadmap that squads follow because it is clear and practical.

  • You anticipate the technical problems the product will hit in the next 6 to 12 months and make the design decisions that avoid them.

  • You frame the most complex and ambiguous technical topics at the system level (data models, service boundaries, event flows, integrations with external tools) and bring them to a decision.

  • You make trade-offs explicit for Product and Engineering leadership: what a pattern brings versus what it costs, what we build now versus what we defer.

Hands-on technical leadership

  • You write code on the critical and transverse pieces: shared libraries, core services, migrations, performance and reliability work that spans squads.

  • You know large sections of the codebase in depth, and you are the person squads call when they are stuck on a hard problem or a production incident.

  • You set the example on testing, observability and deployment practices, and you make good practice the easy default rather than a rule to enforce.

  • You remove complexity wherever you find it: fewer moving parts, fewer ways of doing the same thing, less work for the same outcome.

Growing the engineering team

  • You mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and you help seniors become mentors themselves.

  • Jointly with the chapter leads, you run the backend community: design reviews, tech talks, workshops, shared guidelines and documentation.

  • You represent JobTeaser engineering outside the company, at meetups, in articles or in open source.

Working with engineering leadership

  • You work with the Head of Engineering and the Engineering Managers to structure technical work, staff transverse initiatives and weigh technical investment against product needs.

  • You help technical debates reach a decision, then communicate and support that decision once it is made.

  • You pick up transverse topics that have no natural owner.

What will be your next challenges?

  • Consolidate our tech stack, practices and tooling across our microservice architecture into a cohesive technical vision

  • Lead explorations and architectural design of complex new features and integrations with new tools

  • Supervise the proper documentation of our architectural decisions and practices

  • Participate in the animation of the community of backend and frontend developers

  • Guide improvements to our platform’s monitoring, alerting and reliability

  • Mentor and assist other backend developers and teams on complex problems

Who are you? 🎯

  • We care more about judgment and track record than about years of experience. As a reference point, you probably have 8 or more years in software engineering, including a substantial period in a transverse or lead role spanning several teams (Staff, Principal, Lead or equivalent) in a product company such as a SaaS, a marketplace or a platform.

  • You have strong backend skills in Ruby or another backend ecosystem, and you are at ease with distributed systems, relational databases, Kafka, REST and gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes.

  • You have built and operated business-critical systems at scale, led a large migration or architectural transition across several teams, and can point to measurable improvements in stability, performance or scalability that you drove.

  • You know when structure adds value and when it gets in the way. You prefer clear code to clever code, and you can say "not yet" as easily as "yes".

About the Opportunity:

Arden University runs the 'ACE Mentoring Programme' to help close gaps in progression and improve graduate outcomes for students from priority groups. As part of our Access & Participation Plan, this initiative connects current students/recent graduates with industry professionals and/or Arden alumni for structured, online career mentoring.

As a volunteer mentor, you’ll share your industry expertise and professional insight to help students build confidence, develop employability skills, and progress into meaningful work or further study through clear, achievable career plans.

You’ll be matched with mentee(s) from priority groups, including:

  • Students from ethnic minority backgrounds

  • Students with disabilities (including mental health conditions)

  • Students who are care experienced

Mentoring takes place online via our approved 3rd party mentoring platform, Mentorloop. You’ll receive training and support to help you get started and make the most of the experience.

Programme Timings:

The programme runs from Autumn 2026 to Spring 2027 over a period of 6 months. All mentoring conversations and meetings take place online meaning the schedule is flexible. We ask mentors to commit approximately 1–2 hours per month, including ad-hoc support between mentoring sessions. We recommend holding a meeting roughly every 4 weeks, but this may be more or less frequent, depending on your availability and how often your mentee wishes to meet.

What we are looking for:

We welcome professionals from all sectors and backgrounds who have at least 2 years professional experience in graduate or management level employment. You don’t need prior mentoring experience, just a genuine interest in supporting students and the ability to share practical career insight. Ideal mentors will be:

  • Enthusiastic and committed to the idea of mentoring to support students from a wide range of backgrounds.

  • Willing to help others develop and succeed by sharing real industry insights and personal experience.

  • Strong communicators who can offer encouragement and constructive feedback

  • Respectful, inclusive, open-minded and able to mentor without judgement, bias or discrimination.

  • Relevant professional experience in any sector including self-employment, with the ability to share insights and networks.

  • Able to manage mentoring around a busy schedule and communicate with mentee(s) reliably.

What's in it for you?

Mentoring is a powerful way to give back, but it’s also a rewarding experience for you as a professional. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned leader, mentoring offers the chance to reflect, grow, and make a real difference.

  • Make a meaningful impact by supporting students from diverse backgrounds to grow in confidence, skills, and career clarity.

  • Develop your leadership, coaching, and communication skills - mentoring is a credible form of volunteering that enhances your CV and demonstrates your commitment to people development.

  • Gain fresh perspectives through reverse mentoring and insights from the next generation of talent.

  • Access bespoke mentor training and ongoing support from the programme team.

  • Enjoy flexible volunteering - just a few hours a month, fully online via Mentorloop and designed to fit around your schedule.

  • Raise your organisation’s profile and support CSR goals.

  • Identify emerging talent and build your future pipeline by engaging with motivated students.

Recently shortlisted for national awards, we’re a growing team making a real difference to student success and graduate outcomes.

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Who we are:

As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be.

The Development Project Engineer – Fire Protection & Fire Alarm is primarily responsible for assisting with the design, preconstruction, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities for fire protection, fire alarm, and life safety systems across assigned projects. The Project Engineer will interact daily with Facilities, Contractors, Designers, Engineers, Commissioning Agents, Vendors, Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), Insurance Representatives, and Data Center Operations staff and should possess written and verbal communication skills commensurate with this level of engagement.

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review drawing packages for adherence to fire protection, fire alarm, and life safety design standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external design teams to evaluate designs to ensure compliance with established design standards, local code requirements, insurance requirements, and AHJ requirements.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to define project scope requirements, evaluate deviations from standards, and communicate requirements to design teams.
  • Work with construction, commissioning, and risk management teams to answer Requests for Information (RFIs), code interpretations, and value engineering proposals.
  • Collaborate with the procurement team to review OFCI equipment submittals for compliance with fire protection and fire alarm design criteria.
  • Support project teams in resolving fire protection and fire alarm design issues discovered during construction, testing, and commissioning phases.
  • Work closely with strategic procurement teams on fire protection and fire alarm equipment procurement.
  • Assist in reviewing fire protection hydraulic calculations, fire pump analyses, water supply evaluations, and system acceptance testing requirements.
  • Assist in reviewing fire alarm system architectures, battery calculations, sequence of operations, cause-and-effect matrices, and integrated testing plans.
  • Support factory witness testing, site acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Coordinate with AHJs, insurance representatives, consultants, contractors, and commissioning teams to support project approvals and occupancy milestones.
  • Support development and maintenance of standardized fire protection and fire alarm design standards for mission-critical facilities.
  • Assist with evaluating fire suppression, fire detection, emergency communications, and life safety systems for compliance and operational reliability.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Basic experience with fire protection, fire alarm, life safety, construction, commissioning, facility operations, or engineering design.
  • Familiarity with engineering drawings, specifications, submittals, and construction documents.
  • Understanding of fire suppression systems, fire alarm systems, smoke detection systems, and life safety systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing, supporting, or reviewing fire protection and fire alarm systems for data centers, mission-critical facilities, industrial facilities, or large commercial developments.
  • Assist with project management responsibilities across multiple projects and campuses.
  • Experience with fire alarm sequence of operations, cause-and-effect matrices, system testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Direct experience in the construction of data centers, critical medical facilities, industrial facilities, or other mission-critical environments.
  • Basic knowledge of NFPA standards, including but not limited to NFPA 13, NFPA 20, NFPA 24, NFPA 72, NFPA 75, NFPA 76, NFPA 101, and NFPA 4, as well as applicable building and fire codes.
  • Familiarity with FM Global Data Sheets, insurance requirements, and loss prevention strategies.
  • Experience with double-interlock pre-action sprinkler systems, clean agent systems, water-based suppression systems, and special hazard protection systems.
  • Experience with VESDA and aspirating smoke detection systems, very early warning fire detection systems, and integration with monitoring and control platforms.
  • Experience supporting integrated systems testing, acceptance testing, and commissioning of fire protection and life safety systems.
  • Experience evaluating performance-based fire protection alternatives and alternative means and methods.
  • Basic knowledge of fire protection, fire alarm, and life safety systems and their integration into mission-critical environments.
  • Basic multidisciplinary knowledge of electrical, mechanical, controls, commissioning, pre-construction requirements, and construction processes.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues to senior leadership, consultants, contractors, AHJs, insurers, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • NICET certification, EIT certification, CFPS certification, or a desire to pursue industry certifications is preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interface with all levels of the organization.
  • Must be a capable, proven team player who fosters and operates effectively within internal and external team environments.
  • Ability to solve problems at a tactical and functional level.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of fire protection, fire alarm, life safety, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Ability to review, interpret, and communicate engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and testing requirements.
  • Understanding of risk management principles and fire protection strategies for mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to balance code compliance, operational reliability, maintainability, and project requirements when evaluating technical solutions.

QTS-Specific Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting hyperscale and colocation data center developments.
  • Familiarity with FM-insured facilities, critical environment risk mitigation, and integrated testing of fire protection systems supporting Tier III and Tier IV mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Experience working with owners, contractors, consultants, and commissioning teams in fast-paced data center development environments.

TOTAL REWARDS

This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

Job Description

Construction Operations Leader

The Construction Operations Leader drives operational performance for the profit center’s book of business, strengthening execution across cost, quality, speed, service, and data integrity while ensuring the team and operating model can support growth.

This highly visible role is ideal for a leader who builds strong teams, improves operations, and partners closely with underwriting, shared services, and enterprise leaders to connect business priorities with enterprise capabilities and deliver a high-quality broker and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Performance & Financial Management: Lead profit center support operations, including staffing, systems, and vendor spend; manage KPIs such as cycle time, data quality, leakage, and service levels; and provide operational insights for monthly management meetings and quarterly business reviews.
  • Underwriting Operations & Servicing: Oversee origination and servicing activities across the book of business, including clear, rate, quote, bind, booking, issuance, endorsement, renewal servicing, and related reinsurance or quota share processing; guide subjectivities to completion; and partner with underwriting and service teams to meet SLAs and address delivery gaps.

People, Process & Controls

  • People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop Account Managers, Underwriting Assistants, and Operations Analysts; support hiring, performance management, career development, and workforce planning; and build team capability and a strong talent pipeline.
  • Process, Workflow & Systems: Implement and refine standards for submission, renewal, endorsement, and issuance activity; help prioritize systems and tooling enhancements; and identify operational improvements that can be resolved across the organization.
  • Data, Governance & Compliance: Promote the accuracy of premium, exposure, and policy data used in financial and actuarial reporting; maintain current process documentation, workflows, and operating guidelines; and support timely resolution of issues that create data, reporting, audit, or compliance risk.

Partnership, Growth & Transformation

  • Broker Experience & Business Partnership: Partner with profit center leadership to support a high-quality broker experience through responsiveness, consistency, and strong turnaround times, while ensuring operational execution strengthens broker and customer relationships.
  • Enterprise Partnership & Transformation: Serve as a key operating partner between the profit center, shared services, and centers of excellence; support operational scaling for growth; drive adoption of enterprise tools, standards, and initiatives; lead or contribute to automation, digitization, and efficiency efforts; coordinate readiness for product changes, workflow updates, training needs, and launches; monitor service expectations and delivery performance; elevate persistent issues; and represent profit center priorities in planning and capacity discussions.

What You Will Bring to C&F

  • Experience & Education: 10+ years of insurance operations experience, including 3+ years in a leadership role with responsibility for budget, headcount, and operational outcomes; bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Preferred Credentials & Industry Background: CPCU, AIC, or similar insurance operations designation preferred; experience in executive lines and/or specialty commercial lines underwriting operations preferred.
  • Business Scope & Functional Leadership: Experience supporting a comparable book or business unit, ideally $100M+ in premium, and leading teams across multiple functions, including account management and underwriting support/operations.
  • Financial & Operational Acumen: Strong understanding of loss ratio, expense ratio, and combined ratio drivers; comfort managing budgets and making thoughtful trade-off decisions in a resource-constrained environment.
  • Leadership & Execution: Demonstrated success developing teams in a cross-functional environment, with a strong operational mindset that balances quality, speed, accuracy, and customer experience.
  • Improvement & Problem Solving: Comfort with process improvement, technology adoption, and operational innovation, supported by strong judgment, business acumen, and problem-solving capability.
  • Communication & Working Style: Detail-oriented, accountable, and focused on follow-through and continuous improvement, with excellent communication and relationship-building skills across all organizational levels.
  • Travel: Ability to travel as needed.

What C&F will bring to you

We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. jobs.description:
Role Overview

Village Capital is hiring a Vice President to lead our Africa and the Middle East portfolio. This is a 12-month fixed-term position, with the possibility of extension if Village Capital meets its funding targets.

This is a senior, externally visible leadership role for an investment professional with a track record in fundraising and partnership relationship management. They'll be trusted by funders, investors, government partners, and foundation leaders, and will hold operational excellence and partnership growth as equally important, mutually reinforcing priorities.

They'll bring a solid understanding of the investment landscape, including the tools, structures, and language of early-stage investment capital (equity, debt, hybrid), blended capital, and philanthropic capital, to complement their operational and business development leadership in-region. They will manage regionally distributed teams leading both investment transactions and direct entrepreneur support, and must be fluent enough to oversee and drive a strategy that mobilizes capital to entrepreneurs in the Africa and Middle East region.

The Vice President will delegate with confidence, develop the people around them, and hold teams accountable without micromanaging. They are multidisciplinary, as comfortable in an investor meeting as in a program design session with a donor, and bring a systems-change approach to problem-solving in both settings.

Candidate Profile

The Vice President, Africa & Middle East is a mission-driven leader with investment experience in banking, entrepreneurship, impact investing, or international development, and is equally credible overseeing entrepreneur support programs, investment strategy, and funder and investor relationships. They are fluent in the language of early-stage investment capital, including venture capital (equity, debt, hybrid), blended capital, and philanthropic capital, and comfortable leading investment strategy conversations while supporting execution teams.

They lead with confidence and humility, and manage with cultural fluency. Critically, they work seamlessly across teams, actively building relationships and coordinating with internal stakeholders in different functions to accomplish shared goals.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Regional Leadership

  • Drive multi-regional strategy across Africa and the Middle East, ensuring effective alignment between investment and entrepreneur support approaches, and coherence between regional priorities and Village Capital's global direction.
  • Identify and advance strategic funding and financing opportunities within and across the regions, surfacing insights and recommendations as a member of the organizational leadership.
  • Actively coordinate with regional and functional teams and leadership, collaborating on resource allocation and strategy, sharing learnings, and operating with a ‘one VilCap’ mindset, to ensure seamless integration across teams and to support organizational objectives.
  • Serve as Village Capital's senior representative for the regional portfolio, both internally and externally.
  • Partner with cross-functional colleagues (communications, business development, finance, data and impact, and other regional teams) to ensure integrated and quality execution.
  • Stay current on trends in entrepreneurship, venture capital, innovative finance, philanthropic capital, and blended finance relevant to the region.

Partnership Development & Fundraising

  • Lead strategic stakeholder engagement and business development across the regions, in collaboration with the Business Development team.
  • Cultivate and steward relationships with investors, foundations, corporations, governments, and funders.
  • Partner with the Business Development team on proposal development and donor reporting, and with the Communications team on pitch materials and case studies for organizational offerings (e.g., investment and entrepreneur support); provide strategic and budget input on new proposals.
  • Co-develop regional and sectoral fundraising strategy and maintain a clear fundraising roadmap for the regions.
  • Support efforts to secure long-term commitments and expand revenue across the entire portfolio.

Operational and Investment Leadership

  • Own end-to-end delivery of entrepreneur support programs and investment initiatives running concurrently across the regions, ensuring both are designed and executed at a high standard.
  • Own program and investment quality by reviewing and overseeing delivery standards, supporting direct reports with outputs management, and ensuring work meets organizational and funder expectations.
  • Oversee execution of investment transactions, provide feedback and guidance on investment decisions and transaction structuring, and improve due diligence processes and investment frameworks as needed.
  • Ensure efficient, flexible resource allocation across initiatives as priorities and needs shift.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of investment strategy and entrepreneur support, and contribute to organization-wide learning.
  • Own budgets and expenditure priorities for key operational areas.
  • Collaborate with delivery teams and internal working groups to keep curricula sharp and regionally relevant.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage and support a geographically distributed team, including entrepreneur support delivery staff, investment staff, and contractors.
  • Coach and develop direct reports; run regular 1:1 check-ins and performance conversations.
  • Delegate effectively, matching work to team members' capacity, priorities, and development goals.
  • Build a culture of learning, accountability, and leadership development.

Ecosystem Engagement & Thought Leadership

  • Maintain strategic oversight of ecosystem engagement across regions, including Village Capital alumni and portfolio networks, investor relationships, and expert collaborator networks.
  • Represent Village Capital at key ecosystem convenings and working groups relevant to the regions.
  • Oversee thought leadership content representing your portfolio, providing direction and final review.

Reporting & Funder Communication

  • Lead development and review of region-specific reports for funders and stakeholders, providing oversight and quality assurance rather than direct synthesis.
  • Ensure reporting is supported by the right people and tools, addressing capacity gaps as needed through outside consultants and third-party platform management.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of investment experience in banking, entrepreneurship, impact investing, or international development; entrepreneur support and ecosystem development a plus.
  • A track record of building and running complex, multi-stakeholder lines of business at a high standard.
  • Demonstrated track record in business development, including the ability to develop fundraising strategy, shape proposals, and steward multi-year funder commitments.
  • Experience managing and developing distributed teams across cultures and geographies.
  • Understanding of the early-stage investment landscape, the tools, structures, and language of venture, blended, and philanthropic capital.
  • Experience in the investment space, either from the entrepreneur or investor perspective. Impact investing, venture capital, private credit, or DFI experience preferred.
  • Culturally fluent, with a real, day-to-day commitment to equity.
  • Comfortable operating at a strategic level while staying close enough to spot risk early.
Salary: $120,000-$150,000

Ad Safety & Verification Team

This team builds full stack, high scale products that span Reddit’s consumer-facing apps and ads systems. They own integrations with metrics verification and brand safety partners and operate services that scale to reliably handle tens of millions of requests per day.

jobs.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc.


Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.


Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.


The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI) to join our Innovation team. The role embeds with enterprise clients remotely, with onsite visits as engagements require.


Position Summary

Reporting to the VP, Innovation, Solution Delivery, the Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI) embeds with enterprise clients to design, build and operationalize agentic AI solutions in production. You will build production outcomes for clients, integrate agentic systems with enterprise platforms and systems of record, and stay accountable through cutover, early production and handover to ongoing support. The role is platform-agnostic by design and adapts to whichever AI platform best fits the client, including hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery, scope agentic AI use cases, and translate business problems into engineering deliverables with measurable success criteria such as cycle-time reduction, support deflection, automation rate, security and governance success rate and adoption rate.
  • Design target architectures that fit the client's environment, regulatory posture and platform preferences, selecting the right substrate per engagement across hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.
  • Write production-grade code to deliver the solution, working inside the client's source control, CI/CD and deployment infrastructure, and within enterprise release governance including change approvals, separation of duties, audit evidence and rollback planning.
  • Build and tune retrieval pipelines, prompt architecture, guardrails, agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls that hold under real production variation.
  • Implement enterprise-safe agent tool execution, including permission scoping, approval gates, audit trails and rollback paths for any agent action that touches systems of record.
  • Build evaluation suites that catch hallucinations, regressions, grounding gaps and quality drift, and implement production observability for latency, token usage, error rates, accuracy and output drift.
  • Integrate solutions with client identity, secrets management, network controls, incident response and compliance tooling.
  • Stay engaged through cutover and the first production iteration cycle, then run a structured handover to the ongoing support team, including documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
  • Act as an escalation backup to the support team after handover, stepping back in when issues exceed the support team's depth or when the system needs architectural intervention.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with client engineering, data, security and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly to both engineering teams and C-level audiences.
  • Abstract field learnings into reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures that feed back into Innovation and shape product direction, methodology and the next engagement.

Experience


This is a Principal-level role. We are looking for engineers with the depth to operate independently inside enterprise client environments, the breadth to span production engineering and applied AI, and the demonstrated ability to ship in a discipline that is still being defined. We weight recent, hands-on agentic AI work heavily, recognising that production agentic systems are a young discipline. Equivalent experience from adjacent disciplines, including machine learning engineering, applied AI research with production deployment exposure, or senior backend engineering with recent agentic shipping, is welcomed.

  • 8+ years of professional engineering experience across production systems, with significant production rather than purely advisory time.
  • 2+ years shipping AI or machine learning systems into production, with demonstrated hands-on agentic or LLM-based work.
  • Proven track record working directly with Fortune 500 or Global 2000 enterprise clients in ambiguous, complex environments.
  • Track record of operating across the full lifecycle of a system, including architecture ownership, handover to support and ongoing escalation support.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn fast and ship in emerging technical disciplines. Candidates whose recent agentic AI work was learned quickly on the back of strong fundamentals are explicitly in scope.
  • Enterprise systems-of-record grounding: hands-on experience with an ERP we support (SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards), or strong business-process depth in core enterprise processes such as procurement, finance and order-to-cash. Direct SAP or Oracle E-Business Suite experience preferred.

Skills


  • ERP and enterprise systems experience across SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, infor, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday or other systems of record. Direct SAP and Oracle EBS experience highly valued. Required for ERP-anchored regional seats.
  • Experience with multiple agentic AI platforms, demonstrating ability to deliver on whichever platform the client has standardized on.
  • Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer or equivalent embedded delivery role at an AI lab, hyperscaler or systems integrator.
  • Production Python and at least one additional enterprise or full-stack language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, C# or Scala, including modern agent frameworks and patterns.
  • SQL and data modelling fluency, including the ability to reason about enterprise data quality, lineage, permissions and operational semantics.
  • Hands-on retrieval-augmented generation, including chunking, embeddings, vector stores and reranking.
  • Evaluation suite design for LLM-based systems, including regression detection, hallucination measurement and grounding checks.
  • Production observability for AI systems, including latency, token usage, error rate and output drift instrumentation.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major agentic AI platform such as AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, ServiceNow AI and willingness to learn others as engagements demand.
  • Agent tool execution and governance, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool interfaces, permission scoping, scoped credentials, approval gates, audit trails and safe execution controls.
  • Enterprise integration fundamentals, including REST and event-driven patterns, identity flows such as OIDC and SAML, and secure deployment into client-controlled environments.
  • UI and front-end fluency in modern web frameworks such as Angular, React or equivalent, sufficient to build or extend the user-facing layer of agentic solutions.
  • Durable execution frameworks, event-driven architectures or workflow orchestration at enterprise scale.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication across deep technical and executive audiences, with strong consultative and outcomes-driven instincts. High autonomy, resilience and pragmatism in legacy and politically complex environments, with the proactive discipline needed for effective remote embedding.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or related field, or equivalent practical experience.


Location

Remote - Singapore


Travel

Region-specific (see regional variants of this role). Travel typically 25 percent to work with clients, prospects, partners or attend events.

Why Rimini Street?


We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.


Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company
    • We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues
    • We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients
    • We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
  • Community
    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
  • Over 6,300+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
  • Over 2,000 team members in 23 countries
  • US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:

Overview

DecisionPoint is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developers to support the MODES III program. This individual will design, develop, modernize, test, integrate, and maintain secure enterprise web applications supporting Department of Defense mission requirements. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, modern front-end and back-end technologies, RESTful APIs, cloud-hosted applications, and Agile/DevSecOps delivery in a fast-paced Federal environment.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain responsive enterprise web applications.
  • Develop reusable front-end components and scalable back-end services using approved frameworks and coding standards.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into secure, maintainable software solutions.
  • Troubleshoot defects, perform root-cause analysis, and support production issue resolution.

Oracle APEX and Database Development

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain Oracle APEX applications supporting MODES III business processes.
  • Develop and optimize Oracle SQL, PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects.
  • Integrate Oracle APEX applications with enterprise systems and RESTful services using Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS).
  • Support modernization or migration of legacy applications into Oracle APEX solutions.

API, Integration, and Cloud Support

  • Design, build, document, and maintain secure RESTful APIs and system integrations.
  • Support application deployment and operations in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps engineers to improve CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and deployment automation.
  • Assist with application performance monitoring, tuning, availability, and reliability.

Cybersecurity, Quality, and Compliance

  • Apply secure software development practices and participate in code reviews, automated testing, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to support RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800-53, and Authority to Operate requirements.
  • Develop accessible applications and content consistent with Section 508 requirements.

Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, UX specialists, architects, testers, and Government stakeholders.
  • Provide work estimates, technical documentation, status updates, and knowledge transfer.

The Full Stack Developer will help modernize and sustain MODES III applications that support military members and their families. The role combines hands-on Oracle APEX development, cloud application engineering, secure software delivery, and close collaboration with Government and program stakeholders to deliver reliable, accessible, and mission-focused digital services.

Qualifications

  • Must hold an active Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum 6+ years of enterprise software development experience, including 3+ years performing full stack development.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing and maintaining Oracle APEX applications in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience with Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, ORDS, and RESTful service integration.
  • Experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and at least one modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Experience with one or more back-end technologies such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience using Git-based source control, issue tracking, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted applications in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.

Preferred Experience & Certifications

  • CompTIA Security+ certification is preferred.
  • Experience supporting Federal or Department of War programs.
  • Experience operating in IL4/IL5 or other regulated cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, microservices, container technologies, and infrastructure as code.
  • Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, AWS, or Agile-related certifications are preferred.
  • Experience with SonarQube, Checkmarx, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Docker, or Kubernetes is preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams while managing multiple priorities.
  • Self-starter with strong attention to detail, customer focus, and commitment to software quality and mission outcomes.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Civil Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Civil Engineers to contribute their expertise to a high-impact customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and author authentic civil engineering evaluation tasks reflecting real-world complexity in areas such as structural design, transportation, water systems, and site development.
  2. Source, generate, and curate technical documents including engineering drawings, geotechnical reports, specification sheets, cost estimates, and regulatory code references.
  3. Develop challenging technical problems that require nuanced constraint reasoning and code compliance, mimicking professional engineering scenarios.
  4. Determine the accurate engineering solution for each task, ensuring all relevant regulatory and geometric constraints are satisfied.
  5. Craft comprehensive, multi-item rubrics designed for LLM-based assessment, grading solutions for technical correctness and adherence to codes.
  6. Create and validate high-volume, realistic data files (CSVs, PDFs, spreadsheets) representative of typical project documentation.
  7. Collaborate with project stakeholders to iteratively refine task clarity, realism, and evaluative standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience contributing to civil engineering projects across diverse domains.
  2. Professional Engineer (PE) license or active pursuit of licensure strongly preferred.
  3. Demonstrated mastery in preparing and managing technical documentation, including code-compliance and design specifications.
  4. Experience sourcing and interpreting regulatory codes and integrating them into technical solutions.
  5. Proficiency in generating or reviewing complex technical artifacts such as drawings, reports, and data sets used for project evaluation.
  6. Ability to reason about intricate constraints and deliver solutions that reflect real-world engineering practice.
  7. Strong written communication skills for authoring clear, comprehensive evaluation materials.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.title: Partnership & Growth Associate
jobs.excerpt: About ServiceCentralServiceCentral builds the software that runs product service after the sale: warranty claims, repair authorization, and service execution, for everyone from the local repair shop to the Fortune 50 OEM.
jobs.description:
About ServiceCentral

ServiceCentral builds the software that runs product service after the sale: warranty claims, repair authorization, and service execution, for everyone from the local repair shop to the Fortune 50 OEM. We have been doing it for 25+ years. We are Dell's Partner of the Year, two years running, and our products run service operations across 1,200+ locations in 100+ countries. We are backed by Valsoft Corporation, a permanent-capital owner of 150+ vertical software companies, so we build for the next decade, not the next funding round.

The Role

ServiceCentral is hiring Partnership & Growth Associates to win new customers and grow the ones we bring in. This is a real sales role from day one: you will build your own pipeline, run your own discovery conversations, deliver your own demos, and carry a quota. New business is the priority here, and prospecting is not something you fit around the edges of your week, it is the heart of the job.

You will also own accounts outright, which means you get to see the full arc of a customer relationship rather than one slice of it: winning them, getting them live, growing them, and keeping them. You will build real product depth, get hands-on coaching from people who have done this work themselves, and have experienced support in the room when a deal gets complex. What we are looking for in return is drive, curiosity, and a genuine appetite for hitting a number.

What You Will Own

Pipeline generation and conversion

  • Generate qualified pipeline through outbound calling, email sequences, and social outreach across assigned campaigns, verticals, and territories
  • Sustain consistent, high-volume prospecting activity as the anchor of your week
  • Manage and qualify inbound leads with fast, accurate follow-up and correct routing
  • Research accounts and stakeholders so outreach is personalised rather than generic
  • Run discovery conversations using our qualification framework, and deliver online product demonstrations
  • Close new business against a quarterly quota
  • Hand off opportunities above your authority to Specialists, Managers, or Directors with full context, and earn sourced-pipeline credit
  • Route opportunities on the other platform to your counterpart owner, and earn referral credit

Account ownership

  • Own the full commercial relationship for your assigned portfolio of accounts
  • Maintain a defined contact cadence so no owned account drifts without engagement
  • Execute standard renewals cleanly and on time
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, closing the simple ones and pulling in a Manager or Director on the rest
  • Monitor account health signals and flag at-risk relationships early, before they become recoveries
  • Execute defined save plays on accounts showing risk

Onboarding and time to value

  • Own commercial handoff and welcome communications that set clear expectations
  • Coordinate onboarding with Solutions and Support so customers reach value quickly
  • Track time-to-first-value on your accounts and intervene when it slips
  • Act on or route expansion signals that surface during onboarding

Revenue integrity

  • Audit subscription billing on your accounts to prevent revenue leakage
  • Monitor involuntary churn signals (failed and declined charges) and drive resolution within 24 hours
  • Reconcile the billing platform against internal records so MRR reporting is accurate
  • Verify plan changes (upgrades, downgrades, cancellations) are executed correctly before a customer notices an error
  • Surface systemic billing patterns to your Manager rather than fixing the same problem repeatedly

Enablement and team support

  • Provide day-to-day support on larger accounts held by senior colleagues: routine maintenance, data updates, configuration changes, and low-complexity requests
  • Absorb repeatable work so senior capacity stays on new business and strategic pursuits
  • Create and maintain customer-facing Knowledge Base and self-service content that drives adoption and reduces inbound volume
  • Verify release notes for accuracy and customer clarity before publication
  • Support go-to-market materials and campaign content for upsell and cross-sell motions
  • Support trade shows and events: booth materials, collateral, demo environment readiness, on-site coordination, and lead capture with follow-up

Systems discipline

  • Keep CRM records complete and current, with a scheduled next action on every open opportunity
  • Log activity accurately, because your forecast and your credit both depend on it

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • Commercial drive. You want to carry a number and you want to beat it.
  • Resilience. High-volume outreach means high-volume rejection. You need to make the next call sound like the first one.
  • Coachability. This tier exists partly to develop you. The people who progress fastest ask for feedback and visibly act on it.
  • Process discipline. You will run recurring operational workflows (billing audits, cadence management, CRM hygiene) that protect revenue. Reliability here is the foundation of customer trust.
  • Commercial instinct. You notice when a routine support question is actually an expansion signal, and you do something about it.
  • Clear written communication. Your emails, customer-facing content, and CRM notes are all read by someone who will judge us on them.
  • Customer empathy. You will handle billing disputes and pricing conversations. Doing that well protects both the relationship and the revenue.
  • Curiosity about the platform. The Associates who become Specialists learned their platform properly, not just the pitch.

Autonomy and Escalation

You operate inside a structured playbook with a clear escalation path. Escalation is a strength at this tier, not a weakness.

Decide yourself: standard pricing and terms, routine renewals, day-to-day account management within cadence.

Escalate:

  • Any discount request, however small
  • Any at-risk account signal, immediately
  • Billing discrepancies above defined thresholds
  • Growth opportunities in your accounts that need a Manager or Director, routed with full context
  • Requests for non-standard contract terms, service commitments, or SLAs

Benefits

Quota and Compensation

You will carry a quarterly quota weighted heavily toward new business, with expansion and renewal making up the balance. Quota is set from your assigned accounts and territory rather than a generic benchmark, and it ramps across your first two quarters so you are not held to full target while you are still learning.

Compensation is a competitive base plus variable, with the variable tied to new business won, pipeline quality, and team performance. We will walk you through targets, weightings, and exactly how performance is measured during the interview process.

Where This Leads

Associate is the first rung of a four-tier track. Typical progression to Partnership & Growth Specialist takes 12 to 24 months.

To be promoted you will need to show:

  • Two consecutive quarters at or above quota
  • Clean, independent ownership of your named accounts
  • Ability to run discovery unsupervised
  • Evidence you have informally coached at least one peer

Compensation and logistics

  • On-target earnings: $130k CAD (base ~$50-70k plus variable). Variable is tied to closed-won new business. When our MD or CCO leads the close on an enterprise deal, you share in the win for the pipeline you built and advanced
  • Full benefits
  • Remote within Canada, with working hours that overlap Eastern Time, where most of our team sits.
  • Some travel expected, predominantly within North America

ServiceCentral is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applicants of every background.

jobs.description:
Overview

Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high-performance scientific instruments and high-value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular, and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nanoanalysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

Today, worldwide more than 11,000 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations on all continents. Bruker continues to build upon its extensive range of products and solutions, its broad base of installed systems and a strong reputation among its customers. Being one of the world's leading analytical instrumentation companies, Bruker is strongly committed to further fully meeting its customers’ needs as well as continuing to develop state-of-the-art technologies and innovative solutions for today's analytical questions.

The Bruker NANO group is seeking a Staff SW Engineer for Windows Instrumentation and Automation. The Senior Software Engineer will provide programming design and development for Bruker’s world leading nano-scale Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) product lines. You will work with other software developers, engineers, and scientists supporting and advancing the state-of-the art nanoscale systems technology by developing software from application design to hardware control. This position requires initiative, innovation, and responsibility working within a cooperative team environment to support existing and realize new customer products.

Location and Work Model

Santa Barbara, California, or fully remote. Remote employees must be able to collaborate effectively with a Santa Barbara-based team with no more than a three-hour time difference. Remote employees may be asked to travel to Santa Barbara up to two times per year.

Position Summary

Join the team building software for the world's most capable automated atomic force microscopes used in leading semiconductor fabs. Our software operates precision hardware, turns complex measurements into reliable results, and gives scientists and engineers intuitive control over sophisticated instruments.

We are seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to own architecture and implementation across Windows desktop applications, real-time and non-real-time instrument workflows, hardware integration, automation, data acquisition, processing, persistence, and interactive visualization. You will provide technical leadership without stepping away from production code.

This is a Windows desktop, scientific instrumentation, and hardware-control position. It is not a web, mobile, or cloud application development role. Candidates whose experience is primarily web application development will not meet the core requirements.

Agentic software development is part of how our team engineers software, not an occasional productivity aid. We use GitHub Copilot Business with leading AI models throughout design, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review. The successful candidate will bring meaningful production experience with AI coding agents and will be expected to use and advance these workflows responsibly.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, implement, debug, test, and deploy production software for automated scientific instruments and semiconductor metrology systems.- Develop responsive, multithreaded Windows applications using C#, .NET, WPF, and modern C++/STL.- Integrate desktop software with precision motion, nano-positioning, vision, data-acquisition, control, and automation subsystems.- Design low-latency software that coordinates real-time hardware behavior with non-real-time workflows, data persistence, and intuitive interactive controls.- Own architecture for new capabilities and guide their integration into a mature product codebase through sound interfaces, layering, refactoring, and incremental delivery.- Diagnose complex behavior across software and hardware boundaries; lead technical investigations, articulate options and risks, and drive issues to resolution.- Lead software integration and product deployments in partnership with applications, systems, hardware, test, and manufacturing engineering teams.- Remain deeply hands-on while providing technical direction and raising engineering quality across a small cross-functional team.- Use VS Code and AI coding agents as core engineering tools across the software development lifecycle while applying rigorous technical judgment to all generated work.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience developing complex production systems.- 3+ years of hands-on Windows application development using both C#/.NET/WPF and modern C++/STL.- Strong object-oriented design, API design, debugging, and refactoring skills in a substantial existing codebase.- Demonstrated experience designing and debugging multithreaded, asynchronous, and performance-sensitive Windows software.- Experience integrating software with hardware, instruments, robotics, automation equipment, or other physical systems with timing and reliability constraints.- Experience building interactive desktop user interfaces and the underlying application, data, and device-control layers.- Demonstrated architecture ownership and technical leadership across subsystem or product boundaries.- Meaningful, regular use of GitHub Copilot or comparable AI coding agents on production software. Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific examples spanning multiple development activities and how they ensure correctness and maintainability.- Ability to collaborate clearly with engineers and domain experts, communicate designs and risks, and lead technical work without direct authority.

Education

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field is strongly preferred.- A BS in a related field combined with significant relevant industry, instrumentation, or research experience will be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with C++/CLI, managed/native interoperability, or MFC in a production Windows codebase.- Experience with scientific instrumentation, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, metrology, robotics, machine vision, motion control, nano-positioning, or automated test equipment.- Experience using architectural layering across hardware interfaces, control logic, data processing, persistence, and desktop presentation layers.- Familiarity with signal or image processing, pattern recognition, numerical methods, or analysis of scientific data.- Domain knowledge of atomic force microscopy, optical spectroscopy, surface metrology, physics, chemistry, or microbiology.- Experience with Scrum or another Agile development approach and a record of improving practical engineering processes.- Experience making effective use of both VS Code and Visual Studio in a Windows development environment.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  • When working onsite, ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 30 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.- Ability and willingness to work periodically in a Class 1000 cleanroom using full gowning protocol and laboratory-appropriate attire. These requirements also apply to remote employees during onsite visits.

At Bruker, base salary is part of our total compensation. The estimated base salary range for this full-time position is between $107,100 and $190,000 and provides an opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base salary for the role will depend on a several job-related factors, including, but not limited to education, training, experience, the geographic location of the successful candidate, skills, competencies, job-related knowledge and travel requirements for this position. Full-time employees may also be eligible for a performance-related incentive in addition to a full range of benefits including 401(k) with company match, an employee stock purchase plan, medical and dental plans, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance, employee assistance program and paid time off including vacation, sick time and holidays, and more.

Bruker is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Certain positions at Bruker require compliance with export control laws and as a result, all interviewed candidates for all positions will be screened pre-interview to determine their eligibility in light of export control restrictions.

jobs.description:
Overnight Digital Health Clinician – Registered Nurse

Work from Home | Australia-Wide | Dedicated Overnight Shifts | Night-Shift Uplift

What if your next night shift started at home?

Right now, a dedicated team of Registered Nurses are working overnight from home, providing clinical assessment, triage and health advice to people across Australia.

It’s a different way to use your nursing experience. You’ll assess and support people across a broad range of health concerns, using your clinical experience to determine what care they need and how urgently they need it. One call might involve reassuring a concerned parent, while the next could require you to identify clinical deterioration, assess risk or determine that urgent medical care is needed.

If overnight hours suit you, this is an opportunity to continue using your clinical skills and judgement in a role that offers the benefits of working from home, while making a meaningful difference to people across Australia.

Your experience and clinical judgement will be at the heart of what you do.

What You'll Do

As a Digital Health Clinician, you'll use your nursing experience, assessment skills and clinical judgement to:

  • Conduct telephone-based clinical assessments and triage
  • Provide evidence-based health advice across adult and paediatric presentations
  • Assess clinical risk and recognise when escalation is required
  • Support acute, sub-acute and mental health presentations
  • Recommend appropriate care pathways
  • Refer callers to GPs, Urgent Care Clinics, Virtual Emergency Departments and other appropriate health services

Work From Home — Without Working Alone

Working remotely doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll be part of a connected clinical team, with experienced Clinical Leads available throughout your shift for support, guidance and a second clinical perspective when you need it.

As one of our clinicians puts it:

“You are alone, but you are not. We have a really engaging team on Microsoft Teams and the Clinical Leads are incredibly supportive, they will guide you when you need it.”

It's also a role where experienced nurses continue to learn. Every shift brings different presentations, conversations and opportunities to strengthen your assessment skills and clinical decision-making.

“I'm constantly learning in this role, every shift builds my confidence and clinical judgement.”

Why Work With Us?

  • Work from home anywhere in Australia
  • No commute to or from your overnight shift
  • Dedicated overnight shift with uplift for qualifying hours
  • Continue using your clinical assessment, critical-thinking and decision-making skills
  • Make a meaningful difference to patients across Australia
  • Be part of a connected and supportive remote clinical team
  • Comprehensive paid training to support your transition into digital healthcare

Hours & Key Details

  • Full-time and part-time opportunities
  • Minimum 32 hours per fortnight
  • Minimum 6-hour shifts
  • Overnight hours are between 9:00 pm and 6:00 am AEST, with a night-shift uplift applying to all hours worked within this window
  • Fixed shifts within the 9:00 pm–6:00 am overnight window may be negotiable
  • Initial contract through to 30 June 2027

About You

You're an experienced Registered Nurse with strong clinical judgement who is comfortable assessing risk, making clinical decisions and communicating with people who may be anxious, uncertain or unsure what to do next.

You'll bring experience in acute care, emergency nursing, critical care or complex primary healthcare and be ready to apply those skills in a digital environment.

Essential requirements:

  • Current unrestricted AHPRA registration
  • Minimum four years' post-graduate RN experience in the required clinical areas, gained within the last five years
  • Strong clinical assessment, critical-thinking and communication skills
  • Confidence using digital systems and technology
  • Reside and work within Australia

Experience across mental health, adult and paediatric presentations or previous telehealth experience is highly regarded.

Paid Training

As a Digital Health Clinician, you’ll need to be confident working with technology and navigating multiple digital systems as part of your everyday practice.

We'll provide comprehensive paid training before you begin working independently. You'll have the opportunity to become familiar with our systems, clinical pathways and the skills involved in telephone-based assessment and triage.

Please note: Availability to attend two weeks of full-time Monday–Friday training is mandatory.

Ready for a Different Kind of Night Shift?

If overnight hours work for you and you’re looking for a different way to use your nursing experience, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a supportive team of experienced nurses, work from home, and use your clinical skills to make a meaningful difference to people across Australia.

Apply now to join our overnight Digital Health team.

For enquiries, please contact:

Andrian Publico
Culture and Performance Support Officer

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You'll Own

  • Build AI-powered workflows, assistants, agents and automation systems.

  • Apply AI across customer support, CRM, onboarding, claims, renewals, payments, operations and internal tools.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to turn manual processes into scalable AI-native systems.

  • Build integrations with LLMs, internal data, APIs, documents, knowledge bases and business systems.

  • Design evaluation, monitoring and fallback flows so AI outputs are useful, safe and reliable.

  • Prototype quickly, test with users or operators, then productionize what works.

  • Improve speed, quality and consistency across workflows using AI where it creates real business value.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering foundation, preferably with Python and backend systems.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agents, RAG, workflow automation or AI tools.

  • Able to connect AI systems with real product, data and operational workflows.

  • Good judgement on where AI helps and where rule-based systems or human review are better.

  • Understands evaluation, accuracy, latency, cost, privacy and failure modes.

  • Fast builder who can prototype, test and ship practical systems.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, support automation, CRM or operations automation is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Practical AI builder, not just a prompt experimenter.

  • Thinks in workflows, systems and measurable quality.

  • Can build quickly but still cares about guardrails and reliability.

  • Comfortable working with messy real-world data and processes.

  • Honest about what AI can and cannot do.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

  • People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.
