Description/Responsibilities

We are seeking a Director of Data Engineering to lead the Enterprise Data Foundation (EDF) team at Tivity Health. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of our enterprise data platform — spanning ingestion, transformation, storage, and delivery — across two distinct business domains: our core Fitness business and our Whole Health Living (WHL) healthcare business.

The Director will manage a team of approximately 10 engineers and QA professionals, set technical direction for platform architecture and evolution, and partner cross-functionally with Data Governance, BI & Reporting, Product Engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure data infrastructure meets both current operational needs and future strategic objectives. This is primarily a people management and technical leadership role — the successful candidate must be able to review architectural decisions, evaluate code and pipeline designs, and direct engineering execution, not simply approve timesheets.

This role reports to the VP of Data and works as a peer alongside the BI & Reporting Lead and the Senior Data Governance Strategist within the Data Management department.

Responsibilities:

People Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of ~10 data engineers and QA professionals across ETL development, platform operations, and quality assurance.
  • Conduct performance management including goal-setting, regular 1:1s, career development planning, and performance reviews.
  • Drive team capacity planning, hiring, and onboarding for new engineering and QA roles.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate workload across team members, balancing project delivery, operational support, and technical debt reduction.

Data Architecture & Platform Strategy

  • Own the architectural vision for Tivity Health's enterprise data platform, spanning Snowflake, AWS data services, and on-premises legacy systems.
  • Define and execute the platform evolution roadmap, including modernization of batch ETL toward real-time and event-driven architectures, adoption of open table formats (Apache Iceberg), and progressive elimination of legacy infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies (e.g., zero-ETL integrations, lakehouse patterns, streaming CDC) aligned to business needs and total cost of ownership.
  • Ensure platform designs support scalability, reliability, security, and compliance requirements across both Fitness and WHL healthcare domains.
  • Establish and enforce data engineering standards, patterns, and best practices for pipeline development, infrastructure-as-code, testing, and deployment.
  • Partner with Data Governance to ensure platform architecture enables cataloging, lineage, quality measurement, and access control at enterprise scale.

Engineering Delivery & Operations

  • Oversee design, development, and maintenance of production ETL pipelines (AWS Glue, DMS, Snowflake Tasks) processing data from RDS, DynamoDB, MSSQL, Oracle EBS, SaaS APIs, and file-based sources into Snowflake.
  • Own pipeline reliability and incident response, maintaining 99%+ ETL success rates across both Fitness and WHL platforms.
  • Direct the team's infrastructure-as-code practice (Pulumi) for all Snowflake and AWS resource provisioning and change management.
  • Review and approve architectural decisions, pipeline designs, data models, and production changes — ensuring technical rigor without being the bottleneck.
  • Drive the completion of legacy platform migration (on-premises SQL Server reporting to Snowflake) and retirement of end-of-life systems.
  • Manage operational metrics, SLAs, and capacity planning for data infrastructure (compute, storage, pipeline throughput).

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with the BI & Reporting team to ensure the consumption layer (Tableau, S3 exports, client deliverables) has performant, reliable, well-documented data assets.
  • Collaborate with Data Governance on data quality rule implementation, business term definitions, catalog completeness, and compliance controls.
  • Work with Product Engineering and DevOps on shared infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform security.
  • Communicate platform status, risks, and roadmap to senior IT leadership and business stakeholders.

Platform Scope

The EDF team owns and operates the foundational data platform that all analytics, reporting, governance, and data science teams consume. The current platform includes:

  • Snowflake Data Cloud — AWS Data tooling
  • Snowflake Tasks
  • Infrastructure-as-Code — Pulumi-managed deployments for all Snowflake resources (databases, schemas, roles, warehouses, tasks) and AWS resources (Glue, S3, IAM, DMS).
  • Legacy Systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related quantitative field preferred. Experience in lieu of education will be considered.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or data architecture roles.
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience leading technical teams.
  • Expert-level SQL proficiency and working knowledge of Python for data engineering.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or Databricks) at enterprise scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to define and execute multi-year platform modernization roadmaps.
  • Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment (healthcare, financial services, or similar).

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data platform roles.
  • 5+ years in a management or leadership role directing data engineering teams of 5+ members.
  • Deep expertise with Snowflake (architecture, performance tuning, security model, cost optimization) and AWS data services (Glue, DMS, S3, Lambda, Lake Formation).
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating layered data warehouse architectures (Raw/Staging → Integration → Presentation → Analytics/Consumption).
  • Strong background in ETL/ELT pipeline design, including incremental loading patterns, change data capture, SCD Type 2, and data quality validation.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi, Terraform, or CDK) for managing cloud data resources through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with modern data platform patterns: Apache Iceberg / open table formats, lakehouse architectures, event-driven / streaming pipelines, and zero-ETL integrations.
  • Experience with healthcare data systems (claims adjudication, eligibility, provider networks) is strongly preferred given the WHL domain scope.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, metadata management, data cataloging, and lineage — sufficient to partner effectively with a dedicated governance function.
  • Experience managing both engineering and QA disciplines within a data platform team.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical platform decisions into business value for non-technical stakeholders.

The salary range for this opportunity is $137,700 to $175,000. Compensation depends on several factors: qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience.

Overview

Nakupuna Companies is seeking a Senior Computer Systems Engineer/Architect with Informatica expertise to join our team of talented consultants. The individual will provide solution architecture execution strategy for the Informatica implementation in NAVSUP AWS GovCloud. This role is responsible for the cross-platform design, Everything as Code approach, security architecture, availability and recovery strategy, CI/CD practices, technical integration decisions, and day-to-day engineering coordination needed to move the solution from architecture through production sustainment.

The individual will support NAVSUP Business Systems Center as the senior solution architect for the design, integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and sustainment of the Informatica Data Governance Suite within NAVSUP’s AWS GovCloud environment. Develop the cross-platform architecture and engineering standards for high availability, disaster recovery, security, Everything as Code, CI/CD, monitoring, configuration management, and change control. Coordinate technical activities across the Informatica, database, cloud, cybersecurity, and testing workstreams; identify architecture dependencies and risks; and ensure technical artifacts are secure, reproducible, supportable, and ready for Government review. Support RMF/ATO activities, performance and capacity planning, operational readiness, and knowledge transfer to NAVSUP personnel.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to mission requirements and reasonable accommodation.

  • Develop the high-availability architecture recommendation and agile prototype, including component sizing, dependencies, network design, compute, storage, load balancing, capacity, and cost considerations.
  • Define reliability objectives, RTO and RPO targets, failover strategies, backup and retention methods, restoration procedures, disaster-recovery tests, and rollback plans.
  • Lead the Everything as Code approach across infrastructure, configuration, security, governance policy, testing, and CI/CD deployment; ensure artifacts are reproducible and retained in Government version control.
  • Design AWS GovCloud resources and controls, including EC2, S3, networking, routing, security groups, load balancers, IAM roles, service accounts, logging, monitoring, and approved encryption.
  • Establish technical standards for source control, branching, peer review, automated testing, automated deployment, configuration management, and change control.
  • Lead security engineering for PKI, SSO, LDAP, OCSP, certificates, RBAC, least privilege, Zero Trust, logging, vulnerability remediation, and integration with NAVSUP security operations.
  • Coordinate RMF/ATO and STIG compliance activities, including control mappings, diagrams, system-security documentation, hardening evidence, POA&M inputs, retesting, and closure support.
  • Guide Informatica platform architecture, data integration, performance testing, interoperability, and operational-readiness decisions across the team.
  • Review and approve internal technical designs, scripts, code, configurations, tests, diagrams, runbooks, and deployment packages for quality, consistency, security, and supportability.
  • Establish continuous monitoring for availability, performance, errors, capacity, cost, API metrics, and data-quality indicators using CloudWatch, Splunk, AppDynamics, Informatica, or comparable tools.
  • Coordinate technical risk management, issue resolution, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, sprint planning, milestone reviews, Government briefings, and stakeholder decision support.
  • Plan and deliver hands-on knowledge transfer so NAVSUP administrators and engineers can operate, maintain, recover, and enhance the solution.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

Skills/Qualifications:

In addition to being able to confidently perform the above job duties, the candidate should demonstrate the following:

  • Technical Leadership - Provides clear day-to-day direction across Informatica, AWS, security, testing, and sustainment work; reviews designs and engineering artifacts critically and resolves cross-platform risks before they reach production.
  • Agile / DevSecOps - Turns architecture into prioritized, testable work with clear dependencies, acceptance criteria, and decision points; establishes repeatable source-control, peer-review, automated-testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Analytical / Problem Solving - Balances mission needs, security, reliability, performance, capacity, recovery, cost, and long-term supportability; uses evidence and prototypes to resolve uncertainty and clearly frames options for Government decisions.
  • Communication / Teamwork - Communicates technical issues, risks, and tradeoffs in terms that both engineers and Government leaders can act on; creates a collaborative environment across a small multidisciplinary team and external stakeholders.
  • Quality / Coaching - Sets and enforces standards for architecture, code, configuration, tests, diagrams, runbooks, and security evidence; builds Government ownership through practical mentoring, recorded walkthroughs, and current sustainment documentation.

Education and Experience:

Education: A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or a related technical field is preferred.

Required experience: The candidate must be able to demonstrate the following:

  • 7 years of hands-on Informatica experience
  • 10 years of senior-level experience architecting working with enterprise platforms in AWS or AWS GovCloud from design through production operations.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, storage, networking, security groups, load balancing, identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, performance, capacity, and cost optimization.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Security or Policy as Code, automated testing, Git-based version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience designing high availability, backup, disaster recovery, RTO/RPO, failover, restoration testing, and rollback for production systems.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise API, data-integration, data-governance, metadata, data-quality, and relational data-warehouse architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of RMF/ATO, STIGs, NIST 800-53 controls, system hardening, PKI, SSO, RBAC, logging, vulnerability remediation, and Zero Trust concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small multidisciplinary engineering team and work directly with Government technical, security, contracting, and program stakeholders.
  • Ability to review technical work critically, resolve cross-platform issues, manage risk, and maintain clear architecture and operational documentation.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to meet all privileged-access, background-investigation, CAC, SAAR, training, certification, and NDA requirements.

Preferred experience: The following experience will strengthen the candidate's fit for this role:

  • Recent AWS GovCloud architecture and DevSecOps experience supporting DoD or other Federal production systems.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, AWS Security Specialty, or comparable current certification.
  • Experience with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, or comparable IaC/CaC tooling and Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines.
  • Architecture or technical-lead experience involving MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and Informatica Enterprise Data Catalog, Axon, Data Quality, or PowerCenter.
  • Experience integrating CloudWatch, Splunk, AppDynamics, or comparable observability platforms with enterprise applications.
  • Prior experience with Navy data, WDP/Jupiter, Flank Speed, Microsoft Power Platform, logistics systems, or Government API-management initiatives.

Certifications:

Required: Current DoD 8140.03 IAT Level II baseline certification at the start of performance: CompTIA Security+ CE or a PWS-listed substitute (CCNA, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, or CND).

Required within six months: An applicable computing-environment certification in AWS, Windows, Oracle, UNIX, or Linux, coordinated to the assigned environment.

Clearance and access: This position requires U.S. citizenship, CAC eligibility, and a final, favorably adjudicated T5, T5R, SSBI, or equivalent investigation before privileged access is granted. Interim privileged access is authorized. The certification requirements stated above also apply.

  3. Demonstrated excellence in synthesizing large volumes of material into engaging, structured narratives.
  4. Track record of rigorous source validation, fact-checking, and verifiable reporting (not opinion or commentary).
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly.

Senior Customer Service Manager
Location: Remote

Join a dynamic growth marketing agency where precision meets creativity
At STERRY, we're not your average marketing agency—we're the rocket fuel behind crowdfunding and e-commerce success. Since day one, we've helped clients generate over $100 million in trackable online revenue through strategies rooted in measurable performance.

About the Role
The Senior Customer Service Manager will lead, align, and scale the entire Customer Service department across all shifts. While the CS Managers run day-to-day operations and coach front-line agents during the AM and PM windows, the Senior Customer Service Manager ensures seamless cross-shift handoffs, sets departmental strategy, owns high-level KPIs, and acts as the strategic bridge between Customer Support, Logistics, Quality, and Executive Leadership.

Key Responsibilities
1. Leadership & Team Governance
  • Directly supervise, mentor, and evaluate the CS Managers to ensure balanced accountability, consistent policy enforcement, and 24-hour operational continuity.
  • Resolve escalated policy ambiguities, complex disputes, or out-of-scope issues that exceed shift manager approval limits.
  • Standardize shift-to-shift handoff protocols to prevent dropped tickets, missed social inquiries, or fragmented case ownership.
2. Strategy, Process & Documentation
  • Own the overarching CS strategy, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and the CS Handbook—ensuring all process updates implemented by managers remain standardized across both shifts.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks (e.g., recurring claims, chargebacks, shipping delays) and build scalable solutions to minimize ticket volume and resolution time.
  • Direct workforce planning, shift scheduling models, and coverage contingency plans for peak seasons, leaves, and unexpected spikes.
3. Performance Tracking & KPI/OKR Ownership
  • Synthesize weekly reports from CS managers into actionable department-wide performance summaries for executive review.
  • Define, track, and elevate department benchmarks: CSAT, First Response Time (FRT), Resolution Time, Quality Assurance (QA) scores, and Shopify chargeback win rates.
  • Monitor agent coaching trends and calibration sessions to ensure grading consistency between both shift managers.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Quality
  • Lead weekly feedback loops with Logistics/Shipping regarding carrier and 3PL fulfillment claims, shipping delays, and inventory inaccuracies.
  • Analyze consolidated defect reports, customer complaints, and chargeback trends; deliver root-cause insights to Product, Marketing, and Operations to prevent recurring issues.
  • Partner with Social Media/Marketing teams to ensure engagement standards on Meta Business Suite and other public channels are met or exceeded.

What We’re Looking For
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Management, or a related field is a plus—but what truly matters is your leadership mindset and ability to steer high-performing teams. Eagerness to learn is just as valued as experience.
  • Experience: 10+ years in Customer Support/Service operations, with at least 8+ years leading managers, shift leads, or multi-shift teams (e-commerce background strongly preferred).
  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Shopify, 3PLs, Meta Business Suite, helpdesk CRMs (Zendesk, Gorgias, Freshdesk, etc.), and Google Workspace/Sheets.
  • Analytical Skills: Proven ability to turn defect trackers, dispute data, and shift callouts into actionable operational improvements.
  • Leadership: Strong track record in leadership coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution across asynchronous or multi-shift teams.

Why Join STERRY?
We’re a global, fast-moving agency that’s obsessed with pushing creative and digital boundaries. You’ll work alongside a diverse and collaborative team, and the support to help you grow.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your skills in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Dedicated Care Coordinator Ohio Valley
jobs.excerpt: Why Patients Need YouThe Inflammation and Immunology Dedicated Care Coordinator (DCC) is a non-promotional, field-based role that supports patients’ access to PDPA and VFM products when prescribed by a licensed healthcare provider.
jobs.description:
Why Patients Need You

The Inflammation and Immunology Dedicated Care Coordinator (DCC) is a non-promotional, field-based role that supports patients’ access to PDPA and VFM products when prescribed by a licensed healthcare provider. The DCC owns the continual management and progression of the patient journey — from HUB enrollment through post-fill follow-up — working directly with patients, providers, payers, HUB partners, and third-party vendors. It is a dual patient- and HCP-facing role spanning a patient journey, and the colleague in this role carries 100% ownership of every case in their assigned geography.

What You Will Achieve

The DCC is a subject-matter expert on reimbursement, access, and coverage issues that can educate patients/caregivers and healthcare providers on matters relating to reimbursement, access, and coverage. The DCC will serve as the primary point of contact for patients/caregivers and healthcare providers regarding the status of their request for reimbursement support and access assistance and will also provide updates to patients/caregivers and healthcare providers on their status as appropriate. The DCC holds end-to-end case ownership: benefits investigation and verification, prior authorization and appeals support, appointment and baseline assessment coordination, Interim Care and voucher administration, copay support, prescription triage, and scheduled post-fill follow-up.

How You Will Achieve It

Case Ownership and the Patient Journey

  • Own 100% of assigned cases and drive the continual management and progression of the patient journey, from HUB enrollment through post-fill follow-up

  • Be the central point-of-contact for patients/caregivers and HCP providers regarding the status of their request for reimbursement and access support related to a patient case.

  • Answer questions from patients/caregivers relating to access and coverage

  • Maintain a clear understanding of the patient access journey and requirements at each stage of the process, as well as the role played by patients/caregivers and HCP providers in the process

  • Support access with HCPs and opted-in patients/caregivers who have been prescribed a PDPA OR VFM product

Benefits Investigation and Financial Navigation

  • Conduct the Summary of Benefits (SOB) discussion required for every HUB-enrolled patient, reviewing both the product benefit structure, any associated cost and the baseline appointments for VFM

  • Obtain all missing information on the Patient Enrollment Form (PEF) and verify the testing, voucher, and Interim Care options selected by the HCP office

  • Walk the patient through out-of-pocket cost, deductibles, copay options, and the reimbursement program, including the impact of maximizers and accumulators

  • Verify coverage for the product and for required baseline tests across both PBM and major medical insurance for VFM

  • Oversee the entire prior authorization process, including submission and verification with both the patient and the provider

  • Conduct benefit investigation and verification (BI/BV) calls directly with payers and patients for patients with 3rd party restrictions

  • Confirm and communicate product coverage, cost, prior authorization and appeal requirements, Interim Care program PA and Appeal deadlines, and baseline assessment tests to HCP and patient

Appointment and Assessment Coordination

  • Schedule, reschedule and confirm patient appointments in coordination with the patient, the provider, and the vendor

  • Secure the appropriate confirmation communication back from the provider (CFT)

  • Coordinate compliantly with IQVIA/MDX on patient assessment tests — confirm tests are completed and reschedule where needed

Program and Copay Administration

  • Once IC is approved, manage all Interim Care (IC) program administrative requirements and deadlines with the provider and the patient, including Extended Interim Care programs

  • Confirm voucher need and eligibility with the provider and patient, and triage the voucher for shipment to the patient

  • Maintain Copay portal access and help approved commercial patients secure a copay card

  • Own copay eligibility attestation responsibility

  • Follow up with the patient post-fill to confirm the copay card is functioning correctly

Prescription Triage, Fulfillment, and Ongoing Follow-Up

  • Triage the voucher, paid prescription, and/or Interim Care fill within Polaris

  • Contact the patient at 10 days and again at 45 days post-prescription, confirming that no logistical or financial questions remain outstanding

Case and Systems Ownership

  • Manage and update various case types in Polaris, using its texting, faxing, and prescription triage capabilities

  • View and interpret prior authorization, appeal, and PEF documentation for accuracy

  • Share and manage cases with HUB partners across all patient journeys

  • Coordinate as appropriate with other Pfizer colleagues and Patient Support Program/HUB employees, via tasks and secure messages to requests for action, to help resolve problems with individual patient cases

  • Maintain case comments as a real-time account of the patient journey, including a recap of every call made to the HCP and the patient

  • Use the Kite works encrypted email system for correspondence with patients and providers

  • Manage the Docusign process with patients to obtain required consents

  • Develop an organized, concise, and compliant way to manage assigned patient cases within established time frames

Compliance, Safety Reporting, and Communication

  • Report adverse events (AEs) in accordance with company requirements — AE reporting volume is elevated in this role, patient contact is more frequent and spans the entire patient journey

  • Operate within the tighter content controls and system permissions that apply to this role

  • Compliantly communicate the access landscape and options to patients/caregivers and HCPs

  • Link the patient access support to meet patient needs, using Brand RC-approved materials

  • Conduct yourself with the utmost discretion and confidentiality

  • Adhere to strict company compliance guidelines and procedures

  • Work and lead cross-functionally with internal and external colleagues, compliantly, to improve the patient access journey

  • Effectively link customer insights to the offerings and approved resources to address patient access barriers

  • Build trust through compliant follow-up and knowledge of the access journey

  • Demonstrate excellence in responsible business communication, both written and spoken

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • B.S. or B.A. Degree 8+ years of pharmaceutical (or related) experience in customer-facing roles/functions.

  • 6 months minimum as a FRM, PAC, FAS or similar experience in access and Reimbursement and working with Polaris CRM System.

  • Working proficiency in Polaris, including case management and documentation, prescription triage, and interpretation of PA, appeal, and PEF documentation

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate directly with patients, with providers, and with cross-functional colleagues

  • Experience conducting benefit investigation and verification directly with payers, and working knowledge of prior authorization and appeals processes

  • Working knowledge of copay programs, copay maximizers and accumulators, vouchers, and free or interim care programs

  • Ability to own a high volume of concurrent cases across a patient journey that could average approximately 20 days, with disciplined documentation and follow-through

  • Ability to meet adverse event reporting obligations in a role with frequent, direct patient contact

  • Strong understanding of Reimbursement, Government Payment Systems, Specialty Pharmacy Networks, Co-Pay Assistance Programs, and knowledge of the Specialty Medication area.

  • Appropriate and compliant communication and collaboration with cross-functional field-based colleagues (Sales, Medical, FRM, PCA/SAS, KAD, Government Relations) to ensure optimal and appropriate patient access in both in-patient and out-patient accounts.

  • Alignment with HQ stakeholders to ensure appropriate understanding of, and support for patient access (e.g., Brand and Customer Marketing teams and PCA/SAS teams).

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in a Patient and/or customer facing role requiring access and reimbursement education.

  • Experience working with a HUB.

  • Experience with Kite works or a comparable encrypted email platform, Docusign, and copay portal administration

  • Experience coordinating with third-party vendors on patient assessment, testing, or specialty pharmacy logistics (e.g., IQVIA/MDX, Sonexus)

  • Experience supporting Interim Care, free goods, or bridge programs

  • Experience with both pharmacy benefit (PBM) and major medical benefit coverage pathways

Knowledge & Skill Sets Desired:

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Exceptional relationship building skills, especially with elderly age groups

  • Trust

  • Integrity

  • Empathy

  • Patience

  • Deliver meaningful & concise presentations

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Exceptional critical thinking skills, ability to understand complex processes and effectively communicate to diverse community of patients

  • Outstanding collaboration and networking abilities

  • Ability to work in a team environment

  • Understanding of Specialty Pharmaceuticals and Patient Journeys

  • Adherence to Regulatory and Compliance Standards

  • Flexibility to work across different time zones if needed

Other Job Details

  • Work Location Assignment: Remote colleagues from home 5 days a week or are field-based colleagues that are not affiliated with a Pfizer site.

  • Ability to travel – Approximately 10% to 20%

  • Time Zone: Eastern time zone.

  • Eligible for Relocation Package – NO

  • LAST DAY TO APPLY - 9/18/2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $162,900.00 to $271,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.
We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

Protective Life is transforming how it builds and operates software — moving to a product operating model organized around empowered, outcome-oriented teams — and is putting machine learning and generative AI to work in the products that serve our customers. Voyager is one of these product pods, spanning our Life, Annuities, and Employee Benefits lines.

As a JR or SR AI Developer on Voyager, you help build the AI-powered features and services that reach real users — integrating large language models and ML into Voyager's products on our Databricks Lakehouse and Microsoft Azure. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role focused on application engineering with AI. You will build well-scoped features with guidance from senior engineers and the AI/ML Engineering Lead, working closely with product managers, designers, and data engineers. As a regulated life insurer, we expect AI features to be accurate, well-documented, and appropriate in their handling of sensitive customer data.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    JUNIOR:

    • Build AI-powered application features and services on Azure Databricks and Azure — integrating LLMs and ML models into Voyager's products, with guidance on design from senior engineers.
    • Implement GenAI capabilities — retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, prompt and system design, and tool/function calling.
    • Develop and consume APIs and services that expose model capabilities to product surfaces, with attention to latency, reliability, and cost.

    • Instrument AI features for monitoring — output quality, latency, cost, and user feedback — and help iterate based on evidence.

    • Collaborate with product managers and designers to refine AI features through discovery and iteration.

jobs.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Granicus serves more than 7,000 public-sector agencies and powers approximately 30 billion digital interactions annually. Within the Office of the CTO, we operate an AI-native software development lifecycle: a production engineering model in which autonomous agents perform high-confidence implementation work and senior engineers orchestrate, review, and own the outcome. The model is established and operating; we are scaling it across additional delivery teams.

This role joins one of those teams. Our engineering standards are calibrated to the practices used by leading software and AI organizations — generator-verifier architecture, eval-driven development, staged deployment, and high-volume autonomous pull-request pipelines — operated within a FedRAMP-authorized environment. We are hiring practitioners who will set and uphold these standards, not engineers who simply use AI tooling.

Operating constraints (non-negotiable): agents execute only within branches; all agent-generated code passes senior human review before merging to production; autonomous execution is a force multiplier and does not transfer accountability away from the responsible engineer. Compliance obligations — NIST 800-53 Rev 5, WCAG, SOC 2, and applicable FedRAMP authorizations — are treated as engineering requirements and a source of competitive advantage.

Conventional delivery distributes product management, design, and engineering leadership across separate individuals, introducing coordination overhead at each handoff. In an AI-native lifecycle, where implementation throughput is high, those handoffs become the primary constraint. This role consolidates the product, design, and delivery-leadership disciplines into a single accountable owner who synthesizes them rather than displacing the specialists who practice them. The role translates product intent into shipped, compliant software by directing the agent array and implementing front-end experiences directly. It combines the responsibilities of a staff product engineer, a design engineer, and an engineering manager, and requires demonstrated capability across all three.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Own the product outcome of the team end to end — from problem definition through accepted, in-production software. You hold the roadmap commitment and the quality bar.
  • Direct the agent array across three execution modes — Interactive (real-time pairing with an agent), Supervised (agents propose changes; you review and gate each pull request), and Fully Autonomous (agents execute a scoped workstream end to end; you review the output). You determine the appropriate mode for each workstream based on risk and measured agent reliability.
  • Implement production front-end code from the same repository as the engineering team, under engineering review. You deliver the user experience directly rather than specifying it for others to build.
  • Apply product and design rigor at every stage — discovery, user research, information architecture, interaction design, and prioritization — and ensure that increased build velocity does not compromise upstream rigor.
  • Author the prompts, evaluation criteria, and acceptance criteria that convert product intent into work an agent can execute and a verifier can validate.
  • Enforce the human review gate and accessibility standards in partnership with the lead engineer, ensuring no agent-generated code reaches production without senior human review and that WCAG conformance and compliance requirements are designed in from the outset.
  • Set and maintain the team’s delivery cadence and contribute improvements to the shared operating model that other delivery teams adopt.

  • OWNERSHIP FROM DAY ONE

    • Product outcome and roadmap commitment for one delivery team

    • Deliberate use of the three execution modes per workstream

    • Direct authorship of the team’s production front-end code

    • Acceptance criteria and evaluation suites for all team deliverables

  • SCOPE YOU WILL GROW INTO

    • Refinement of the cross-team product-and-design operating model

    • Higher autonomy ratios supported by measured agent reliability

    • A design system and component library that agents build against by default

    • Mentorship of additional product-and-design engineering leads as the model scales

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Required

  • End-to-end product delivery as a builder. You have owned a product surface end to end — making product decisions, designing the experience, and personally writing front-end code deployed to production users.
  • Production front-end engineering. Proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and React (or an equivalent framework), strong CSS, and the ability to move fluently between design files and application code.
  • Design discipline. Demonstrated competence in information architecture, interaction design, and accessibility (WCAG), with the judgment to evaluate experience quality, not only functional completeness.
  • Direction of AI coding agents. Practical experience using coding agents on production work, including a working understanding of their failure modes and the controls required to use them as leverage without compromising quality or review.
  • A track record of defining how teams work. You have established a process, pattern, or standard that other practitioners adopted.
  • High autonomy under ambiguity. You produce structure and direction where none is provided.

Preferred

  • High-assurance or regulated delivery experience. Shipping within FedRAMP, FedRAMP High, defense, financial services, healthcare, or another NIST 800-53 / SOC 2 / HIPAA-bound environment, treating those constraints as design inputs.
  • Public-sector or govtech product experience, including an understanding of constituent- and caseworker-facing use cases.
  • Design-systems ownership. Experience building or maintaining a component library used across multiple teams.
  • Experience operating within an eval-driven or test-first engineering culture at a leading software organization.

Indicators of a strong fit

  • You are effective owning quality for software an agent implemented, and you treat that accountability as central to the role.
  • You can both define the product and implement its interface, and you prefer to do both rather than specialize in one.
  • You hold product positions firmly and revise them quickly in response to evidence.
  • You regard regulatory constraints as design parameters to engineer within, not obstacles to delivery.
  • You want to shape the operating model rather than inherit a fixed process.

Indicators this role is not a fit

  • You require a single, well-bounded discipline — product, or design, or engineering exclusively. This role spans all three.
  • You consider code review outside your responsibility. The review gate is a core part of this role.
  • You are uncomfortable being accountable for output you did not personally author. Autonomy in this model increases ownership, not the reverse.
  • You require fully specified requirements before beginning work. Resolving ambiguity is a central responsibility.
  • You view compliance as overhead to minimize rather than rigor to engineer.

Pay Range

USD $144,000.00 - USD $184,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

As part of the Cotiviti Interoperability University team, this senior-level role specializes in training delivery for Cotiviti proprietary enterprise solutions and technologies for Interoperability solutions. Responsibilities

Customer Training Delivery

1. Interoperability Onboarding

2. Smart Trading Boot Camp

17. California Knowledge Pack

18. New York Knowledge Pack

  • Conduct training needs assessments with customer stakeholders to design, develop and deliver customized content format and depth such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos, or lectures to US Healthcare payer leaders and their IT, support, trainers and business operations teams adopting and upgrading Cotiviti Interoperability solutions.
  • Manage post-training evaluations, collect feedback, generate learning analytics reports, and share insights with customer success teams.
  • Serve as the primary training point-of-contact for assigned customer accounts, directing the training activity integrated with Cotiviti Delivery excellence Framework (DEF) to build and maintain trusted relationships with client leaders, learners, customer trainers and support teams.

Cotiviti Staff Training Delivery

  • Own and deliver instructor-led and virtual staff training programs on unique Cotiviti Interoperability Smart Trading and Encounter Management products, features, and workflows for enterprise clients,
  • Onboard new-hire staff and cross-train staff with unique Cotiviti Interoperability Smart Trading, and Encounter Management training programs that prepare learners from across the company to perform their roles including Cotiviti Interoperability quarterly Boot Camp.
  • Conduct training needs assessments with internal stakeholders to design, develop and deliver customized content format and depth such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos, or lectures to US Healthcare payer leaders and their IT, support, trainers and business operations teams adopting and upgrading Cotiviti Interoperability solutions
  • Manage post-training evaluations, collect feedback, generate learning analytics reports, and share insights with customer success teams.
  • Serve as the primary training point-of-contact for assigned customer accounts, directing the training activity integrated with Cotiviti Delivery excellence Framework (DEF) to build and maintain trusted relationships with client leaders, learners, customer trainers and support teams.

Cotiviti Product Certifications

programs ensuring alignment with product, technology and domain to recognize product knowledge, skill and role-specific performance standards.

  • Apply product expertise to assess advanced-level certification examination results and manually adjudicate certification skill assessment capstone exercises against Cotiviti-defined performance standards to establish and maintain industry-standard recognition of customer and Cotiviti product, services competence.

Subject Matter Expertise & Collaboration

  • Build and maintain deep Cotiviti Interoperability product and healthcare interoperability payer domain expertise to deliver credible, authoritative training to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Expertise in Cotiviti’s intellectual property as evidenced in the Cotiviti proprietary software stack, healthcare EDI transacton standards (X12, HIPAA) and state-specific regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to stay current on product changes, regulatory changes impacting interoperability, Cotiviti implementation methodologies and translate them into training updates.

This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: QRY 101Hey there!  We're QRY, a media-buying agency that specializes in scaling retail brands.
jobs.description:
QRY 101

Hey there! We're QRY, a media-buying agency that specializes in scaling retail brands. We connect brand awareness and performance media to unlock growth, use sophisticated data analytics, and employ a full-funnel marketing strategy to help brands reach their most valuable consumers. We’re a high‑performance, high‑ownership team that values candor, curiosity, and results. We love what we do and the people we do it with.

We’re hiring a Paid Media Strategist to own channel performance across a portfolio of clients. You’ll plan, launch, and optimize social campaigns, keep budgets and pacing tight, and translate data into crisp decisions. You love the details, move with urgency, and can explain complex ideas simply, internally and with clients.

Your day-to-day

This role involves successfully managing client campaigns in the digital advertising space across 4 main sectors:

  • Media Strategy:
    • You plan, book, and optimize paid media campaigns (i.e. Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit) for 6-8 clients, utilizing available media planning tools to develop media plans.
    • You strategize and implement A/B experiments to test audiences, creative, landing pages, offers, etc.
    • You facilitate campaign implementation, including asset collecting and trafficking.
    • With support from Associate Directors, you’ll manage the channel's monthly reporting and strategy sessions with the client, owning overall communication for all channel initiatives.
  • Performance:
    • You scope, develop, and manage channel initiatives to consistently hit the goals for channels across all clients.
    • You act as a strategic advisor and recommend strategic pivots to increase the channel's performance.
  • Reporting + Forecasting:
    • You enthusiastically present reports to clients, highlighting the performance of your channels, how it assisted other channels in the funnel, how it affects the client's business, and recommended next steps.
    • You complete a monthly forecast for respective channels based on budget and/or revenue goals.
  • Cross Channel Strategy + Collaboration:
    • You collaborate with the other media and creative agency team members to ensure the creative specifications of negotiated plans are met.
    • You consistently identify cross-channel strategies / collaborations with clients to improve performance.
    • You effectively communicate with clients on teams' capabilities and opportunities, and proactively offer solutions for ad hoc issues.

How you win

  • Channel performance: You hit agreed KPI targets for your channels (e.g., MER/ROAS, CAC/LTV, revenue, efficiency) within budget and platform guardrails.
  • Learning velocity: You run a disciplined test program with documented hypotheses, win rate, rollout decisions, and measurable lift.
  • Forecast accuracy: You run accurate forecasts on a monthly basis and tie expectations to realistic assumptions.
  • Execution: You deliver decks, reports, and campaign launches with low error rates related to QA or data and you ensure QRY quality is represented in every outcome.

What’s it like here

We’re a high‑performance culture with high support. We’re serious about setting clear goals, providing direct feedback, documenting our progress, and celebrating our wins. You’ll get real ownership, supportive teammates, and the tools to do excellent work.

  • Your first month: You’ll build trust with client and internal partners, learn each brand’s goals and constraints, and align on how success will be measured. You’ll review current channel setups and performance at a high level and agree on priorities and near‑term wins. By the end of the month, you’ll have a good understanding of our clients, their channel set ups, and how our pods work.
  • After month one: You’ll own steady, predictable performance against plans and keep budgets and timelines on track. You’ll communicate often, surface risks early with options, and highlight opportunities for smart growth. The result is consistent delivery, fewer surprises, and clear momentum.

Requirements

✍️​ Experience: You have 2-5 years of successful hands-on paid media management experience in an agency environment. You know the ins and outs of making things run smoothly and have applied successful tactics in a previous role. You have experience leading and managing large media budgets for retail and e-commerce brands, with hands-on experience across paid media platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit. Ideally, you also have experience with programmatic display advertising.

📚 Education: Ideally, you have a bachelor's degree in marketing, science, or a related field.

🔢 Analytical Mindset: You're an analytical thinker. You have experience turning complex data into digestible reports, seeing the big picture, and breaking it down into an actionable plan that gets results. You also have experience with platform-native reporting, GA4, and Looker Studio.

💬​ Communication: Your communication skills are top-notch and you can communicate with senior stakeholders effectively and efficiently.

🧪 Experimentation: You have hands-on experimentation experience, including running A/B tests on audiences, creative, landing pages, or offers and turning results into rollout decisions.

🖥️​ Remote Work Environment: You understand the importance of a clean and quiet work environment suitable for video conferencing. You respect digital etiquette and ensure smooth virtual collaboration.

Benefits

🤑 Competitive salary. We offer a market-rate salary of up to $85,000.00 USD/year, based on experience.

💰 Quarterly bonuses. Enjoy quarterly bonuses tied to company revenue.

🏠 USA remote flexibility. Choose your ideal workspace, whether it’s your home office or a coffee shop.

🌴 Time off made easy. Take advantage of our unlimited PTO policy.

🏥 Comprehensive healthcare. We offer exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance, fully covered for employees by QRY. We also offer a $100 monthly budget for your wellbeing, i.e. gym memberships, coworking day pass, etc.

📈 Secure your future. Participate in our 401k program with a company match.

🌱 Growth and development. Nurture your learning and development with our investment to L&D, growth opportunities, and tools such as our Learning & Development Philosophy + Policy, role matrices, and skill assessments.

💻 Latest tech. Team members are provided with the latest Macbook Pro and a one-time $500 stipend to set up their at-home workspace.

🥳 Celebrate and connect. Join us for annual team retreats (we’ve been to Austin, Tennessee, and Utah to name a few), weekly Coffee Chats, and monthly Happy Hours to foster our vibrant culture.

jobs.description:
Master Works is seeking a QA Integration Engineer to ensure the robustness, reliability, and security of enterprise integration flows and middleware components built on the IBM webMethods integration layer. This role develops comprehensive test plans, automates API verification, and executes rigorous scenario-based testing across core operational back-office platforms, third-party web services, and middle-tier microservices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review integration specifications, Swagger/OpenAPI docs, and data mapping sheets to formulate end-to-end testing strategies.
  • Design, build, and execute functional, regression, boundary, and negative test scenarios for REST and SOAP APIs running across IBM webMethods.
  • Validate bidirectional data exchange and state changes between external/internal APIs and underlying operational systems (ERP, enterprise asset management, legacy databases).
  • Build and maintain automated API test suites integrated with CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Conduct payload structure validation, schema validation (JSON/XML), data transformation checks, and transaction rollback verification.
  • Execute non-functional integration testing, including rate limiting, API latency benchmarks, error-handling resilience, and token authentication (OAuth, mTLS).
  • Track and document integration defects, coordinate root-cause analysis with the webMethods development team, and monitor fixes to closure.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of dedicated software quality assurance experience, with at least 2 years focused specifically on middleware, microservices, and API integration testing.
  • Direct working knowledge of testing within Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) or integration middleware ecosystems (IBM webMethods, Software AG, or comparable platforms like MuleSoft/TIBCO).
  • High proficiency in API testing tools such as Postman, Newman, SoapUI, ReadyAPI, or JMeter.
  • Strong grasp of API authentication protocols, message brokers, HTTP status code semantics, and distributed system architectures.
  • Proficiency in writing complex SQL queries to validate database-level state changes after API execution.
  • ISTQB Certified Tester (Advanced Level - Technical Test Analyst or Agile Tester), Postman API Fundamentals / Certified Automation, and IBM Certified Associate (webMethods) certifications are preferred.
  • Skills in automated testing scripts (Python/JavaScript), CI/CD test automation (Azure DevOps/GitLab), XML/JSON parsing, and mock service virtualization are preferred.

jobs.excerpt: THE COMPANY Careerminds is a leader in career transition and coaching solutions, helping organizations support employees through change while enabling workforce growth and development.
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Careerminds is a leader in career transition and coaching solutions, helping organizations support employees through change while enabling workforce growth and development. Our product portfolio includes market-leading Career Transition and Coaching Services as well as Progression, our application for Career Frameworks and progression planning.

THE ROLE

We're growing our machine learning team. We're looking for Machine Learning Engineers who own products end to end — from the problem, to production, to the metric that proves it worked.

This role exists because of how we build. A small product strategy team sets direction and priorities; engineers own the work end to end — discovery, design, build, ship, and the result. You'll have the autonomy of a founder inside your domain and the accountability that comes with it.

That accountability includes the unglamorous half of ML. You own the experiment that doesn't pan out and the call to kill it, not just the launch. We'd rather you run four honest experiments and ship the one that works than ship four things that all look fine on a dashboard.

AI-native development isn't an aspiration here — it's the baseline. Our engineers ship with Claude Code and Claude Design as their default tools, and the leverage that creates is why one engineer can own a product end to end.

We want people already working this way who want to push the ceiling higher, not people who are curious about AI. In the interview we'll ask you to show us the trail: repos, PRs, or shipped work you built this way.

This is a 100% remote/work-from-home role.

THE KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Depending on area of focus:

Canonical data and entity resolution

  • Canonical datasets for titles, companies, skills, and industries — the layer every application depends on. Content-addressed IDs, faceted taxonomies, alias graphs accumulated across tens of millions of rows.
  • Rules-based resolution pipelines with LLM escalation, where the accumulated alias graph is the durable asset and escalation volume should fall over time.
  • Nightly agent loops that adjudicate ambiguous entities, propose structural changes, and get gated by invariant checks and blast-radius limits before anything commits.
  • Job ingestion at scale: multi-source feeds, deduplication, freshness, and the indexing economics underneath.

Retrieval, ranking, and matching

  • Job matching v2: two-tower retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, trained on outcome labels rather than clicks. Hard-negative mining, propensity weighting, impression-time logging.
  • Mobility embeddings learned from observed career sequences — the similarity a text encoder can't recover, where Claims Adjuster and Underwriting Assistant are substitutable despite sharing no vocabulary.
  • Pivot feasibility: given where someone is, what moves are realistic, what's missing, and which intermediate roles actually worked for peers.

Applied LLMs and agents

  • Fine-tuning where it earns its cost — against outcome labels, not for tasks a well-prompted frontier model already handles.
  • Agentic systems in production with human approval gates: agents that analyze, propose changes as reviewable artifacts, and execute only after a human signs off. We have this pattern running against tens of millions of customer touchpoints a year and want to push it much further.
  • Continuous skills inference from work artifacts rather than static documents — a problem several of our enterprise customers are currently solving for themselves, badly.
  • New product surfaces where the right answer genuinely requires an LLM, and the discipline to notice when it doesn't.

Across all of it

  • Evaluation infrastructure you'd defend in a design review: time-forward splits, calibration, offline-to-online agreement, and honest handling of feedback-loop degeneration and survivorship bias.
  • Building inside real constraints: GDPR, EU AI Act high-risk classification for employment AI, and client data commitments are design inputs here, not someone else's problem.

THE MUST-HAVES

  • 5+ years shipping ML systems into production — and you can name the system, the metric before and after, and how you knew the model caused the change.
  • Depth in both classical ML and deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow) applied to live products, not notebooks and Kaggle sets.
  • Working fluency with LLMs in production — retrieval, evals, prompt and context engineering, and the judgment to recognize when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • You already ship with agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Claude Design, or close equivalents — and can point to work you built with them.
  • Software engineering fundamentals strong enough to own your own deploys — Python, Git, cloud (we run AWS), containers, and the patience for genuinely messy, human-authored, self-reported data.

THE NICE-TO-HAVES

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, or taxonomy design at scale
  • Ranking, recommendation, or two-tower retrieval systems
  • Sequence models on longitudinal or event-stream data
  • Embedding and vector retrieval systems in production
  • Experiment design, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation
  • Warehouse-native ML (dbt, Snowflake, or similar)
  • Labor market, HR tech, or people-data domain experience
  • Open-source contributions or publications

We seek talented, qualified employees, regardless of race, color, sex/gender (including pregnancy, gender identity, and gender expression), national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law. Le rôle nécessite une expérience pratique avec des plateformes telles que Tenable, Qualys ou Rapid7, ainsi qu’une solide maîtrise des méthodologies de priorisation comme CVSS, EPSS et KEV.

La personne travaillera étroitement avec les équipes d’infrastructure, applications, Cloud, opérations et cybersécurité afin de coordonner les activités de remédiation et d’améliorer la maturité globale du programme de gestion des vulnérabilités.

Digital Designer

PH location / Remote first

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role We are looking for a creative and collaborative Digital Designer to join our Digital Product team! In this role, your goal is simple: help us design the digital experiences that turn curious consumers into loyal subscribers.

Working closely with our eCommerce Specialist, Growth Marketing, and Creative partners, you will take our brand campaigns and translate them into engaging on-site experiences. You’ll work closely with our Product Designer on the storefront, with a focus on visual craft, brand expression, and keeping the storefront looking fresh and commercially effective.

We are also excited for this person to embrace AI. You'll use AI tools to speed up your day-to-day workflow—handling routine formatting and generating assets so you have more time to spend on the actual creative craft that AI can't replicate.

If you worked here this past month, here are some things you might have been involved in:

  • Helping design a site takeover for a new product launch (like adding a cameo from “Clammy” as a temporary avatar during our Splash Limited Edition).
  • Using AI tools to generate draft assets and format standard banners, saving yourself hours of manual resizing.
  • Collaborating with Growth Marketing to iterate on landing pages, making sure the design connects the ad content smoothly to the shop experience.
  • Partnering with the Product Designer to ensure your campaign placements fit nicely within the everyday storefront.
  • Updating standard campaign placements (banners, hero treatments, product callouts) to keep the site looking unmistakably Who Gives A Crap.
  • Sprinkling digital easter eggs across the site that reward curiosity (like hiding toilets across the site for a "Where's the Loo" Limited Edition campaign).

Let’s talk about you
You are a solid visual designer who understands that great digital design isn't just about looking good—it's about helping the customer find what they need. You have a great eye for typography and composition, and you're eager to learn how your designs impact metrics like conversion.

Here’s what we're hoping you'll bring to the table:

  • Visual Craft: You have a strong portfolio of digital work. You know how to take a campaign brief and apply it to digital surfaces while keeping the brand feeling consistent and high-quality.
  • Curiosity around AI: You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools to speed up your production work, but you know that the final brand finish and quality control always stay with you.
  • Commercial Interest: You want to know why a design works. You're curious about how campaigns perform on site and are open to using customer insights to tweak your designs.
  • A Collaborative Mindset: You are a great team player. You listen well, adapt your communication style depending on who you are working with (marketing, engineering, etc.), and take constructive feedback in stride.
  • Time Management: You know how to juggle multiple tasks. Campaign work moves fast, so you are good at prioritizing your time, keeping the team updated on your progress, and flagging when you need help.

You give a crap
Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?
First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world. We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right). Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?
If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

the basics

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d) to join us as the embedded technical expert who takes our customers from "interested in AI" to running real agentic workflows in production.

This is a hands-on, code-shipping role, not an advisory one. You'll work directly inside a customer's environment - understanding their domain, their data, and the business outcomes that matter to them - and build the agentic use cases (using MCPs, skills, and our agent platform) that make those outcomes real. You'll also bring a working understanding of Kubernetes, since our platform is built and operated on it, but that's the foundation you stand on, not the focus of the role.

Giant Swarm is a fast-growing open-source infrastructure management platform used by modern enterprises. Our vision is to empower developers around the world to ship great products - this role is core to how we do that with our agent platform.

your job

  • You partner directly with a customer as their embedded expert - not just advising, but designing, building, and shipping working agentic solutions in their environment.

  • You get up to speed on a new customer's domain quickly (e.g. smart manufacturing, financial services, whatever it is) and identify the business outcomes AI/agentic workflows can realistically deliver for them.

  • You design and build proof-of-concepts and production-track agentic workflows using MCPs, skills, and our agent platform, tailored to that customer's data and systems.

  • You act as the customer-side expert on what our agent platform can do - translating platform capability into something their engineers can actually use and extend.

  • You work closely with customer engineering teams - some devrel-style enablement, workshops, and pairing so they can own what you build after you move on.

  • You feed the patterns and gaps you find back to the product team, shaping what we build next.

  • You may support pre-sales conversations - helping scope what AI use cases would deliver value for a prospect, and building examples that help make the case for choosing Giant Swarm.

requirements

  • You have practical, hands-on experience in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar).

  • You have real, hands-on experience building with agentic AI - MCPs, agent frameworks, tool-using LLMs, or similar. This is non-negotiable.

  • You can get productive in an unfamiliar business domain fast, and turn what you learn into concrete technical solutions.

  • You have at least a solid working understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native operations.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently with both customer stakeholders and engineers - this role lives at that interface.

  • Experience with developer relations, workshops, or technical enablement is a strong plus, as is prior Solutions Architect experience.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity - this is our first hire fully dedicated to agentic customer work, so a lot of the "how" is still being defined as you go.

  • You are able to comfortably align parts of your workday with Europe (UTC +/- 2 hours).

salary information

We’re a fully remote company and use a formula-based salary calculator to determine starting salaries, factoring in location, experience, and responsibility. This approach helps us avoid pay gaps (e.g., gender pay gap) by basing compensation on objective criteria rather than negotiation. Because we apply a location factor, the actual figure for hires outside Cologne will differ from the reference range above, and the total package may include components beyond base salary (e.g., equity, benefits). We’re publishing this range to comply with the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Your recruiter will walk you through how the calculator applies to your location and level.

In this role, the PAL Lead will be responsible for navigating a new prescription via a referral from a referral source through the necessary steps to determine whether it can be serviced in the BioMatrix network of pharmacies.

In addition to the PAL- Pending duties, PAL Lead will also assist in ensuring the team is achieving service level agreements, on-boarding new cases to meet team goals, being a resource for escalations and further escalating cases as appropriate. This role will work closely with data entry, reimbursement, nurse coordination, revenue cycle management and pharmacy operations team members supporting various stages of the intake and pharmacy management processes and will understand the case status and next steps for each referral they are responsible for supporting.

In this role, your work will:

  • Help patients remain on therapy without delays or disruption
  • Provide clarity and reassurance during insurance or coverage changes
  • Support care teams through accurate documentation and proactive communication

Every follow‑up helps safeguard a patient’s ability to continue treatment with confidence.

jobs.description:
***For that position, we only hire in Buenos Aires🇦🇷 or Sao Paulo🇧🇷***

Who is Rollee

Rollee is a data platform that helps financial institutions make better risk decisions by accessing verified income, employment, and other alternative data directly from the source.

The way people work has changed. Income can now come from multiple employers, freelance work, gig platforms, or other sources, but many financial institutions still rely on traditional documents and credit data to understand someone's financial situation. This can make verification slow and fragmented and can leave people with non-traditional income profiles underserved.

Through a single platform, we connect to sources such as gig platforms, government tax portals, payment platforms, and other employment and income systems, then transform that information into structured, actionable data. Our customers use it to verify income and employment, improve their risk models, reduce fraud, and make better underwriting decisions.

Ultimately, our mission is to help build a financial system where people can be assessed based on a more complete picture of their real financial situation, regardless of how or where they work.

The role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Coverage team.

The Coverage team is responsible for expanding and maintaining Rollee’s ability to connect to employment and income data sources. You’ll work on challenging technical problems involving web and mobile applications, third-party systems, APIs, authentication flows, and data extraction.

We’re open to different levels of experience. You might be a junior engineer looking for an environment where you can learn quickly and take on increasing responsibility, or a more experienced engineer ready to own problems independently and contribute to technical decisions.

What matters most to us is your curiosity, problem-solving ability, and willingness to understand how systems work under the hood.

What you'll do

  • Build, maintain, and improve integrations with employment and income data sources
  • Investigate and resolve production issues
  • Explore web and mobile applications to understand how they communicate with backend systems
  • Work with undocumented or partially documented third-party APIs
  • Debug authentication flows, network requests, and data extraction processes
  • Write reliable, maintainable Python code
  • Contribute to technical design decisions and help improve our engineering practices
  • Improve the testing, monitoring, and automation of our systems
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and other members of the team
  • Take ownership of your work, iterate quickly, learn from feedback, and continuously improve

The scope and level of ownership will naturally depend on your experience.

What we're looking for

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with web scraping, automation, data extraction, or similar technical challenges
  • A good understanding of HTTP, APIs, and client-server communication
  • Some experience exploring or debugging web and/or mobile applications
  • The ability and curiosity to investigate systems with limited or incomplete documentation
  • A strong problem-solving mindset and an interest in understanding how things work
  • The ability to learn independently and get comfortable with unfamiliar technical challenges
  • Good written and spoken English

We’re intentionally open to different experience levels, so you don’t need to tick every box. If you have strong technical foundations and enjoy solving unconventional engineering problems, we encourage you to apply.

Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus:

  • Experience with network debugging and traffic analysis
  • Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms
  • Familiarity with application security, encryption, and common security protocols
  • Experience reverse-engineering web or mobile application behavior
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • An understanding of privacy-by-design principles
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, or DevOps practices
  • Experience designing maintainable backend systems and APIs
  • Experience working in a remote engineering team

Why Rollee

  • Build something that matters. Join an early-stage company with an ambitious mission: transforming how employment and income data is accessed around the world.
  • Have real ownership. Work on meaningful technical challenges, make decisions, and have a direct impact on the product from day one.
  • Grow with us. Whether you join as a junior, mid-level, or senior engineer, we’ll adapt the scope and level of ownership to your experience, with plenty of room to learn and grow.
  • Work flexibly. We care about outcomes and ownership, not where you sit. We give our team the flexibility and trust to do their best work.
  • Get the tools you need. We provide a MacBook, plus access to a coworking space and/or a remote-work equipment budget, depending on your location.
  • Be part of an international team. Work with people from different backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives in an environment where everyone can contribute.
  • Join a well-backed company. Rollee is backed by leading investors and business angels, including Speedinvest, Seedcamp, and 20VC.
  • And there’s more. We offer additional benefits that we’ll be happy to walk you through during the interview process.

Our hiring process

  1. Cultural interview with our People Manager (30min)
  2. Take-home technical assignment
  3. Technical interview with members of the Coverage Team (1 hour)
  4. Interview with a Tech Lead & Product Manager (30min)
  5. Final conversation with our CEO (15min)
